Awakened: see invisible things and into the Ethereal Plane within 60 feet; once per dawn, as a bonus action, see through up to 1 foot of stone, 1 inch of metal or 3 feet of wood or dirt within 60 feet for 1 minute (lead blocks it); as a bonus action, toggle 2x magnification. Exalted: automatically detect and succeed on saves against illusions you can see, and see an aura around shapechanged creatures; once per dawn, as an action, cast antimagic field.

magic-item:grimoire-infinitus.description: A Vestige of Divergence: an endless, 3-pound spellbook. Dormant: it holds alarm, antimagic field, Bigby's hand, blight, charm person, confusion, control weather, create undead, detect thoughts, enlarge/reduce, fear, foresight, gaseous form, glyph of warding, legend lore, Leomund's tiny hut, mass suggestion, mislead, misty step, Mordenkainen's faithful hound, prismatic spray, ray of enfeeblement, silent image, teleport and thunderwave; used as your spellbook, you prepare one extra wizard spell. Awakened: advantage on saves against spells and magical effects while carrying it, and one more prepared spell. Exalted: Arcane Recovery twice between long rests, and one more prepared spell.

magic-item:hide-of-the-feral-guardian.description: A Vestige of Divergence. Dormant: +1 AC; while transformed by an effect that replaces your statistics you keep the armor's benefits and gain +1 to melee attack and damage rolls; once per dawn, as an action, polymorph yourself into a giant owl, keeping your Int, Wis and Cha. Awakened: +2 AC and +2 to those rolls, and the polymorph can make you a cave bear (polar bear statistics). Exalted: +3 AC and +3 to those rolls, and the polymorph can make you a guardian wolf.

magic-item:infiltrator-s-key.description: A Vestige of Divergence. Dormant: works as thieves' tools for locks with proficiency and advantage, and advantage on Dex (Stealth) checks to move silently while holding it. Awakened: as a bonus action it becomes a +1 dagger that returns after ranged attacks (or a key again); once per dawn each, as an action, cast alter self, invisibility, knock or pass without trace. Exalted: once per dawn, as a bonus action, open a passage up to 10 by 10 feet through a surface up to 5 feet thick, closing once the key passes through (shunting anyone inside safely); once per dawn each, cast dimension door, gaseous form or mislead.

magic-item:stormgirdle.description: A Vestige of Divergence of Kord. Dormant: resistance to lightning and thunder and Strength 21; once per dawn, as an action, become a Storm Avatar for 1 minute: immune to lightning and thunder, bludgeoning weapon hits deal thunder and piercing or slashing hits deal lightning, and as a bonus action a creature within 30 feet makes a DC 15 Dex save, 3d6 lightning, half on success. Awakened: Strength 23, the strike deals 4d6, and the avatar flies 30 feet (hover). Exalted: Strength 25, the strike deals 5d6, and once per dawn you can cast control weather.

magic-item:verminshroud.description: A Vestige of Divergence. Dormant: advantage on smell-based Wis (Perception) checks, immunity to disease, darkvision 60 feet (or +60); once per dawn, as an action, polymorph into a rat or giant rat keeping your Int, Wis, Cha and the cloak's benefits. Awakened: resistance to poison; once per dawn cast insect plague (save DC 15, no material components); the polymorph can make you a giant wasp. Exalted: climb speed equal to walking speed; a bite natural weapon (1d6 + Str piercing, usable as a bonus action) whose damage forces a DC 17 Con save or poisoned for 1 minute (repeat save each turn end); the polymorph can make you a giant scorpion.

magic-item:wreath-of-the-prism.description: A Vestige of Divergence: a crown of golden thorns set with Tiamat's five colors. Dormant: darkvision 60 feet (or +60); when you hit or grapple a Beast, Dragon or Monstrosity of CR 5 or lower, you can cast dominate monster on it (save DC 13); a success grants it 24-hour immunity, a failure marks it with a golden collar or crown while charmed, charming a second creature ends the first, and it knows you charmed it. Awakened: CR 10 or lower, DC 15. Exalted: CR 15 or lower, DC 17.

magic-item:blade-of-broken-mirrors.description: An Arm of the Betrayers holding the glabrezu Ragazuu (sentient chaotic evil; Int 21, Wis 24, Cha 24; hearing and darkvision 120 feet; telepathy, Abyssal and Common), who urges reckless revolution. Artifact properties: 1 minor beneficial and 1 minor detrimental when dormant, plus one of each when awakened and 1 major beneficial when exalted. Dormant: you know Abyssal; +1 dagger that returns after ranged attacks; it remembers Humanoids it kills (forgotten on a new attunement), and as an action you can take any remembered form (statistics unchanged except size), reverting as an action or on death. Awakened: +2, and once per dawn each, as an action, cast fabricate, hallucinatory terrain, major image or phantasmal killer (save DC 15). Exalted: +3, spell DC 17, and as an action turn invisible with your gear until you let go of it, attack, force a save, or end it as a bonus action.

magic-item:grovelthrash.description: An Arm of the Betrayers holding the ultroloth Ciria (sentient neutral evil; Int 18, Wis 15, Cha 19; hearing and darkvision 120 feet; telepathy, Abyssal, Common and Infernal), who loves treasure and pain. Artifact properties as the Arms of the Betrayers. Dormant: you know Abyssal and Infernal; +1; on a hit you can deal an extra 2d6 bludgeoning and take 1d6 psychic; double damage to objects; advantage on Wis (Insight) checks to spot lies in languages you know. Awakened: +2; burrow speed equal to walking speed through sand, earth, mud or ice; once per dawn, when a creature within 30 feet hits you, use your reaction to deal it psychic damage equal to the damage you took. Exalted: +3; an extra 2d6 bludgeoning on hits while below half HP; burrow through rock at half speed leaving a 5-foot tunnel; once per dawn each, cast earthquake, meld into stone or stone shape (save DC 17).

magic-item:lash-of-shadows.description: An Arm of the Betrayers holding the marilith Sizlifeth (sentient chaotic evil; Int 18, Wis 16, Cha 20; hearing and darkvision 120 feet; telepathy, Abyssal, Common and Draconic), short-tempered and fond of harm. Artifact properties as the Arms of the Betrayers. Dormant: you know Abyssal and Draconic; +1; a creature it hits makes a DC 13 Con save against a poison of your choice (each other than Serpent Venom once per dawn): Dead Eyes, poisoned and blinded for 1 hour; Serpent Venom, 3d6 poison, half on success. Awakened: +2, DC 15, and Ghoul's Blood: poisoned and paralyzed for 1 minute (repeat save each turn end). Exalted: +3, DC 17, and Cockatrice Tears: restrained as it turns to stone, repeating the save at the end of its next turn: success ends it, failure petrifies it for 24 hours.

magic-item:mace-of-the-black-crown.description: An Arm of the Betrayers holding the erinyes Xartaza (sentient lawful evil; Int 20, Wis 12, Cha 18; hearing and darkvision 120 feet; telepathy, Common and Infernal), who pushes its wielder toward Asmodeus. Artifact properties as the Arms of the Betrayers. Dormant: you know Infernal; +1; as a bonus action, ignite or douse its head (bright light 40 feet, dim 40 more), dealing an extra 1d6 fire while lit; once per dawn, as an action, summon a friendly imp that obeys you for 10 minutes. Awakened: +2, 2d6 fire, the summon can be a bearded devil, and resistance to poison while holding it. Exalted: +3, 3d6 fire that ignores fire resistance, the summon can be a barbed devil, and resistance to fire while holding it.

magic-item:ruin-s-wake.description: An Arm of the Betrayers holding the balor Yarrowish (sentient chaotic evil; Int 20, Wis 16, Cha 22; hearing and darkvision 120 feet; telepathy, Abyssal, Common and Orc), hungry for violence. Artifact properties as the Arms of the Betrayers. Dormant: you know Abyssal and Orc; +1 and an extra 1d8 piercing on hits; it returns after ranged attacks; once per short or long rest, when hit by a melee attack, use your reaction to attack the attacker with advantage. Awakened: +2 and 2d8; once per dawn, hurl it as a lightning bolt in a 5-foot line to a creature within 120 feet: DC 15 Dex save, 8d6 lightning, half on success, then it returns. Exalted: +3; once per dawn, as a bonus action, chosen creatures within 30 feet gain advantage on attacks until your next turn; once per dawn, when it drops a creature to 0 HP, regain HP equal to that attack's damage.

magic-item:silken-spite.description: An Arm of the Betrayers holding the yochlol Sinnafex (sentient chaotic evil; Int 13, Wis 15, Cha 15; hearing and darkvision 120 feet; telepathy, Abyssal, Common, Elvish and Undercommon), who whispers distrust. Artifact properties as the Arms of the Betrayers. Dormant: you know Abyssal, Elvish and Undercommon; darkvision 60 feet (or +60); +1; as an action, coat it in poison for 1 minute or one hit: DC 13 Con save or poisoned for 1 hour, and unconscious meanwhile if it fails by 5 or more (woken by damage or a shake); spider climb with a climb speed equal to your walking speed, and webs can't hold you. Awakened: +2, DC 15, and once per dawn each, cast cloudkill, darkness, levitate or web (save DC 15). Exalted: +3, DC 17, magical darkness doesn't hinder your darkvision, and once per dawn, as a bonus action in dim light or darkness, teleport up to 60 feet to another such space you can see.

magic-item:the-bloody-end.description: An Arm of the Betrayers holding the pit fiend Izeelzee (sentient lawful evil; Int 22, Wis 18, Cha 24; hearing and darkvision 120 feet; telepathy, Common and Infernal), who demands fealty. Artifact properties as the Arms of the Betrayers. Dormant: you know Infernal; +1; once per dawn each, cast charm person, dominate person or fear (save DC 13); advantage on Cha (Intimidation) checks. Awakened: +2, DC 15; once per dawn, when it drops a creature to 0 HP, chosen creatures within 15 feet make a DC 15 Wis save or are frightened until the end of your next turn; when a creature hits you in melee, use your reaction to deal it 1d6 psychic. Exalted: +3, dominate monster added, DCs 17, and the reaction deals 2d6.

magic-item:will-of-the-talon.description: An Arm of the Betrayers holding the bone devil Ashtyrlon (sentient lawful evil; Int 14, Wis 15, Cha 19; hearing and darkvision 120 feet; telepathy, Common, Draconic and Infernal), greedy and demanding. Artifact properties as the Arms of the Betrayers. Dormant: you know Draconic and Infernal; +1; once per dawn, as a bonus action, Frightful Presence: chosen aware creatures within 30 feet make a DC 13 Wis save or are frightened for 1 minute (repeat save each turn end; 24-hour immunity after); as an action, breathe 3d6 damage (half on a save), each type once per dawn: acid (30-foot line, Dex), cold (15-foot cone, Con), fire (15-foot cone, Dex), lightning (30-foot line, Dex), poison (15-foot cone, Con), DC 13. Awakened: +2, breath DC 15 and 4d6, Frightful Presence DC 15, and resistance to acid, cold, fire, lightning and poison while carrying it. Exalted: +3, breath DC 17 and 5d6, Frightful Presence DC 17.

magic-item:orrery-of-the-wanderer.description: A 2-foot clockwork orrery powered by six component relics. Random properties: 2 minor beneficial, 1 major beneficial, 1 major detrimental (perhaps only with all components installed). Components can be attuned separately (held to use) or together through the orrery, where installed components don't count against your attunement limit. Future Echoes: +1 AC while it is within 30 feet. Into the Void: your alignment drifts to chaotic neutral and you feel driven toward dangerous planes. Master of Travel (all six installed): 7 charges, regaining 1d4 + 4 at dawn; while touching it, as an action, cast (save DC 17) contact other plane (3), demiplane (6), gate (7), plane shift (5) or teleportation circle (3).

magic-item:chronolometer.description: An Orrery of the Wanderer component (may misbehave when not installed). +1 to Int saves, and you learn one new language on first attuning. Time Bandit (once per dawn): at the start of your turn roll a d6: on 1-3 gain an extra action and double speed this turn; on 4-6 you can reroll your next failed save, attack roll or check and take either result. Fate Swap (once per dawn): as a reaction when a creature you can see within 30 feet takes damage, it gains an extra action on its turn or acts immediately.

magic-item:dimensional-loop.description: An Orrery of the Wanderer component (may misbehave when not installed). +1 to Str saves and darkvision 60 feet (or +30 feet). Dimensional Cloak (once per dawn): as a bonus action, for 1 minute gain advantage on Dex (Stealth) checks to hide, and attacks against you have disadvantage. Fold Space (once per dawn): a space you can see within 60 feet counts as within 5 feet of you until the end of your turn, letting you move there without provoking or reach into it.

magic-item:far-gear.description: An Orrery of the Wanderer component (may misbehave when not installed). +1 to Cha saves and advantage on Cha (Intimidation) checks. Aberrant Ally (once per dawn): as conjure celestial without concentration, summoning an Aberration of CR 4 or lower. Unnatural Bane (once per dawn): cast bane (save DC 15) on any number of creatures in range for 1 minute.

magic-item:rotor-of-return.description: An Orrery of the Wanderer component (may misbehave when not installed). +1 to Con saves, and you perfectly recall events from the last 30 days. Borrow Object (once per dawn): a generic mundane item worth 50 gp or less appears with you for 10 minutes. Recall Code: as an action, set a return point; once per dawn, as a bonus action within 500 feet of it, teleport there.

magic-item:timepiece-of-travel.description: An Orrery of the Wanderer component (may misbehave when not installed). +1 to Dex saves, you always know north, and you can cast longstrider on yourself at will. Turn-by-Turn Directions (once per dawn): a voice only you hear guides you by the safest direct route to a place within 10 miles known to some creature within 10 miles of it (it knows terrain, not monsters, traps or locks). Get Away From It All (once per dawn): as an action, cast teleport.

magic-item:wheel-of-stars.description: An Orrery of the Wanderer component (may misbehave when not installed). +1 to Wis saves, and as an action cast dancing lights, guidance or message. Portent of the Stars (once per dawn): as a reaction when a creature you can see within 60 feet makes an attack roll, save or check, it adds or subtracts (your choice) 1d10. Alter Gravity (once per dawn): as an action, cast fly on yourself or levitate (save DC 15).

magic-item:arc-rifle.description: 4 charges, regaining 1d4 at dawn. As an action spend 1 to fire a 60-foot by 5-foot line of lightning: Dex save (DC PB + Dex mod) for 6d6 lightning, half on success. When the last charge is spent, roll a d20; on a 1 it burns out for good.

magic-item:ardor.description: +3 battleaxe dealing +3d10 necrotic on a hit. While held you are immune to charmed, frightened, paralyzed, poisoned, and stunned. Bonus action: let it hover nearby, and command it (bonus action) to fly 50 feet and attack or return. Once each per dawn cast bane, banishment, bestow curse, branding smite, or incendiary cloud (DC 18). Only its twin Zeal can harm it (AC 21, 300 HP).

magic-item:bow-of-four.description: Summon an elemental arrow when you shoot (no action), dissolving after 1 minute: air 2d8 lightning, earth 2d8 magical bludgeoning, fire 2d8 fire, or water 2d8 cold.

magic-item:carvaloth-scale-armor.description: Its color shifts to hide you: Perception checks to see you have disadvantage and you have advantage on Stealth checks to hide from sight.

magic-item:cinder-coat.description: +1 AC. 3 charges, regaining 1d3 at dawn: when you hit a creature that isn't at full HP, spend 1 for +1d10 fire.

magic-item:cloak-of-the-stygian-bat.description: Advantage on hearing-based Perception. Once per long rest, activate it for 1 minute: fly 30 feet, blindsight 120 feet, and advantage on Dex saves while airborne.

magic-item:flammable-tincture.description: As an action throw it up to 30 feet: the target makes a DC 10 Dex save or is vulnerable to fire for 1 minute, overriding any resistance or immunity.

magic-item:light-drinker.description: +2 longsword dealing cold instead of slashing. Darkvision 60 feet that sees through magical darkness. Bonus action: emit magical darkness 15 feet (dim 15 more), resizable as an action between 10 and 30 feet; only antimagic field suppresses it.

magic-item:ring-of-hidden-desire.description: Three times per day (recharging at midnight), as an action learn a creature's darkest desire unless it passes a DC 13 Wis save, which makes it immune for 24 hours. No effect on Intelligence 3 or lower.

magic-item:seeing-glass.description: Its reflection shows every creature's true form as with true seeing. It shatters if turned on a vampire.

magic-item:telltale-heart.description: Advantage on saves against being frightened, and a DC 15 Wis save against frighten effects that allow none. Once per long rest, listen to it for advantage on an Intelligence check.

magic-item:zeal.description: +3 warhammer dealing +3d10 radiant on a hit. While held you are immune to charmed, frightened, paralyzed, poisoned, and stunned. Bonus action: let it hover nearby, and command it (bonus action) to fly 50 feet and attack or return. Once each per dawn cast banishment, branding smite, beacon of hope, earthquake, or heroism (DC 18). Only its twin Ardor can harm it (AC 21, 300 HP).

magic-item:anglerfish-helm.description: Water Breathing cast on you lasts twice as long, the antenna can shed bright light 20 feet and dim light 20 more, and once per dawn you can cast Charm Person (3rd level) from it.

magic-item:baffled-candle.description: While lit, the creature holding it is invisible. It burns for 1d4 + 3 minutes, then is destroyed.

magic-item:bell-of-resonance.description: Once per dawn, ring it as an action: creatures wielding metal weapons within 30 feet make a DC 14 Strength save or drop them.

magic-item:boots-of-the-stampede.description: When you Dash, you move an additional 15 feet.

magic-item:burnright-brand-hair-dryer.description: 7 charges, regaining 1d6 + 1 at dawn. As an action cast Burning Hands (1), Gust of Wind (2), or Cone of Cold (5).

magic-item:censer-of-arguing-spirits.description: Lifting the lid of this battered teapot raises three bickering elderly spirit faces; each answers one question, then can't be asked again for 7 days.

magic-item:canseco-bat.description: A +1 warhammer. Once per dawn, when a hostile creature misses you with a ranged spell attack, use your reaction to redirect it at another creature within 30 feet using the bat's attack bonus.

magic-item:cloud-touched-boomerang.description: On a hit you can make the target succeed on a DC 12 Strength save or fall prone.

magic-item:coin-s-edge.description: Flipped into the air, it permanently becomes a mundane dagger.

magic-item:corrupted-pendant.description: Once per dawn as an action, regain a third of your hit point maximum, but you can't benefit from a short rest until the next dawn. Recharging it afterward takes a 1-hour ritual consuming three common ingredients.

magic-item:crt-tv-chicken-timer.description: Once per dawn, set it as an action for 11 minutes 14 seconds; meanwhile its screen shows a fuzzy view of the 10-foot sphere around it.

magic-item:cube-of-cubes.description: Once per dawn, solve a side as an action to cast a random spell (d6): Water Bullet, Forest Guard, Cure Wounds, Enlarge/Reduce, Flaming Sphere, or Pacify Person (spellcasting +4, attack +7, DC 15).

magic-item:eye-kite.description: While flying it, as an action see downward through it with your own visual senses.

magic-item:familiar-s-collar.description: Cast Control Animal at will on a friendly beast wearing the collar.

magic-item:field-cauldron.description: When used with alchemist's supplies to brew an uncommon or rarer potion, you also brew a random common potion.

magic-item:fisherman-s-spear.description: Melee attacks can extend to reach targets up to 15 feet away, at -1 to hit per 5 feet beyond normal reach.

magic-item:flying-broomstick.description: Thought-controlled broom with a 60-foot flying speed carrying up to 1,000 pounds; it returns to you from within 100 feet on command and can leave a cosmetic trail.

magic-item:gametoy.description: While attuned with a cartridge inserted, you are proficient in the cartridge's skill; swap cartridges as an action. Comes with one random-skill cartridge.

magic-item:guardian-spheres.description: A set of 1d4 + 1 floating spheres, each with 5 hit points that it automatically spends to reduce damage from attacks on you; spent spheres go inert and recover at dawn.

magic-item:heron-s-eye-ring.description: +3 to Wisdom (Insight and Perception). 6 charges (1d4 + 2 at dawn): Dispel Magic (3), Find Traps (2), See Invisibility (2), Shared Vision (2), Spell Signature (2).

magic-item:hover-hopper.description: Inflated on command, these balloons halve your falling damage and let your standing long and high jumps reach your Strength or Dexterity score in feet.

magic-item:hurler-s-gloves.description: +2 damage with thrown weapons and +15 feet to their ranges.

magic-item:instaprint-camera.description: Photos show magical creatures and objects with a school-of-magic aura. Comes with 1d12 + 4 film cards.

magic-item:jabbadoon-s-feather.description: A creature holding it becomes as light as a feather.

magic-item:keys-to-the-sandcastle.description: 50 charges; spend 1 as an action to cast Sand Structure. Becomes a knickknack when empty.

magic-item:keytar.description: During a minute-long performance, pick a lock within 15 feet with a Charisma (Performance) check against its DC; after a failure you can't retry that lock for 24 hours.

magic-item:lafula-s-iron-teapot.description: Once a month, brew six cursed portions; drinkers suffer a Bestow Curse effect the brewer chooses for 1 year or until removed.

magic-item:lunar-weapon.description: At night, hits deal an extra 1d8 radiant.

magic-item:oiki-s-pinwheel.description: Spin it and set it down as an action: hostile creatures within 120 feet that see it make a DC 15 Wisdom save or are stunned while it spins (1 minute, or indefinitely in strong wind; save each turn). Afterward its magic jumps to another pinwheel.

magic-item:only-members-jacket.description: As an action, take on an illusory disguise of a humanoid set by the enchanter until you remove it (DC 14 Investigation to see through).

magic-item:painter-s-sun-hat.description: Placed down as an action with its command word, it hovers and projects an immobile illusion of a humanoid you know wearing it (DC 10 Investigation).

magic-item:pendants-of-belonging.description: A set of four, six, or eight; each wearer always knows the direction of the others.

magic-item:punch-card.description: A hole is punched each time its carrier is hit by an attack (starts with 1d6). The tenth hole reduces that attack's damage to 0, and the magic fades.

magic-item:roake-s-clay-urn.description: Once, as an action, a spirit within 30 feet that sees or hears you makes a DC 13 Wisdom save (CR 3+ succeed) or is sealed in timeless slumber until the urn is broken.

magic-item:ruby-red-bike.description: A bicycle with a 70-foot speed. Once per dawn, after riding 60 feet in a turn, use an action to raise a Wall of Fire along your path.

magic-item:scarf-of-muffling.description: Three times per dawn, throw it as an action at a creature within 60 feet: DC 14 Dexterity save or it can't speak until it or another creature pulls it off (DC 14 Strength check as an action).

magic-item:scuttling-lantern.description: Touch to light or snuff (bright 30 feet, dim 30 more). While lit, command it to scuttle 20 feet each turn along any surface or have it follow you; it goes out beyond 500 feet.

magic-item:sibling-purses.description: Two pouches holding 5 pounds each; an object placed in one can teleport into the other if it is within 20 feet and has room.

magic-item:soda-cans.description: Melon Soda grants a random common combat potion, Cola Soda a random common utility potion, and Fish Sauce Soda a random common whimsical potion.

magic-item:solar-amulet.description: Regain 3 extra hit points whenever a spell or magical effect heals you.

magic-item:splinter-bow.description: Split a shot between two creatures within 10 feet of each other with one attack roll; each target hit takes half the rolled damage.

magic-item:sticky-hand.description: While holding it you can cast Retrieve.

magic-item:sunbaked-cassettes.description: As a bonus action roll a d4: on 1 to 3 regain an expended slot of that level (or the next higher expended), once per dawn; on a 4 you teleport 30 feet in a random direction.

magic-item:talisman-of-the-phoenix.description: 1d4 charges: spend one to turn a failed death save into a success. When empty it burns up and reforms elsewhere.

magic-item:travel-wok.description: A +1 frying pan dealing an extra 1d4 fire. Once per dawn, food cooked in it gives eaters 1d6 temporary hit points for 1 hour.

magic-item:umbrella-of-shielding.description: A +1 umbrella; when targeted by a ranged weapon attack, use your reaction for +5 AC against it.

magic-item:weapon-of-the-sun-and-moon.description: Formed by a ritual combining a Lunar Weapon and Solar Amulet: a +1 weapon with both items' properties that can cast a 60-foot Darkness once per day and Daylight once per night.

magic-item:yappa-mask.description: While worn, your creature type is Spirit and you speak and understand Torum.

magic-item:banner-of-the-krig-rune.description: A 5-by-3-foot war banner (an action to furl or unfurl). Mark of Courage: once per short or long rest as a bonus action, you and allies within 20 ft. of the unfurled banner are immune to frightened for 10 minutes. Sentinel Standard: you see invisible creatures within 20 ft. of it. Standard's Shield: once per short or long rest as a bonus action, ranged attacks against you and allies within 20 ft. of it have disadvantage for 1 minute. Gift of Battle: 8 hours of work destroys the banner to fix a 500-ft.-radius sphere where creatures you chose are immune to frightened and gain +1 to attack rolls and AC.

magic-item:blod-stone.description: A diamond holding a creature's blood. As an action, sense the distance and direction to the nearest non-Undead creature related to that blood (the creature itself or a blood relative).

magic-item:claw-of-the-wyrm-rune.description: Wyrmslayer: three times per dawn as an action, a Dragon within 30 ft. makes a DC 15 Con save or is vulnerable to all damage until the end of your next turn. Wyrm Shield: resistance to Dragon breath weapons while displayed. Wyrm Ward: 8 hours of work destroys it to fix a 100-ft.-radius sphere where Dragons have disadvantage on saves and fly no faster than 10 ft.

magic-item:conch-of-teleportation.description: Once per dawn as an action, blow it to cast teleport to the single destination set by its maker, with no chance of mishap or being off target.

magic-item:gavel-of-the-venn-rune.description: Arbiter's Shield: attacks against you have disadvantage before your first turn in each combat. Bond of Amity: once per long rest as an action, strike a surface; the first creature within 60 ft. to deal damage with a hit in the next minute takes psychic damage equal to half of it. Gift of Truth: 8 hours of work destroys it to fix a 30-ft.-radius sphere where anyone who lies takes 5 psychic and flinches.

magic-item:gurt-s-greataxe.description: A +1 frost-giant-sized greataxe (325 lb.) dealing 3d12 slashing, plus 2d12 slashing against humans. Sheds torchlight below 0 degrees Fahrenheit. Once per dawn as an action, cast heat metal (DC 13) dealing cold instead of fire. Uthgardt attack any giant wielding it.

magic-item:ingot-of-the-skold-rune.description: Runic Shield: +1 AC while carried. Shield Bond: once per short or long rest as a bonus action, a creature within 30 ft. takes only 1 from each damage until the end of your next turn, and you take half the prevented damage (unreducible). Shield Ward: 8 hours of work destroys it to enchant a nonmagical shield (rare, attunement: +1 AC and once per long rest drop to 1 HP instead of 0) or two-handed melee weapon (uncommon: +1 AC while held).

magic-item:korolnor-scepter.description: One of the Ruling Scepters of Shanatar: a +3 magic club that lets you use the Wyrmskull Throne. 10 charges (regains 1d6 + 4 at dawn): 1 to learn the distance to the surface when underground or underwater, 2 to cast sending, 3 to cast teleport (no mishap within 60 ft. of the throne).

magic-item:navigation-orb.description: A 7-ft. mithral sphere keyed to one cloud castle. Touching it, use an action to move the castle 1 mph in a chosen direction, stop it, or turn it 90 degrees; you always know the castle's altitude. Removing or destroying it fixes the castle in place.

magic-item:opal-of-the-ild-rune.description: Ignite: as an action, set a flammable object within 10 ft. alight. Fire's Friend: resistance to cold. Fire Tamer: as an action, put out any amount of open flame within 10 ft. Gift of Flame: 8 hours of work destroys it to enchant a nonmagical weapon (uncommon: +1d6 fire on hits) or armor (rare, attunement: resistance to cold).

magic-item:orb-of-the-stein-rune.description: Indomitable Stand: as an action, for 1 minute or until you move, advantage on checks and saves against forced movement, and enemies moving within 10 ft. make a DC 12 Str save or stop. Stone Soul: you can't be petrified. Earthen Step: once per short or long rest, cast meld into stone as a bonus action. Gift of Stone: 8 hours of work destroys it to enchant a shield (rare, attunement: resistance to ranged weapon damage) or boots (uncommon, attunement: advantage on Str saves and a reaction to avoid being knocked prone).

magic-item:pennant-of-the-vind-rune.description: Wind Step: as an action, fly up to 20 ft. Comforting Wind: you can't suffocate. Wind's Grasp: once per short or long rest, as a reaction take no falling damage. Wind Walker: once per short or long rest, cast levitate as a bonus action. Gift of Wind: 8 hours of work destroys it to enchant armor (uncommon, attunement: +5 ft. speed and no Stealth disadvantage) or boots or a cloak (rare, attunement: turn up to 20 ft. of movement each turn into flight and cast feather fall once per short or long rest).

magic-item:potion-of-giant-size.description: For 24 hours, a Medium or smaller drinker becomes Huge, Strength 25 (if lower), double HP maximum and current HP, +5 ft. melee reach; enlarged weapons roll triple damage dice. Excess HP at the end become temporary HP.

magic-item:robe-of-serpents.description: Bears 1d4 + 3 serpents. As a bonus action, detach one as a giant poisonous snake that acts on your initiative, attacks your foes, and vanishes after 1 hour, at 0 HP, or when dismissed. With no serpents left, the robe is mundane.

magic-item:rod-of-the-vonindod.description: A 100-pound adamantine rod with 10 charges (regains 1d6 + 4 at dawn). As an action, spend 1 to cast locate object; against adamantine objects the range is 10 miles.

magic-item:shard-of-the-ise-rune.description: Frigid Touch: once per short or long rest as an action, freeze water in a 10-ft.-radius sphere. Frost Friend: resistance to fire. Icy Mantle: once per short or long rest as an action, a touched creature's next bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage within 1 minute is reduced to 0. Winter's Howl: once per short or long rest, cast sleet storm (DC 17). Gift of Frost: 8 hours of work destroys it to enchant a cloak (rare, attunement: resistance to fire and advantage on Stealth in snow) or boots (rare, attunement: ignore difficult terrain and walk on water).

magic-item:wyrmskull-throne.description: A hovering obsidian throne on four blue dragon skulls; only a creature attuned to and holding a Ruling Scepter can use it, and anyone else who sits is paralyzed in a force field. 9 charges (all regained at dawn): fly 30 ft. and pass through earth and stone (free), lightning bolt as a 9th-level spell (DC 19, 49 (14d6)) for 1, globe of invulnerability around throne and rider for 2, or a spectral ancient blue dragon for 1 minute that makes a bite and two claw attacks each turn for 3. Destroyed only by breaking five Ruling Scepters on it at once (30-ft. burst, DC 21 Dex, 70 (20d6) slashing, half on success).

magic-item:amulet-of-protection-from-tur.description: Advantage on saves against turn undead effects, and three times per dawn you can turn a failed one into a success. It glows silvery blue when such an effect targets you.

magic-item:balance-of-harmony.description: Cast detect evil and good as a ritual by setting it on a solid surface and sprinkling the pans with holy water (or placing a 100 gp transparent gem in each). It tips toward good or evil or wavers for neither; touching it then reveals what the spell would.

magic-item:bracelet-of-rock-magic.description: Immunity to being petrified. As an action, cast flesh to stone (DC 15) three times total, then stone shape thirteen times, after which it turns to lead. Curse: earth-linked creatures (stone giants, dwarves) have advantage on the save, and if one succeeds the spell rebounds on you (you save with disadvantage; failure petrifies instantly) and your attunement ends.

magic-item:eagle-whistle.description: While you blow it continuously you fly at twice your walking speed, for up to 5 + five times your Con modifier rounds (minimum 1) or until you speak, hold your breath, suffocate, or land; stop while aloft and you fall. Three uses per dawn.

magic-item:hell-hound-cloak.description: As an action, become a hell hound for up to 1 hour (as polymorph; revert as a bonus action). Curse: you won't part with it, and from the sixth use on a failed DC 15 Cha save locks you in form until dispelled or 0 HP; 6 hours in form makes it permanent (remove curse to reverse, wish after 6 days).

magic-item:javelin-of-backbiting.description: +2 to attack and damage; thrown ranges +30 ft., one extra damage die, and it returns to your hand. Curse: you won't part with it and have disadvantage with other weapons; on a natural 1 it strikes you (new attack with advantage against your own AC).

magic-item:loadstone.description: Looks like a 150 gp gem and hides from detect magic (identify reveals it). Curse: using Dash or Disengage while carrying it reduces your speed by 5 ft. and halves your carrying and lifting capacity, and you won't part with it, until remove curse.

magic-item:mirror-of-the-past.description: Once per dawn as an action, think of a creature or object while gazing in to see up to 1 minute of accurate but random, cryptic scenes from its past.

magic-item:night-caller.description: A duergar crystal whistle. Blown in darkness or under the night sky, it casts animate dead, reaching through up to 10 ft. of soft earth (the undead digs out in 1 minute); once per 7 days. Once per 24 hours it can reassert control over one or two undead it animated.

magic-item:nolzur-s-marvelous-pigments.description: 1d4 pots with a brush. Paint inanimate objects or terrain (doors, pits, trees, weapons) up to 10,000 cubic feet per pot (1,000 sq. ft. of surface, 10 minutes per 100 sq. ft.) and they become real and nonmagical. Nothing created is worth more than 25 gp; painted energy dissipates harmlessly.

magic-item:potion-of-mind-control.description: Before the end of your next turn, cast dominate beast or dominate person (rare) or dominate monster (very rare) at DC 15; on a failed save it lasts 1 hour without concentration and the target saves against it with disadvantage.

magic-item:robe-of-summer.description: Resistance to cold, and you're comfortable and unaffected by extreme temperatures.

magic-item:shatterspike.description: +1 to attack and damage. Hits against objects are automatically critical and can deal bludgeoning or slashing; nonmagical damage can't harm it.

magic-item:spear-of-backbiting.description: +2 to attack and damage; thrown ranges +30 ft., one extra damage die, and it returns to your hand. Curse: you won't part with it and have disadvantage with other weapons; on a natural 1 it strikes you (new attack with advantage against your own AC).

magic-item:stone-of-ill-luck.description: Identifies as a stone of good luck. Curse: -2 to ability checks and saves while carried (applied secretly), and you won't part with it until remove curse.

magic-item:wand-of-entangle.description: 7 charges (regains 1d6 + 1 at dawn; 1 in 20 to crumble when emptied). As an action, spend 1 to cast entangle (DC 13).

magic-item:wand-of-the-war-mage.description: Adds its bonus to your spell attack rolls, and your spell attacks ignore half cover.

magic-item:waythe.description: Sentient +1 greatsword (NG; Int 12, Wis 2, Cha 14; hearing and darkvision 120 ft.; speaks Giant and Common, telepathic). Giants it hits take +2d6 slashing and make a DC 15 Str save or fall prone. It also works as a wand of enemy detection that recharges fully at dawn and never crumbles. Good characters attune in 1 minute; it urges bold action.

magic-item:abracadabrus.description: A gem-studded chest with a 1.5-ft. cubic compartment and 20 charges (regains 1d20 at dawn; 1 in 20 to lose its magic when emptied). As an action, touch the closed lid and spend 1 to conjure named nonmagical objects worth up to 1 gp total that fit inside an empty chest. Food spoils after 24 hours; gems and precious metals vanish after 1 minute.

magic-item:cauldron-of-plenty.description: A 30-gallon copper cauldron. Stirring water in it for 1 minute turns it into hot stew, one meal for up to four people per gallon; three uses per dawn.

magic-item:hook-of-fisher-s-delight.description: Tied to a line in at least a 10-ft. cube of water, each uninterrupted hour roll a d6; on a 6 a random magical fish appears on the hook. Once per dawn.

magic-item:lantern-of-tracking.description: A hooded lantern (6 hours per pint of oil, bright light 30 ft., dim 30 ft. more) attuned to one random creature type; its flame turns green while such a creature is within 300 ft.

magic-item:orc-stone.description: As an action, summon an orc war chief spirit within 30 ft. that obeys you and understands your languages for 10 minutes or until it drops to 0 HP. After three uses it turns to dust.

magic-item:piwafwi-cloak-of-elvenkind.description: A drow spider-silk cloak of elvenkind: hood up, Perception to see you has disadvantage and you have advantage on Stealth to hide (an action to raise or lower). An hour of unbroken sunlight ruins its magic.

magic-item:professor-orb.description: A sentient quartz sphere (Int 18, random Wis and Cha and alignment) that speaks four languages, sees and hears 60 ft., and knows four narrow academic subjects (+9 to recall lore in them). It casts mage hand at will only to move itself and never conflicts with its owner.

magic-item:professor-skant.description: A lawful good, chatty, condescending professor orb (Wis 11, Cha 9) speaking Common, Draconic, Elvish, and Loross, expert in Netheril's history, vampires, Elverquisst rituals, and the tarrasque.

magic-item:psi-crystal.attunementNote: by a creature with Intelligence 3 or higher
magic-item:psi-crystal.description: Grants telepathy while attuned and glows purple; higher Intelligence means brighter light and longer telepathy range.

magic-item:scroll-of-tarrasque-summoning.description: As an action, read it to summon the tarrasque within 1 mile, hostile to everything, vanishing at 0 HP.

magic-item:scroll-of-the-comet.description: Outdoors, as an action, call a comet to a point within 1 mile: a 50-ft.-deep, 500-ft.-radius crater; creatures in it make a DC 20 Dex save, 30d10 force or half, and unattended nonmagical objects and structures are destroyed.

magic-item:shield-guardian-amulet.description: Linked to one shield guardian, which protects and obeys the wearer; you know its distance and direction on the same plane. Within 10 ft., an action and a DC 20 Arcana check reactivates it. Unattended amulet: AC 10, 10 HP, immune to poison and psychic; a new one costs 1,000 gp and a week.

magic-item:the-codicil-of-white.description: Auril's fur-bound primer of rites: carrying it grants resistance to cold. It holds the spell frost fingers and the incantation poem Rime of the Frostmaiden, which can split a glacier.

magic-item:thermal-cube.description: A 3-inch brimstone cube that keeps everything within 15 ft. at 95 degrees Fahrenheit.

magic-item:ythryn-mythallar.description: A 50-ft. Netherese crystal globe (bright light 300 ft., dim 300 ft. more); up to eight attune by a short rest within 30 ft., and all must agree to each use. Fly it 30 ft. per action carrying everything within 500 ft.; recharge a held magic item within 30 ft.; cast control weather (50-mile radius) without components. Touching the globe: DC 22 Con save, 180 (20d10 + 70) radiant or half (undead at disadvantage); objects that touch it disintegrate.

magic-item:dawnbringer.description: Sentient gilded hilt (NG; Int 12, Wis 15, Cha 14; hearing and darkvision 120 ft.; speaks Common plus your languages, telepathic). Works as a sun blade, its radiant blade summoned or dismissed as a bonus action. Once per dawn, touch a creature to cast lesser restoration. It fears darkness and abandonment and wants to stay lit and close to you.

magic-item:piwafwi-of-fire-resistance.description: A drow cloak of elvenkind that also grants resistance to fire: hood up (an action), Perception to see you has disadvantage and you have advantage on Stealth to hide. An hour of unbroken sunlight ruins its magic.

magic-item:spell-gem.attunementNote: by a spellcaster, only to imbue it
magic-item:spell-gem.description: Holds one spell; if you know it or it's on your class list, cast it from the gem as an action without components (no attunement needed), emptying it. Spells above your level need a spellcasting check (DC 10 + spell level). The gem type sets its maximum spell level, rarity, save DC, and attack bonus. Attuned, cast a 1-action or 1-minute-plus spell into an empty gem to store it (consumed abjuration components at half cost), once per dawn.

magic-item:stonespeaker-crystal.description: Advantage on Investigation checks. 10 charges (regains 1d6 + 4 at dawn; 1 in 20 to vanish when emptied): speak with animals (2), speak with dead (4), or speak with plants (3). It can replace a consumed material component of a divination spell for 1 charge per spell level.

magic-item:wand-of-viscid-globs.description: 7 charges (regains 1d6 + 1 at midnight; 1 in 20 to melt when emptied). As an action, spend 1 for a ranged attack (spellcasting or Int modifier + proficiency) within 60 ft.; on a hit the target is restrained for 1 hour, ended by a pint of alcohol, oil of etherealness, universal solvent, or sunlight. An hour of unbroken sunlight destroys the wand.

magic-item:black-crystal-tablet.attunementNote: by a creature proficient in Arcana
magic-item:black-crystal-tablet.description: After attuning, you make a DC 20 Wis save at the end of your next long rest or gain a random long-term madness. As an action, cast eyebite or gate (its portal reaching only the Far Realm) from the tablet; it then can't be used again until the next dawn.

magic-item:blast-scepter.description: Works as an arcane focus. While attuned you have resistance to fire and lightning, and as an action you can cast thunderwave at 4th level (DC 16) from it without a slot.

magic-item:chest-of-preserving.description: A 25-lb. chest, 2.5 ft. by 1.5 ft. by 1 ft. with a rounded lid. Food and other perishables stored inside don't age or spoil.

magic-item:circlet-of-human-perfection.description: While worn, you look like an attractive human of average build whose features (age, gender, coloring, voice) the circlet picks. Your statistics, racial traits, and gear are unchanged except for size. Taking it off ends the effect.

magic-item:dagger-of-blindsight.description: A saw-toothed dagger with a black pearl in its pommel. While attuned, you have blindsight 30 ft.

magic-item:dodecahedron-of-doom.description: A 12-inch, twelve-sided clockwork metal die. As an action, hurl it up to 60 ft.; if it rolls at least 10 ft. before stopping, roll a d12 on its table for a random magical effect (the table is in the adventure). Effects that need a target do nothing without one in range, and spells it casts need no components.

magic-item:horn-of-the-endless-maze.description: As an action, blow it to summon 3d4 + 3 minotaur-like Abyssal spirits within 60 ft. that use berserker stats and leave after 1 hour or at 0 HP. If you are proficient with all simple weapons they obey you and are friendly to your allies; otherwise they attack you. Usable once every 7 days.

magic-item:horned-ring.description: Lets the attuned wearer ignore Undermountain's magical restrictions.

magic-item:orb-of-gonging.description: A hollow 5-inch, 5-lb. orb of notched bronze rings. Spend an action lining up the notches and it gongs loudly every 6 seconds, audible 600 ft. away, until they are knocked out of line.

magic-item:potion-of-watchful-rest.description: A sweet amber brew. For 8 hours magic can't put you to sleep, and you can stay awake through a long rest and still gain its benefits. It does nothing for creatures that don't sleep.

magic-item:propeller-helm.description: While worn, use an action to cast levitate with no components; the propeller whirs loudly until the spell ends. Each time the spell ends, there is a 50 percent chance the helm turns nonmagical.

magic-item:shield-of-the-uven-rune.description: An ancient white dragon scale bearing the uven (enemy) rune, recognizable with a DC 20 Intelligence (History) check. While holding it you are immune to cold; right after a melee hit on you, use your reaction to deal 3d6 necrotic to the attacker; and once per short or long rest you can cast bane (DC 17) from it, lasting 1 minute without concentration. Tracing the rune onto a nonmagical weapon over 8 hours (both within 5 ft.) destroys the shield and makes the weapon a rare +1 weapon requiring attunement, rising to +3 against one creature type you choose: aberrations, celestials, constructs, dragons, elementals, fey, fiends, giants, or undead.

magic-item:tearulai.description: A sentient neutral good sword of sharpness with an emerald blade and jeweled hilt, its powers dormant until it is pulled from Valdemar's skull. Hits on objects deal maximum weapon dice. On a natural 20 against a creature it deals 14 extra slashing; roll another d20, and on a 20 it severs a limb (or a chunk of a limbless body). A command word sheds bright light 10 ft. and dim light 10 ft. beyond until repeated or sheathed. An evil creature trying to attune takes 20 psychic. The blade can't be damaged or dulled, and it can't be teleported without its attuned wielder. It has 6 charges (regaining 1d4 + 2 at dawn) to cast fly (2), polymorph (3), or transport via plants (4) without material components. Int 17, Wis 12, Cha 20; hearing and truesight 120 ft.; telepathic with its wielder; speaks Common, Draconic, Elvish, and Sylvan; knows any gem's true value within 5 ft. Vain and beauty-loving, it craves finer gems and longs to return to the forests of Myth Drannor, trying to take over a wielder whose goals oppose that.

magic-item:charm-of-plant-command.description: A fist-sized bundle of dried stems bound in silver thread, worn on a thong. It has 3 charges, regaining all at dawn. As an action, spend 1 to cast speak with plants, also gaining advantage on Charisma checks to influence plants for the duration.

magic-item:cursed-luckstone.description: A cool gray-and-black river stone etched with an unknown sigil. Once per dawn while carrying it, gain advantage on one ability check. Curse: attuning curses you until remove curse or similar magic; you can't get rid of the stone (it teleports back to your pack), and after each use your next two ability checks have disadvantage.

magic-item:helm-of-underwater-action.description: While wearing this brass helmet you can breathe underwater and gain darkvision 60 ft. and a swim speed of 30 ft.

magic-item:pipe-of-remembrance.description: A long wooden pipe with a river-stone bowl. Once per dawn, its smoke lingers around you and after 10 minutes forms moving figures that replay your greatest deeds for 5 minutes before fading.

magic-item:pressure-capsule.description: A small capsule of beeswax, sand, and enchanted water plants. A creature that eats one ignores the effects of swimming deeper than 100 ft.

magic-item:sekolahian-worshiping-statuet.description: A 1-ft. sandstone shark with gaping jaws. When a Tiny sea creature comes within 1 inch of its mouth, the shark snaps to life and deals it 1 piercing, at most once per hour.

magic-item:amulet-of-the-black-skull.description: An obsidian screaming skull with ruby eyes and emerald teeth on an iron chain. It has 6 charges, regaining 1d6 at dawn. As an action, spend 1 to teleport with your gear to a familiar spot within 100 ft. on the same plane, sight not required; it ignores the Tomb of the Nine Gods' magic restrictions. A non-undead user makes a DC 16 Con save each time or arrives transformed, rolling percentile dice on the Black Skull Transformation table (in the adventure).

magic-item:bookmark.description: Artus Cimber's +3 dagger. With it drawn, use a bonus action to make its blue pommel gem shed bright light 20 ft. and dim light 20 ft. beyond (or go dark), or turn it into a north-pointing compass on your palm. Once per dawn each, cast dimension door from it, or compulsion (DC 15, range 90 ft., affecting only spiders that are beasts).

magic-item:ghost-lantern.description: A restless spirit is bound inside. Holding it, command the spirit as a bonus action to shed bright light 30 ft. and dim light 30 ft. beyond, or as an action send it out to act as mage hand until the spell ends. If you fall unconscious within 10 ft., it emerges, stabilizes you, and returns. The spirit can't be harmed, turned, or raised; dispel evil and good frees it to the afterlife and leaves the lantern nonmagical.

magic-item:mask-of-the-beast.description: A carved wooden beast mask with 3 charges, regaining all at dawn. While wearing it, spend 1 charge to cast animal friendship as an action.

magic-item:ring-of-winter.description: A frost-rimed gold band that sizes itself and numbs the hand until you attune. Sentient chaotic evil (Int 14, Wis 14, Cha 17; hearing and sight 60 ft.; communicates by emotion), it craves destruction and tries to dominate its wearer into reckless cruelty. Neither ring nor wearer can be targeted by divination or seen through scrying. You don't age while wearing it (age doesn't catch up later), though magical aging still affects you. Attuned, you are immune to cold and extreme cold. 12 charges, regaining all at dawn: 1 as an action to chill a 120-ft.-radius sphere within 300 ft. by 20 degrees per minute down to -30 F, icing surfaces, until you end it as an action; spells (DC 17): sleet storm (1), ice spike growth (1), Bigby's hand of ice dealing bludgeoning as a fist and immune to cold (2), cone of cold (2), ice storm (2), wall of ice (2), flesh to ice as flesh to stone (3), Otiluke's freezing sphere (3); or as an action create within 60 ft. a motionless ice object fitting a 10-ft. cube, hard as metal or stone (2), or an ice copy of a beast of CR 2 or lower (4) that is a construct vulnerable to fire, immune to cold and poison and to charmed, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, and poisoned, and obeys only you; either melts after 24 hours or at 0 HP, losing 5 (1d10) HP per minute in extreme heat. Rumors claim deeper powers for an evil master it can't break, such as freezing worlds or commanding white dragons and the ice primordial Cryonax. It resists all heat and is destroyed only on the finger of the Summer Queen.

magic-item:scorpion-armor.description: Plate made from giant scorpion chitin. While worn, you gain +5 to initiative unless incapacitated, and it imposes no disadvantage on Stealth or on saves against extreme heat. Curse: each time you don or doff it, make a DC 15 Con save, taking 100 (10d10 + 45) poison on a failure or half on a success. Only wish lifts the curse.

magic-item:staff-of-the-forgotten-one.attunementNote: by a sorcerer, warlock, or wizard
magic-item:staff-of-the-forgotten-one.description: A crooked bone staff topped by the skull of an archmage Acererak destroyed, marked with his death rune. While you carry it: double proficiency on Arcana and History checks; you can't be blinded, charmed, deafened, frightened, petrified, or stunned; undead of CR 2 or lower won't threaten or attack you unless harmed; and it works as a +3 quarterstaff dealing an extra 10 (3d6) necrotic. 7 charges, regaining 1d4 + 3 at dawn: as an action spend 1 to curse a creature within 60 ft. you can see (Con save against your spell DC), which can't regain HP and is vulnerable to necrotic until greater restoration, remove curse, or similar. Whenever anyone but Acererak spends charges, 50 percent chance the trapped archmage tries to possess the wielder (DC 20 Cha save or become a DM-controlled NPC that seeks to destroy the staff; dispel evil and good traps it again). Breaking it as an action unleashes a 30-ft.-radius blast: DC 18 Dex save, 132 (24d10) force, half on success, freeing the spirit. Thrown into a sphere of annihilation, staff, spirit, and sphere are all destroyed without exploding.

magic-item:yklwa-1.description: +1 to attack and damage rolls with this magic yklwa, the Chultan short spear: a simple melee weapon dealing 1d8 piercing, thrown at range 10/30 ft.

magic-item:yklwa-2.description: +2 to attack and damage rolls with this magic yklwa, the Chultan short spear: a simple melee weapon dealing 1d8 piercing, thrown at range 10/30 ft.

magic-item:yklwa-3.description: +3 to attack and damage rolls with this magic yklwa, the Chultan short spear: a simple melee weapon dealing 1d8 piercing, thrown at range 10/30 ft.

magic-item:blood-spear.description: The chieftain Kavan's blood-stained spear. When your melee attack with it drops a target to 0 HP, you gain 2d6 temporary HP. Anyone can wield it, but only the one Kavan chose gets +2 to attack and damage rolls with it.

magic-item:crusader-s-shortsword.attunementNote: by a lawful good creature (takes 1 minute)
magic-item:crusader-s-shortsword.description: A sentient lawful good +1 shortsword (Int 11, Wis 13, Cha 13; hearing and sight 120 ft.; communicates by emotion) devoted to fighting evil. It always sheds bright light 15 ft. and dim light 15 ft. beyond, which only destroying it puts out. Once per dawn, its attuned wielder can cast crusader's mantle from it.

magic-item:daern-s-instant-fortress.description: As an action, set down this 1-inch metal cube and speak its command word; it grows into a 20-ft.-square, 30-ft.-tall adamantine tower with arrow slits, a battlement, two floors joined by a ladder, and a roof trapdoor. Its door faces you, opens only at your command (a bonus action), and resists knock and similar magic. Creatures in the area make a DC 15 Dex save, taking 10d10 bludgeoning or half on success, and are pushed outside; unattended objects take the damage and are pushed. It can't be tipped over. The roof, door, and each wall have 100 HP, immunity to nonmagical non-siege weapons, and resistance to other damage; only wish repairs it, 50 HP to one part per casting. An action and the command word shrink it again, but only while it's empty.

magic-item:gulthias-staff.description: A spongy black staff cut from a Gulthias tree; beasts within 30 ft. grow uneasy. 10 charges, regaining 1d6 + 4 at dusk. It works as a magic quarterstaff, and on a hit you can spend 1 charge to heal HP equal to its damage, as blood oozes from it and you make a DC 12 Wis save or gain a short-term madness. While attuned, blights and other evil plants don't treat you as hostile unless you harm them. Breaking or burning it unleashes a scream heard 300 ft. away that kills every blight that hears it.

magic-item:holy-symbol-of-ravenkind.attunementNote: by a good-aligned cleric or paladin
magic-item:holy-symbol-of-ravenkind.description: A sunburst platinum amulet set with a large crystal, once carried by the vampire-hunting paladin Lugdana. 10 charges, regaining 1d6 + 4 at dawn. Hold Vampires (1 charge, action): vampires and vampire spawn within 30 ft. make a DC 15 Wis save or are paralyzed 1 minute, repeating the save each turn end. Turn Undead (3 charges): when presenting it with Turn Undead or Turn the Unholy, undead have disadvantage on their saves. Sunlight (5 charges, action): it sheds sunlight as bright light 30 ft. and dim light 30 ft. beyond for 10 minutes or until you end it.

magic-item:icon-of-ravenloft.description: A 10-lb., 12-inch silver statuette of a kneeling cleric, given to Strahd to consecrate his castle. Every creature within 30 ft. is under protection from evil and good against fiends and undead. Attuned, you can cast augury from it once per dawn without material components; use it as a holy symbol for Turn Undead or Turn the Unholy, raising the save DC by 2; and once per dawn, as an action while holding it, heal a creature you can see within 30 ft. for 3d8 + 3 HP (not undead, constructs, or fiends).

magic-item:saint-markovia-s-thighbone.description: The relic of a saint who wounded Strahd; it works as a mace of disruption. If it hits a vampire or vampire spawn during a battle, it crumbles to dust when that battle ends.

magic-item:shield-of-the-silver-dragon.description: A +2 shield bearing the silver dragon emblem of the Order of the Silver Dragon. It whispers warnings, giving you +2 to initiative while you aren't incapacitated.

magic-item:sunsword.description: The sentient platinum hilt of Sergei von Zarovich's crystal sword, its blade lost forever; it now works as a sun blade. Chaotic good (Int 11, Wis 17, Cha 16; hearing and sight 60 ft.; communicates by emotion). Its purpose is to destroy Strahd, out of revenge for its lost blade, and it secretly fears its own destruction.

magic-item:yester-hill-axe.description: A battleaxe carved with leaves and vines that weighs half as much as normal. It deals an extra 1d8 slashing to plants and plant creatures. In the hands of a non-good creature it sprouts thorns on each attack, dealing 1 magical piercing to the wielder afterward.

magic-item:balloon-pack.description: A backpack holding a bound air elemental spirit and a folded leather balloon. While worn, deploy it as an action to levitate yourself for 10 minutes without concentration, or as a reaction when falling to gain feather fall. When the spell ends, the spirit escapes and you sink gently up to 60 ft., falling if still aloft. It works again only after an hour recharging in an elemental air node.

magic-item:bottled-breath.description: A breath of elemental air. Inhale it and either exhale it for the effect of gust of wind, or hold it and need no air for 1 hour (ending early, as to speak, forfeits the gust).

magic-item:claws-of-the-umber-hulk.description: Heavy brown iron gauntlets shaped like umber hulk claws, reaching to the elbows. Wearing both, you gain a 20-ft. burrow speed and tunnel through solid rock at 1 ft. per round. Each claw is a proficient melee weapon dealing 1d8 slashing plus Strength. While wearing them, you can't handle objects or cast spells with somatic components.

magic-item:devastation-orb.description: A 12-inch, 10-lb. elemental bomb made in a 1-hour ritual at an elemental node with an elemental weapon and 2,000 gp of components; the node sets its element. It detonates 1d100 hours after creation with no outward sign (identify or divination reveals when); it has AC 10, 15 HP, immunity to poison and psychic, and explodes at 0 HP. A case inscribed with the opposing element holds it safely, though removed past its time it blows 1d6 rounds later. Its effect fills a 1-mile-radius sphere, then it is spent. Air: a 1-hour windstorm; creatures ending a turn exposed make a DC 18 Con save or take 1d4 bludgeoning, light structures and weak trees fall after 10 minutes, and strong wind rules apply. Earth: earthquake (DC 18) for 1 minute. Fire: a 24-hour extreme-heat wave with a 10 percent chance each hour of a spreading wildfire that deals 3d6 fire to creatures coming within 10 ft. Water: 24 hours of heavy rain; a substantial body of water floods after 2d10 hours, rising 10 ft. and surging outward 100 ft. per round, sweeping away Large or smaller creatures and light structures.

magic-item:drown.description: A barnacle-studded steel trident holding a spark of Olhydra; it floats, stays cool, and water never harms it. +1 to attack and damage, and hits deal an extra 1d8 cold. While you hold it, you speak Aquan, resist cold, and once per dawn can cast dominate monster (DC 17) on a water elemental. Once per dawn inside a water node, you can perform the Tears of Endless Anguish ritual to make a water devastation orb. Flaw while attuned: you demand the largest share of spoils and part with nothing; after 24 hours attuned, barnacles grow on your skin until greater restoration (not while attuned).

magic-item:ironfang.description: A rune-etched iron war pick holding a spark of Ogrémoch, immune to rust, acid, and corrosion. +2 to attack and damage, and hits deal an extra 1d8 thunder. While you hold it, you speak Terran, resist acid, have tremorsense 60 ft., sense (but can't pinpoint) precious metals and stones within 60 ft., and once per dawn can cast dominate monster (DC 17) on an earth elemental. 3 charges, regaining 1d3 at dawn: spend 1 as an action to cast 2nd-level shatter (DC 17). Once per dawn inside an earth node, you can perform the Rumbling ritual to make an earth devastation orb. Flaw while attuned: you love to break things and cause ruin.

magic-item:lost-crown-of-besilmer.description: An open-faced steel dwarven helm ringed by a gold circlet with seven spikes. While worn, you resist psychic damage and have advantage on saves against being charmed. 3 charges, regaining 1d3 at dawn: as a bonus action, spend 1 to inspire a creature within 60 ft. that can see or hear you, which can add a d6 to one ability check, attack roll, or save before the end of your next turn.

magic-item:orcsplitter.attunementNote: by a good-aligned dwarf, fighter, or paladin
magic-item:orcsplitter.description: King Torhild Flametongue's battered greataxe, its rune for orc split in two. While you hold it: +2 to attack and damage; a natural 20 against an orc forces a DC 17 Con save or it drops to 0 HP; orcs can't surprise you while you aren't incapacitated, and you sense orcs within 120 ft. not behind total cover (not where); and you and friends within 30 ft. can't be frightened while you aren't incapacitated. Sentient lawful good (Int 6, Wis 15, Cha 10; sight and hearing 120 ft. with darkvision), it speaks through emotion and the odd verse of old Dwarvish. Grim and unbending, it scorns cowardice and deceit, exists to defend dwarves, and urges you against giants, goblins, and above all orcs.

magic-item:seeker-dart.description: A dart etched with wind spirals. Whisper 'seek' and throw it at a creature within 120 ft. that you've seen before (sight not needed now); with a clear path, winds carry it instantly through 1-inch gaps and around corners. The target makes a DC 16 Dex save or takes 1d4 piercing and 3d4 lightning. Then, or if there's no path, it becomes an ordinary dart.

magic-item:storm-boomerang.description: A griffon-bone boomerang marked with the air sigil; a thrown ranged weapon (60/120 ft.) usable by anyone proficient with javelins. A hit deals 1d4 bludgeoning and 3d4 thunder, and the target makes a DC 10 Con save or is stunned until the end of its next turn; a miss returns it to your hand. After dealing thunder once, it loses the thunder and stun until it spends an hour in an elemental air node.

magic-item:tinderstrike.description: A keen flint dagger holding a spark of Imix; it throws sparks on solid hits, stays warm, and smolders 1d4 minutes after drawing blood. +2 to attack and damage, and hits deal an extra 2d6 fire. While you hold it, you speak Ignan, resist fire, and once per dawn can cast dominate monster (DC 17) on a fire elemental. Once per dawn inside a fire node, you can perform the Dance of the All-Consuming Fire ritual to make a fire devastation orb. Flaw while attuned: you act without thinking and take reckless risks.

magic-item:weird-tank.description: A ten-gallon glass-and-bronze tank on a leather harness, holding a water weird. While wearing it, open it as an action to release the weird, which acts right after you, stays bound to the tank, and obeys your telepathic commands (no action). You can close it as an action only after the weird retracts or dies. If the weird dies, the tank works again only after 24 hours in an elemental water node, which forms a new weird. The tank has AC 15, 50 HP, vulnerability to bludgeoning, and immunity to poison and psychic; destroying it kills the weird.

magic-item:windvane.description: A silver spear set with dark sapphires, light as a breeze, holding a spark of Yan-C-Bin. +2 to attack and damage, it has the finesse property, and hits deal an extra 1d6 lightning. While you hold it, you speak Auran, resist lightning, and once per dawn can cast dominate monster (DC 17) on an air elemental. Once per dawn inside an air node, you can perform the Song of the Four Winds ritual to make an air devastation orb. Flaw while attuned: you break vows and plans, caring nothing for duty or honor.

magic-item:wingwear.description: A snug, air-embroidered suit with gliding flaps. 3 charges: as a bonus action, spend 1 to gain a 30-ft. fly speed until you land. You lose 5 ft. of altitude at the end of each turn, or drop to the ground at once if you didn't fly 30 ft. horizontally that turn; landing ends it. It recharges fully after an hour in an elemental air node.

magic-item:bobbing-lily-pad.description: A 10-ft.-wide floating leaf vehicle whose tendrils carry it over land, across water (not under it), and through the air at walk, fly, and swim speeds of 20 ft., with hover, following your spoken directions while you ride. It carries 300 lb. freely, or up to double that at half speed.

magic-item:chromatic-rose.description: A magic rose in one of five colors, each tied to a damage type (acid, cold, fire, lightning, or poison) and showing a harmless visual effect when held. Held by the stem, it gives you resistance to its type; if a single source would still deal you more than 10 of that type, the rose disintegrates and you take none. As an action, blow its petals into a 20-ft. cone of its element: DC 15 Con save, 3d10 of that type, half on success, destroying the rose.

magic-item:dust-of-corrosion.description: One packet of ground rust monster antennae. As an action, throw it to fill a 10-ft. cube from you: nonmagical ferrous metal there rusts instantly to useless dust, and creatures made wholly or partly of ferrous metal make a DC 13 Con save, 4d8 necrotic, half on success.

magic-item:eldritch-staff.description: A +1 quarterstaff with 10 charges, regaining 1d6 + 4 at dawn; spending the last, roll a d20, and on a 1 it bursts harmlessly and is destroyed. On a melee hit you can spend up to 3 charges for an extra 1d8 lightning each. When you take damage while holding it, use your reaction and 3 charges to turn invisible and teleport with your gear up to 60 ft. to a space you can see, staying invisible until your next turn starts or you attack, cast a spell, or deal damage.

magic-item:iggwilv-s-cauldron.description: An 80-lb., 100-gallon cauldron on eight clawed feet that only Iggwilv or Baba Yaga can switch (with an action and a touch) between a gold form, embossed with bare trees, leaves, and brooms, and an iron form, embossed with eight each of bats, toads, cats, lizards, and snakes. A humanoid attuning makes a DC 15 Con save or is aged to frailty (half speed, sight and hearing limited to 30 ft., disadvantage on checks, attacks, and saves, and death of old age in 3d8 days), reversible only by wish or divine intervention; a hag coven of three can attune together until it disbands. It has one minor beneficial and one minor detrimental random property. Gold: stirred water becomes hot stew feeding four per gallon; once per dawn, wine stirred 10 minutes becomes an elixir giving four per gallon 10 temporary HP (vanishing after an hour); filled with 90 gallons of water and 10 of wine, it focuses a scrying that the target automatically fails, even across planes, consuming the liquid; once per dawn, a broom dipped in it becomes a broom of flying for 3 days. Iron: once per dawn, scream into it as an action to release an obedient swarm of bats for 1 minute, acting after you; once per dawn, a gallon or more of blood stirred 1 minute puts humanoids within 100 ft. per gallon to sleep for 1 hour (not attuned or charm-immune creatures), waking on damage or a shake; once per 8 days, a branch tipped with a dead frog or toad and dipped in water becomes a wand of polymorph with 3 charges that crumbles when emptied; touching it with a unicorn horn for 1 minute while reciting the poem The Witch Queen's Cauldron freezes every unattuned creature within 1,000 ft. in time (helpless, unaware, untouchable, and unaffected by magic) until the ritual is repeated, the cauldron is destroyed or leaves the plane, or a frozen creature meets an antimagic field or a unicorn horn. It is a Medium object (AC 19, 80 HP) harmed only by a flame tongue or frost brand; at 0 HP it shatters into eight pieces, ending its effects and stripping every hag coven in the multiverse of Shared Spellcasting until a wish reassembles the pieces within 5 ft. of one another.

magic-item:ornithopter-of-flying.description: An 8-ft.-long, 25-lb. flying contraption with a 14-ft. wingspan. It carries a rider of up to 300 lb. (with gear) at a fly speed of 30 ft. by spoken directions, but can't hover. If it loses its rider while aloft, it falls and can't fly again for 1d6 + 4 days.

magic-item:pixie-dust.description: One packet. As an action, sprinkle it on yourself or a creature you can see within 5 ft. to grant a 30-ft. fly speed with hover for 1 minute; if aloft when it ends, the creature floats safely to the ground.

magic-item:potion-of-advantage.description: A sparkling golden mist that pours like water. After drinking it, you have advantage on one ability check, attack roll, or save of your choice within the next hour.

magic-item:scissors-of-shadow-snipping.attunementNote: by a fey or a spellcaster
magic-item:scissors-of-shadow-snipping.description: Iron shears. Once per dawn, as an action, snip away the shadow of a humanoid you can see within 5 ft. (an unwilling target keeps it with a DC 15 Cha save). The shadow stays rooted until you use a bonus action, while you can see it, either to steer it up to 30 ft. across any solid or liquid surface (harmless, unharmable, invisible in darkness, silent, needing nothing) or to release it, after which it acts on its own as a fey shadow whose Strength Drain knocks creatures unconscious at 0 Strength rather than killing them (recovering after a rest). A shadowless creature is cursed until a curse-ending spell or the shadow's destruction returns its shadow.

magic-item:snicker-snack.description: A +3 vorpal greatsword that ignores resistance to slashing. On a natural 20 against a creature with a head, it lops one off, killing it if it can't live without it; creatures immune to slashing, headless, with legendary actions, or too big instead take an extra 6d8 slashing. While attuned you're proficient with greatswords and can use Charisma for its attack and damage rolls. Sentient chaotic good (Int 9, Wis 14, Cha 18; hearing and darkvision 120 ft.; speaks, reads, and understands Common in a silvery voice), it craves slaying evil dragons. Fickle, it ends attunement after you miss three times in a row; after each long rest you can win it back with a contested Charisma check, and in no other way.

magic-item:steel.description: A +2 longsword. Once per dawn, as an action, cast revivify from it by touching the target with the blade. Sentient lawful good (Int 8, Wis 11, Cha 15; sight and hearing 60 ft.; speaks, reads, and understands Common and Draconic), it frets over your welfare and hates backing down from a fight.

magic-item:witchlight-vane.attunementNote: by Mister Light or his chosen successor
magic-item:witchlight-vane.description: A 3-lb. rod set with red glass and topped with butterfly wings. Attuned, it is a +3 mace dealing an extra 1d8 radiant. Within the Witchlight Carnival it senses the mood of every creature of Int 4 or higher; as an action you can pinpoint the happiest, and its wings turn clockwise when spirits are high and counterclockwise when they're low. Sentient chaotic good (Int 11, Wis 14, Cha 14; sight and hearing 30 ft.; communicates by emotion), it wants everyone at the carnival enjoying themselves. Its holder is vulnerable to lightning; its attuned bearer can't be blinded, deafened, petrified, or stunned and can cast dancing lights, polymorph, or ray of frost as an action without components using Charisma (after each polymorph roll a d8; on a 3 or 8, no more polymorph until dawn).

magic-item:witchlight-watch.attunementNote: by Mister Witch or his chosen successor
magic-item:witchlight-watch.description: A glowing gold pocket watch on a chain, ticking only for its holder, whose face shows the carnival ringed by a tiny henge whose moving shadows mark the time. As an action, its attuned owner can start packing up or setting up the whole Witchlight Carnival on the same plane; over 1 hour every carnival object moves itself into place, creatures are unaffected, the process can't be stopped, and the property is then unusable for 8 hours. The attuned bearer can cast fire bolt, invisibility, or message as an action without components using Intelligence (after each invisibility roll a d8; on a 3 or 8, no more invisibility until dawn), gains 30 lb. while attuned, and must eat and drink eight times the normal amount each day.

magic-item:woodcutter-s-axe.description: A +1 greataxe that deals an extra 2d6 slashing on hits against plants, plant creatures, and unattended wooden objects.

magic-item:cracked-driftglobe.description: A 1-lb. sphere of thick, cracked glass. Within 60 ft. of it, speak its command word to make it shed light as the light spell.

magic-item:gloves-of-soul-catching.description: While worn, your Constitution is 20 (no effect if already 20 or higher). After a successful unarmed strike, you can deal an extra 2d10 force and either regain HP equal to that force damage or gain advantage on one attack roll, ability check, or save before the end of your next turn.

magic-item:iron-bands-of-bilarro.description: A rusty 3-inch, 1-lb. iron ball. Once per dawn, as an action, speak its command word and hurl it at a Huge or smaller creature you can see within 60 ft., making a ranged attack with Dex plus proficiency. On a hit, it unfolds into bands that restrain the target until you speak the word again as a bonus action; a miss or release returns it to a ball. Any creature can use an action and a DC 20 Strength check to snap the bands, destroying them; a failure bars that creature from trying again for 24 hours.

magic-item:nether-scroll-of-azumar.description: A scroll that isn't used up. After 30 days of study (8 hours a day), make a DC 25 Intelligence (Arcana) check; failure deals 16d10 psychic and requires another 30 days before retrying. On success your Intelligence rises by 2 (max 22, once only), you gain advantage on saves against spells and magical effects, and a stone golem appears within 60 ft. as your ally, crumbling to dust if you die.

magic-item:orcus-figurine.description: A gray figurine of Orcus carved from an ogre's petrified heart, reeking of rot within 5 ft. It is a Tiny object (AC 17, 3 HP) immune to all damage but radiant, and detect evil and good reveals it as desecrated. While intact: undead within 30 ft. can't be turned, and dead creatures within 30 ft. can't be revived. Praying to Orcus while holding it for at least an hour has a 10 percent chance to summon a smoky avatar (wraith stats, chaotic evil) that attacks every non-undead it meets and vanishes after 1 hour or at 0 HP; once summoned, it can't be called again for 30 days.

magic-item:radiance.description: A golden hand mirror that serves as a wand. While held, +1 to spell attack rolls, and your spell attacks ignore half cover. It sheds dim light 5 ft. when surrounded by darkness. Once per dawn, as a bonus action, cast enhance ability on yourself only.

magic-item:serpent-scale-armor.description: Shimmering scale mail. You add your full Dexterity modifier to AC instead of a maximum of +2, and it imposes no disadvantage on Stealth.

magic-item:serpent-s-fang.description: A single-edged magic sword carved from a giant serpent's fang, its hilt reshaping to fit any hand. Hits deal an extra 1d10 poison.

magic-item:staff-of-fate.description: A clear crystal +3 quarterstaff with 6 charges. As a bonus action, spend 1 to give yourself or a creature you can see a d4 to add to one ability check, attack roll, damage roll, or save before your next turn starts (lost if unused). Spending the last charge, roll a d20: on 9 or lower it becomes a plain quarterstaff that shatters on its first damaging hit; on 10 or higher it regains 1d6 charges.

magic-item:stonky-s-ring.description: While worn, cast telekinesis at will, targeting only unattended objects. Its attuned wearer commands Stonky's constructs, though skitterwidgets ignore commands spoken from more than 30 ft. away.

magic-item:watchful-helm.description: While worn: +1 AC, awareness of your surroundings even while asleep, and advantage on sight-based Perception. Once per dawn, as a bonus action, cast see invisibility from it.

magic-item:battle-standard-of-infernal-p.description: A hell-forged infernal iron banner bearing a small sealed cage with an incapacitated quasit inside (cage AC 19, 10 HP, immune to all but force). If the quasit dies or escapes, it vanishes in smoke and a new one appears while the cage is intact. While you hold it, your weapon attacks and those of allies within 300 ft. count as magical for overcoming resistance and immunity.

magic-item:blade-of-avernus.description: Works as a vorpal sword, with 2 minor beneficial, 1 major beneficial, and 1 major detrimental random property (the last suppressed while an archdevil is attuned). Ruler of Avernus: as an action, point it at a devil you can see within 60 ft., which makes a DC 22 Cha save or is charmed for 1 hour and obeys you; ordering it toward what it sees as suicide ends the charm and the sword can't target that devil again. Infernal Recall: as an action, cast word of recall, delivering creatures within 30 ft. of the current ruler of Avernus, or to a sanctuary you choose if you rule it. Destroyed by casting it into the River Styx or melting it in the forge that made it.

magic-item:fane-eater.attunementNote: by an evil cleric or paladin
magic-item:fane-eater.description: Arkhan the Cruel's battleaxe. +3 to attack and damage; on a natural 20 against a creature, it takes an extra 2d8 necrotic and you regain that much HP.

magic-item:gauntlets-of-flaming-fury.description: Steel gauntlets. Wearing both, any nonmagical weapon you hold in them counts as magical. Once per dawn, as a bonus action, wreathe one or two held melee weapons in flame, each dealing an extra 1d6 fire on hits until you sheathe or let go of either.
