magic-item:hellfire-weapon.description: A weapon of infernal iron veined with hellfire that sheds dim light 5 ft. A humanoid killed by it has its soul drawn into the River Styx, where it is instantly reborn as a lemure.

magic-item:helm-of-devil-command.attunementNote: by a creature that speaks Infernal
magic-item:helm-of-devil-command.description: A bulky, eyeless pit fiend helm that resizes to fit; you see through it normally. You know the location and kind of every devil within 1,000 ft. and can speak telepathically to one or broadcast to all (they can't reply). 3 charges, all returning 24 hours after the last is spent: as an action, spend 1 to cast dominate monster (DC 21) on a devil only (a non-devil target wastes the charge), and a devil that sees you knows you tried. A non-devil using this in the Nine Hells has a 20 percent chance of drawing a narzugon on a nightmare within 1d4 hours, intent on reclaiming the helm for its master.

magic-item:infernal-puzzle-box.description: A 3-lb., 5- to 6-inch airtight cube of infernal iron, bone, or horn used to hold diabolic contracts. An object placed inside is sealed in; no magic can open the box, and it becomes immune to damage. Each opens by its own mundane trick, which a creature that knows it can perform as an action. Studying it for an hour allows a DC 30 Intelligence (Investigation) check to learn the trick; failing by 5 or more forces a DC 18 Wis save, 42 (12d6) psychic, half on success.

magic-item:infernal-tack.description: A narzugon's full nightmare harness: bridle, bit, reins, saddle, stirrups, and spurs. A nightmare wearing it serves the spur-wearer until that wearer dies or the tack is removed. As an action, clash the spurs or scrape them through blood to call it; it arrives within 20 ft. at the start of your next turn, acts on your initiative as your ally, and stays 1 day, until either of you dies, or until you dismiss it as an action. If it dies, it re-forms in the Nine Hells in 24 hours and can be called again. A nightmare must first be subdued to be harnessed.

magic-item:matalotok.description: The Frost Father, forged by the frost giant god Thrym and favored by Kostchtchie; icy and wreathed in mist. While you hold it you are immune to cold, and whenever it damages a creature, it releases a 30-ft.-radius burst dealing 10 (3d6) cold to each creature there.

magic-item:obsidian-flint-dragon-plate.description: Plate armor granting +2 AC, resistance to poison, and advantage on checks and saves to avoid or escape being grappled.

magic-item:shield-of-the-hidden-lord.description: A celestial shield, now twisted into a shifting fiendish face, that imprisons the pit fiend Gargauth. While holding it you gain +2 AC and resistance to fire. While Gargauth is inside it is sentient (Int 22, Wis 18, Cha 24; hearing and truesight 120 ft.; speaks Common and Infernal in a hollow whisper; telepathic within 120 ft.). 3 charges, regaining all at dawn: as an action spend 1 for fireball or 2 for wall of fire lasting 1 minute without concentration (DC 21). Once per dawn, on its own choice during your turn, it radiates dread for 1 minute: hostile creatures starting their turn within 20 ft. make a DC 18 Wis save or are frightened until their next turn, immune for 24 hours on success. Calling itself the Hidden Lord, Gargauth hints it is a trapped angel, steers its bearer toward cruelty and domination, and wrongly believes it can escape in the Nine Hells. Dispel evil and good has a 1 percent chance to free it (certain if cast by a solar, planetar, or archdevil), or a god can free it by touch and name.

magic-item:smokepowder.description: A magical explosive for firearms, kept in waterproof packets (five shots) or airtight kegs (five hundred). Set alight, dropped, or handled roughly, it explodes, dealing fire to everything within 20 ft.: 1d6 for a packet, 9d6 for a keg, halved with a DC 12 Dex save. Dispel magic renders it permanently inert.

magic-item:soul-coin.description: A 5-inch, third-of-a-pound infernal iron coin inscribed in Infernal that binds one soul, which you can feel raging or despairing. Evil creatures can carry any number; a non-evil creature carrying more than its Constitution modifier has disadvantage on attack rolls, ability checks, and saves. 3 charges: as an action, spend 1 to drain 1d10 temporary HP from the soul, or to ask it a question it must answer truthfully in a sentence or two from what it knew in life. A curse-removing spell or spending the last charge frees the soul and rusts the coin away, as does destroying it (AC 19, 1 HP per remaining charge, harmed only by a hellfire weapon or an infernal war machine's furnace). Freed souls go to their god's realm or alignment plane; lawful evil ones usually rise from the Styx as lemures. Freeing a soul is a good act. They are the currency of the Nine Hells, minted by Mammon on Minauros.

magic-item:sword-of-zariel.attunementNote: by a creature the sword deems worthy
magic-item:sword-of-zariel.description: The fallen Zariel's celestial-steel longsword, glowing faintly and humming; it seeks a brave, heroic wielder and allows attunement immediately. Your first attunement permanently transforms you into an idealized, heavenly self (no magic reverses it): your alignment becomes lawful good, you speak, read, and write Celestial, resist necrotic and radiant, your Charisma becomes 20 (if lower), you grow feathered wings (fly 90 ft., hover), you gain truesight 60 ft., and you take new personality traits rolled on its tables. It sheds bright light 5 ft. and dim light 5 ft. beyond (15 and 15 as a bonus action, or back); fiends have disadvantage on attacks within its bright light. It has 2 minor beneficial random properties and deals an extra 9 (2d8) radiant, or 16 (3d10) two-handed, and an evil creature damaged by it makes a DC 17 Con save or is blinded until the end of its next turn. Sentient lawful good (Int 10, Wis 20, Cha 18; sight and hearing 30 ft.; communicates by emotion); while held, advantage on Insight checks. Zariel can destroy it by grasping it, and it is destroyed if used to shatter the Companion unless wielded by an angel of CR 15+ or a good cleric or paladin of 10th level or higher; if Zariel dies in the Nine Hells, it becomes as breakable as any longsword.

magic-item:black-dragon-mask.description: A glossy ebony mask with horns and a skull-like look that reshapes to fit its wearer. While worn and attuned: resistance to acid (immunity if you already resist it; if already immune, acid damage instead heals you for half of it); unarmored, add your Charisma bonus to AC; a breath weapon that needs a rest to recharge gains recharge 6; darkvision 60 ft. (or +60 ft. if you have it) and, once per day, blindsight 30 ft. for 5 minutes; you speak and understand Draconic and have advantage on Charisma checks against black dragons; and once per day you can turn a failed save into a success. You can also breathe underwater.

magic-item:blue-dragon-mask.description: A glossy azure mask ringed with spikes and crowned by a ridged horn that reshapes to fit its wearer. While worn and attuned: resistance to lightning (immunity if you already resist it; if already immune, lightning damage instead heals you for half of it); unarmored, add your Charisma bonus to AC; a breath weapon that needs a rest to recharge gains recharge 6; darkvision 60 ft. (or +60 ft. if you have it) and, once per day, blindsight 30 ft. for 5 minutes; you speak and understand Draconic and have advantage on Charisma checks against blue dragons; and once per day you can turn a failed save into a success. Creatures you deal lightning damage to can't take reactions until their next turn.

magic-item:green-dragon-mask.description: A mottled green mask with a frilled crest and spiked jaw plates that reshapes to fit its wearer. While worn and attuned: resistance to poison (immunity if you already resist it; if already immune, poison damage instead heals you for half of it); unarmored, add your Charisma bonus to AC; a breath weapon that needs a rest to recharge gains recharge 6; darkvision 60 ft. (or +60 ft. if you have it) and, once per day, blindsight 30 ft. for 5 minutes; you speak and understand Draconic and have advantage on Charisma checks against green dragons; and once per day you can turn a failed save into a success. You can also breathe underwater.

magic-item:red-dragon-mask.description: A glossy crimson mask with swept-back horns and spiked cheek ridges that reshapes to fit its wearer. While worn and attuned: resistance to fire (immunity if you already resist it; if already immune, fire damage instead heals you for half of it); unarmored, add your Charisma bonus to AC; a breath weapon that needs a rest to recharge gains recharge 6; darkvision 60 ft. (or +60 ft. if you have it) and, once per day, blindsight 30 ft. for 5 minutes; you speak and understand Draconic and have advantage on Charisma checks against red dragons; and once per day you can turn a failed save into a success. Creatures and flammable objects you deal fire damage to catch fire, taking 1d6 fire at the start of each of their turns until someone in reach uses an action to put it out.

magic-item:white-dragon-mask.description: A gleaming white mask touched with pale blue under a spined crest that reshapes to fit its wearer. While worn and attuned: resistance to cold (immunity if you already resist it; if already immune, cold damage instead heals you for half of it); unarmored, add your Charisma bonus to AC; a breath weapon that needs a rest to recharge gains recharge 6; darkvision 60 ft. (or +60 ft. if you have it) and, once per day, blindsight 30 ft. for 5 minutes; you speak and understand Draconic and have advantage on Charisma checks against white dragons; and once per day you can turn a failed save into a success. While at half your HP maximum or lower, your melee attacks deal an extra 1d8 cold.

magic-item:draakhorn.description: The horn of Ephelomon, Tiamat's ancient red dragon consort, given to dragons for their war on the giants. So huge that two Medium creatures (or one Large or bigger) must hold it while a third sounds it, it makes the ground thrum; its low drone unsettles animals for miles and warns every dragon within 2,000 miles of great danger. Coded blasts once sent specific messages. Made to warn chromatic dragons, it is now misused by the Cult of the Dragon to summon them to the Well of Dragons.

magic-item:dragongleam.description: A spear holding 10 charges of daylight, meant for dim forest undergrowth, triggered by the Draconic command phrase 'Tiamat's eyes shine' inscribed on its crossguard.

magic-item:dragontooth-dagger.description: A dagger made from a dragon's fang with a leather-wrapped root for a handle and no crossguard. +1 to attack and damage, and hits deal an extra 1d6 acid; against enemies of the Cult of the Dragon the bonus becomes +2 and the acid 2d6.

magic-item:hazirawn.description: A sentient neutral evil greatsword that speaks Common and Netherese. Unattuned, it gives +1 to attack and damage and deals an extra 1d6 necrotic on hits. Attuned, the bonus is +2 and the necrotic 2d6, and a creature you hit can't regain HP for 1 minute, ending early on a DC 15 Con save at the end of each of its turns. Attuned and in hand, use an action to spend charges (4, regaining 1d4 at midnight) to cast detect magic (1), detect evil and good (1), or detect thoughts (2).

magic-item:insignia-of-claws.description: A jeweled Cult of the Dragon insignia that flares purple as combat begins. While worn, your unarmed strikes and natural weapons gain +1 to attack and damage rolls and count as magical.

magic-item:mask-of-the-dragon-queen.description: Bringing two or more dragon masks together fuses them into this crown of five roaring chromatic heads over a new draconic mask covering face, neck, and shoulders. While worn and attuned: resistance to acid, cold, fire, lightning, and poison (each becoming immunity if you already resist it, or healing you for half the damage if already immune); unarmored, add your Charisma bonus to AC; a breath weapon needing a rest gains recharge 6; darkvision 60 ft. (or +60 ft.) and once per day blindsight 30 ft. for 5 minutes; you speak Draconic; and five times per day you can turn a failed save into a success. You also gain the color-specific benefits of one mask of your choice, including advantage on Charisma checks against dragons of that color: Dragon Fire (red), Lingering Shock (blue), Water Breathing (black or green), or Winter's Fury (white).

magic-item:tankard-of-plenty.description: A golden stein decorated with dancing dwarves and grain. 3 charges, regaining all at dawn: grasp the handle and say 'Illefarn' to spend 1 and fill it with three pints of rich dwarven ale.

magic-item:wand-of-winter.description: An icicle-like wand with 7 charges, regaining 1d6 + 1 at dawn; spending the last, roll a d20, and on a 20 it melts away. As an action, cast from it even if you can't cast spells, with no components: ray of frost (free, or 1 charge at 5th level; +5 to hit), sleet storm (3 charges, DC 15), or ice storm (4 charges, DC 15).

magic-item:bracers-of-celerity.description: Lightweight bronze bracers lined with purple velvet. While wearing them, all your speeds increase by 10 feet, and you have advantage on saving throws to avoid or end the paralyzed or restrained condition on yourself.

magic-item:cape-of-enlargement.description: A grayish-purple cape with silver runes along its hem. It has 3 charges and regains 1d3 expended charges daily at dawn. As a bonus action, expend 1 charge to enlarge yourself for 10 minutes (or until you dismiss it as a bonus action): your size increases by one category (or as large as the space allows), you have advantage on Strength checks and saving throws, and your weapon and unarmed strike hits add your proficiency bonus to damage.

magic-item:dragonguard.description: You have a +1 bonus to AC while wearing this armor. Made for Tergon, a human hero of old Neverwinter, this breastplate bears a gold dragon motif and grants advantage on saving throws against the breath weapons of dragons.

magic-item:flayer-slayer.description: Carvings of decapitated mind flayers adorn the blade. You gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls with this greataxe. An aberration hit with it takes an extra 1d12 slashing damage, and if it is grappling a creature it must succeed on a DC 15 Strength saving throw or release each creature it is grappling.

magic-item:hew.description: A +1 battleaxe that deals maximum damage when its wielder attacks a plant creature or an object made of wood. Its creator used it for protection in the forest while cutting firewood.

magic-item:lightbringer.description: A +1 mace made for a cleric of Lathander, its solid brass head shaped like a sunburst. On command it glows as bright as a torch, and while glowing it deals an extra 1d6 radiant damage to undead.

magic-item:luminous-war-pick.description: The haft is inlaid with crushed pearlescent stones that give it a faint glow. You gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls with this war pick. As a bonus action you can cast daylight centered on a point on the pick; this can't be used again until the next dawn.

magic-item:mind-crystal.description:
A gemstone holding a single-use spell modification. When you cast a spell with a casting time of 1 action while holding it, you can modify the spell as described below; only one mind crystal per spell, and not alongside a Metamagic option. Afterward it becomes a nonmagical gem worth 50 gp.
Careful (Uncommon): up to three creatures affected by the spell automatically succeed on their saves against it.
Distant (Uncommon): a spell with a range of 5 feet or more (not self) gains 100 feet of range; a touch spell gets a range of 30 feet.
Empowered (Uncommon): reroll up to three damage dice, using the new rolls.
Extended (Uncommon): a spell lasting 1 minute or longer has its duration doubled, to a maximum of 24 hours.
Heightened (Rare): one creature affected by the spell has disadvantage on its first save against it.
Quickened (Rare): the casting time becomes 1 bonus action.
Subtle (Common): cast the spell without verbal or somatic components.

magic-item:mindblasting-cap.description: A soft violet cap stitched with the folds of a brain. As a bonus action while wearing it, project psychic energy in a 60-foot cone: each creature there makes a DC 15 Intelligence saving throw, taking 5d8 psychic damage and becoming stunned for 1 minute on a failure (repeating the save at the end of each of its turns), or half damage only on a success. Once used, this can't be used again until the next dawn.

magic-item:mindguard-crown.description: While you wear this adamantine crown, you have advantage on Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma saving throws, and resistance to psychic damage.

magic-item:mudslick-tower.description:
As an action, place this 1-inch granite sphere on the ground and speak its Terran command word ("petrification") to make it grow into a tower 20 feet on a side and 30 feet high, with arrow slits, a battlement, two floors joined by a ladder, and a roof trapdoor. Speak the word again while touching it to shrink it back; it must be empty. Muddy knobs constantly extrude and retract across its surface.
Each creature in the area where it appears makes a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw, taking 10d10 bludgeoning damage on a failure or half on a success, and is pushed to an unoccupied space next to the tower; unworn objects take the damage and are pushed automatically. When it expands it merges with any natural stone it touches.
Its small door faces you and opens only at your command (a bonus action), and is immune to knock and similar magic. The tower is adamantine and can't be tipped over. The roof, door, and each wall have 100 hit points, immunity to damage from nonmagical weapons other than siege weapons, and resistance to all other damage; while merged with natural stone it is immune to all damage. Only a wish spell can repair it, restoring 50 hit points to the roof, door, or one wall per casting.

magic-item:netherese-ring-of-protection.description: Made from a single piece of mystical green glass stronger than steel. You gain a +1 bonus to AC and saving throws while wearing it, plus a +4 bonus to saving throws or checks to avoid dropping or being disarmed of anything held in that hand.

magic-item:potion-of-psionic-fortitude.description: When you drink this black potion swirling with pink and purple flecks, you have advantage for 1 hour on saving throws to avoid or end the charmed or stunned condition on yourself.

magic-item:ring-of-the-orator.description: This ring has 6 charges and regains 1d6 expended charges daily at dawn. While wearing it, expend 1 charge to project your voice clearly to all creatures within 1 mile for 1 minute, regardless of noise; magical silence, 1 foot of stone, 1 inch of common metal, a thin sheet of lead, or 3 feet of wood blocks it. Creatures you can see understand you even if they don't know the language you speak.

magic-item:spider-staff.attunementNote: by a bard, sorcerer, warlock, or wizard
magic-item:spider-staff.description:
The top of this magic quarterstaff is shaped like a spider, and it deals an extra 1d6 poison damage on a hit when used to make a weapon attack.
Spells. The staff has 10 charges and regains 1d6 + 4 expended charges daily at dusk. While holding it, you can expend charges to cast spider climb (1 charge) or web (2 charges; save DC 15). If you expend the last charge, roll a d20; on a 1, the staff crumbles to dust.

magic-item:staff-of-defense.attunementNote: by a bard, sorcerer, warlock, or wizard
magic-item:staff-of-defense.description:
This slender, hollow 3-pound staff is made of glass yet is as strong as oak. While holding it, you have a +1 bonus to AC.
Spells. The staff has 10 charges and regains 1d6 + 4 expended charges daily at dawn. While holding it, you can expend charges to cast mage armor (1 charge) or shield (2 charges). If you expend the last charge, roll a d20; on a 1, the staff shatters.

magic-item:statuette-of-augury.description: A gold statuette of an elf worth 100 gp. A non-evil creature grasping it can ask a question and receive a telepathic answer as though it had cast augury. Each creature can activate it only once, ever.

magic-item:chime-of-exile.description: This silver chime is engraved with delicate sigils. While holding it, you can use an action to cast banishment (save DC 20); a target with 50 hit points or fewer automatically fails its save. Once used, it can't be used again until the next dawn.

magic-item:crown-of-lies.description:
Burnished, entwined metal rods form this crown, which the Dark Powers of the Domain of Dread gave to Kas so he would deliver Vecna to them. To attune, place it on your head and speak a true desire of your heart.
Random Properties. 1 minor beneficial, 1 major beneficial, and 1 minor detrimental property.
Perfect Disguise. As an action, transform to look and feel exactly like any creature you've seen at least once that is no more than one size smaller or larger than you, voice included. Your size and speed become the creature's; you otherwise keep your statistics, and the crown melds into you undetectably. The form lasts until you die, your attunement ends, or you use another action to change form. Interactions reveal no illusion, and you count as that creature for spells, traps, and defenses. Your lies always seem true to any magical or mundane detection, you receive sending spells meant for you or the disguised creature, and scrying aimed at that creature targets you. Only a wish spell reveals your true nature. In your true form, you can make the crown visible or not.
Destroying the Crown. If its wearer is killed by the creature it is disguised as, the crown disintegrates.

magic-item:rod-of-seven-parts.description:
The Wind Dukes of Aaqa wove their power into the Rod of Law to imprison the demon lord Miska the Wolf-Spider on Pandemonium; the rod shattered into seven pieces scattered across the multiverse.
Possessing the Broken Rod. It can't be attuned while broken. Holding a piece, you know the general location of the next consecutive piece. Pieces can be assembled or disassembled as an action, but a partial rod gains no other abilities. Each piece can cast its associated spell from the Rod Pieces table as an action, once per dawn.
Possessing the Whole Rod. Once all seven are reassembled, it can be attuned. It is a +3 quarterstaff. It has 7 charges and regains 1d4 + 3 daily at dawn: as an action, expend 1 charge to cast any spell from the Rod Pieces table, or cast detect evil and good at no cost. A non-lawful wielder finds their worldview shifting toward keeping a personal code.
Destroying the Rod. The assembled rod must be immersed in lava in the Abyss for fifty years. A single piece destroyed this way re-forms after one year and teleports to a random place in the multiverse.

magic-item:hammock-of-worlds.description: A colorful hammock woven with traditional Ataguan designs, usable only by a member of the Green Doctors. As an action, unfold it on a solid surface to open a two-way portal to the Ghost Orchid Tepui in the Feywild or to the Drought Elder in the Far Realm (your choice). Folding it up as an action closes the portal. Once it has opened a portal, it can't do so again for 1d8 hours.

magic-item:azuredge.description:
An intelligent battleaxe forged by the archwizard Ahghairon to defend Waterdeep: a rune-etched steel handle wrapped in blue dragon hide with a star sapphire pommel, its silver, electrum, and steel head shimmering deep blue.
You gain a +3 bonus to attack and damage rolls with it, and the shield spell offers no defense against it. A fiend or undead you hit takes an extra 2d6 radiant damage.
Hurling. It has 3 charges, regained daily at dawn. Expend 1 to throw it (range 60/180); hit or miss, it returns to your hand or feet at the end of the turn.
Illumination. As an action, make it glow blue (bright light 30 feet, dim light 30 more) or quench the glow.
Sentience. Lawful neutral, Int 12, Wis 15, Cha 15, with hearing and darkvision 120 feet. It speaks, reads, and understands Common, communicates telepathically with its wielder in a calm, delicate voice, and senses non-lawful creatures within 120 feet.
Personality. Sworn to protect Waterdeep, it patiently seeks a law-abiding wielder devoted to the city. If used against its will, it can become ten times heavier and adhere to any Medium or larger object or surface; only a wish spell can separate them without destroying one, though the axe can end this at any time.

magic-item:badge-of-the-watch.attunementNote: by someone designated by the Open Lord of Waterdeep
magic-item:badge-of-the-watch.description: This badge marks a captain of Waterdeep's City Watch and bears the city's emblem. While wearing it, you gain a +2 bonus to AC if you aren't using a shield. If it is more than 5 feet from you for over 1 minute, it vanishes and reappears within 5 feet of the Open Lord. While holding it, the Open Lord knows your location on the same plane while you remain attuned, and can end your attunement by touching it as an action.

magic-item:blackstaff.attunementNote: by a Blackstaff heir, who must be a wizard
magic-item:blackstaff.description:
The sentient, rune-carved symbol of office of the Blackstaff, Waterdeep's highest-ranking wizard. It has all the properties of a staff of power, plus the following.
Animate Walking Statues. Within the city, expend charges as an action to animate or deactivate one walking statue of Waterdeep per charge. Animated statues obey the telepathic commands of Khelben Arunsun's spirit within the staff, and go inanimate if deactivated or if the staff is broken.
Dispel Magic. Expend 1 charge as a bonus action to cast dispel magic on a creature, object, or effect you touch with the staff; against an unwilling creature or its possession, you must first hit it with a melee attack using the staff.
Drain Magic. When you hit a creature that uses spell slots with the staff, expend 1 charge as a bonus action to make it expend its highest-level slot.
Master of Enchantment. When you cast an enchantment spell of 1st level or higher while holding it, an Arcana check (DC 10 + spell level) lets you cast it without expending a slot.
Sentience. Neutral, Int 22, Wis 15, Cha 18, hearing and darkvision 120 feet, telepathy with its holder.
Personality. It holds the spirits of every previous Blackstaff, dominated by its devious creator Khelben. It protects Waterdeep and its Open Lord first and empowers its wielder second, and stops functioning for a Blackstaff who no longer serves its wishes until it finds a worthy heir.
Spirit Trap. A Blackstaff who dies is trapped in the staff and can't be raised. Destroying the staff frees the spirits, but Khelben can lodge in any remaining piece, which keeps Sentience and can remake the staff at will, trapping the spirits again.

magic-item:bracer-of-flying-daggers.description: This armband appears to have thin daggers strapped to it. As an action, pull up to two magic daggers from it and hurl them immediately, making a ranged attack with each. A dagger not hurled at once vanishes, and they vanish after they hit or miss. It never runs out.

magic-item:dragonstaff-of-ahghairon.description: While holding it, you have advantage on saving throws against the spells and breath weapons of dragons and the breath weapons of other dragon-type creatures. A dragon you touch with it can move through Waterdeep ignoring Ahghairon's dragonward until touched again or until a time you proclaim. It has 10 charges and regains 1d10 daily at dawn: expend 1 as an action to cast command, and a dragon targeted has disadvantage on the save.

magic-item:feather-of-diatryma-summoning.description: Speak the command word as an action and throw this bright plume into a Large unoccupied space on the ground within 5 feet, and it becomes a living diatryma (an axe beak whose beak deals piercing damage) for up to 6 hours. It reverts early at 0 hit points or when you touch it and speak the word again as an action, and then can't be used for 7 days. It is friendly, can be ridden, understands your languages, and obeys your spoken commands, defending itself if given none.

magic-item:knave-s-eye-patch.description: While wearing this eye patch, you have advantage on sight-based Perception checks, are unaffected by Sunlight Sensitivity, and are immune to magic that reads your thoughts or determines whether you are lying. Creatures can communicate telepathically with you only if you allow it.

magic-item:lord-s-ensemble.attunementNote: by a creature with a humanoid build
magic-item:lord-s-ensemble.description:
Worn by the Masked Lords of Waterdeep to make each indistinguishable from the others. The helm, amulet, and robe function as a single item, attuned together, but only within Waterdeep and its sewers.
Lord's Helm. A face-concealing bucket helm with eye screens. Your voice sounds genderless, and you are immune to magic that reads your thoughts, determines whether you are lying, or reveals your alignment or creature type. Telepathy reaches you only if you allow it.
Lord's Amulet. Bears the crest of Waterdeep and functions as an amulet of proof against detection and location.
Lord's Robe. Functions as a ring of free action and makes you appear a nondescript, androgynous humanoid 6 feet tall.

magic-item:paper-bird.description: Write a message of fifty words or fewer on this parchment and speak a creature's name, and it folds into a Tiny paper bird that flies to that recipient (turning to ash if they are on another plane). The bird is an object with 1 hit point, AC 13, flying speed 60 feet, Dex 16, 1 in all other abilities, and immunity to poison and psychic damage. It flies directly to within 5 feet of the recipient and becomes ordinary parchment that only they can unfold. It turns to ash if its hit points or speed drop to 0 or it is immobilized. Usually sold in boxes of 1d6 + 3 sheets.

magic-item:ring-of-truth-telling.description: While wearing this ring, you have advantage on Insight checks to determine whether someone is lying to you.

magic-item:stone-of-golorr.description:
A glossy greenish-gray palm-sized stone that is actually the aboleth Golorr, transformed into an object.
Random Properties. 1 minor beneficial and 1 minor detrimental property.
Legend Lore. It has 3 charges and regains 1d3 daily at dawn; expend 1 to cast legend lore, speaking directly with the aboleth, which can't lie but is often cryptic. It knows where Lord Neverember's secret vault lies, that three keys open it, and that the gold dragon Aurinax guards it.
Failed Memory. When your attunement ends, make a DC 16 Wisdom save or lose all memory of the stone and what it taught you. Remove curse has a 20 percent chance to restore it; greater restoration always does.
Sentience. Lawful evil, Int 18, Wis 15, Cha 18, hearing and darkvision 120 feet, telepathy with its attuned owner, and it learns the greatest desires of any creature communicating with it. It hungers for information, demands to be passed on often, and tries to take control of an owner who refuses.
Personality. Alien, domineering, and hungry for knowledge, it thinks itself an ageless god.
Destroying the Stone. It is immune to all damage and isn't a creature. Antipathy/sympathy cast on it, choosing antipathy against aberrations, turns it to mucus and releases Golorr within 30 feet, enraged and attacking all creatures it sees.

magic-item:demon-skin.description: This armor appears as a pot of bubbling black ichor. When you attune to it, the ichor contours to your skin and the pot vanishes; it can be worn under clothes and doesn't impede bodily functions. It can't be removed unless you choose to or die, at which point the ichor flows back into the reappearing pot. While wearing it, you have resistance to poison damage, and it doesn't impose disadvantage on Stealth checks.

magic-item:iggwilv-s-horn.description: As an action, blow this horn to cast arms of Hadar, fog cloud, gust of wind, or web from it (save DC 13). Each spell can't be cast from it again until the next dawn.

magic-item:potion-of-polychromy.description: Seven syrupy bands of brightly colored liquid. When you drink it, you and your gear take on a rainbow-hued appearance for 1 hour, during which you can use a bonus action to turn any colors you choose. Mimicking your surroundings makes your hues shift to match them, granting advantage on Stealth checks until you change colors or the potion ends.

magic-item:tasha-s-creeping-keelboat.description: A magic boat 10 feet wide and 30 feet long with four legs, giving it a walking and swimming speed of 20 feet (it can't go underwater). It moves at your spoken direction while you ride it, and creatures of your choice aboard gain a +1 bonus to AC. It carries 1,000 pounds without hindrance, or up to twice that at half speed.

magic-item:book-of-vile-darkness-variant.description:
A foul manuscript, most believe authored by Vecna, cataloging every vile idea and black magic he could find, with later additions stitched in by other evil writers. Plants wither near it, animals shun it, and even stone it rests on long enough crumbles.
An attuned creature must spend 80 hours studying it to gain its benefits and can then add evil lore to it. A non-evil creature that attunes makes a DC 17 Charisma save or becomes neutral evil. The book vanishes if you go 10 days without an evil act or willingly do good. If you die while attuned, a great evil claims your soul and you can't be restored to life while it is held.
Circle of Death. As an action, cast circle of death (DC 20); afterward roll a d6, and on 1-5 this can't be used again until dawn.
Condition Immunities. You can't be charmed or frightened.
Evil Presence. On attunement, its hostile spirit tries to possess you: on a failed DC 20 Charisma save you become an NPC under the DM's control until it is banished by dispel evil and good or similar magic.
Adjusted Ability Scores. After study, raise one score by 2 (max 24) and lower another by 2 (min 3), once.
Mark of Darkness. After study you gain a hideous disfigurement and advantage on Persuasion checks with evil creatures and Intimidation checks with non-evil ones.
Command Evil. While holding it, cast dominate monster (DC 18) on an evil target as an action, once per dawn.
Dark Lore. Double your proficiency bonus on Intelligence checks to recall lore about evil.
Dark Speech. As an action, recite Dark Speech: you take 1d12 psychic damage and each non-evil creature within 15 feet takes 3d6 psychic damage.
Destroying the Book. Torn pages eventually return. A solar tearing it in two destroys it for 1d100 years. A creature attuned for a century can find a hidden phrase that, spoken in Celestial, destroys both speaker and book, but it re-forms 1d10 x 100 years later while evil exists. Only the end of all evil destroys it forever.
Vile Lore. It may hold rituals of lichdom or becoming a death knight, the true names of fiends, and horrific spells of the DM's design.

magic-item:constantori-s-portrait.description:
A painting by Dkesii Kwan of the courtier Constantori, one of several magical paintings the late crime lord Daiyani Grysthorn gave to esteemed associates.
Sentience. Lawful evil, Int 14, Wis 12, Cha 8, hearing 120 feet and darkvision 60 feet (it can't see behind itself). It speaks Common, Draconic, and Elvish without moving its mouth and eagerly gathers secrets, names, events, and political talk it overhears.
Personality. Demanding, condescending, and vain; it hates being covered or hidden and loudly condemns anyone who tries to remove it from its gold-leaf frame.
Wealth of Information. It has observed decades of conversations, from criminal conspiracies to secret passwords; the DM decides what it knows. While attuned, you can contact it telepathically as an action over any distance on the same plane, maintained by concentration; it can't contact you.
Guardian Portrait. You can command it to guard its location against creatures you name as enemies. It has 3 charges, regained daily at dawn: when an enemy starts its turn in a space it can see, it expends 1 charge to cast magic missile (3 missiles) at it.
The painting is a Small object with AC 12, 20 hit points, and immunity to poison damage, weighing 15 pounds framed. Mending restores 2d6 hit points if it has at least 1.

magic-item:shard-of-xeluan.description:
A 1-foot obsidian shard veined with silver and gold.
Empowered Magic. While holding it, you can use it as a spellcasting focus, and it grants a +1 bonus to spell attack rolls.
Enhanced Strength. Your Strength increases by 4 (to a maximum of 22) while it is on your person.
Curse. Attuning extends its curse to you until remove curse or similar magic ends it or the shard is reattached to Xeluan's petrified heart. When you roll a 1 on an attack roll, ability check, or saving throw, you suffer a misfortune from the Shard Misfortunes table; only one at a time.

magic-item:shard-solitaire.description:
A gemstone holding an unstable extradimensional rift, its facets ribboned with shifting iridescent veins. Five types exist, each a different gemstone.
Rift Step. As a bonus action, teleport with your gear to an unoccupied space you can see within 30 feet. You can extend this by up to 30 feet more, but then make a DC 16 Constitution save or take 3d10 force damage after teleporting.
Spellcasting. It has 6 charges and regains 1d6 daily at dawn. As an action, expend charges to cast one of its spells (save DC 16, no material components); the spells common to all shards and those specific to each type are listed on the Shard Solitaire Types table.

magic-item:blade-of-the-medusa.description:
On a natural 20 with an attack using this magic sword, the creature also makes a DC 15 Constitution save. On a failure it is restrained and repeats the save at the end of each of its turns: three successes end the effect, three failures petrify it for 1 hour. Creatures immune to the weapon's damage type, without flesh bodies, or with legendary actions are immune.
Curse. Attuning extends the curse to you until remove curse or similar magic: you are unwilling to part with the weapon, and when you roll a 1 on an attack with it, you make a DC 15 Constitution save or are restrained and subject to the same petrification saves.

magic-item:deck-of-several-things.description:
A unique deck of twenty-two metal cards with raised-dot mosaics, kept in a leather pouch. Declare how many cards you will draw, then draw them, each within 1 hour of the last; undrawn cards fly out and take effect at once. Each drawn card fades and returns to the deck, except the Fool and the Jester. Effects last for the duration of the adventure unless noted.
Balance: your alignment flips. Comet: defeat the next hostile monster or group single-handedly to gain advantage on checks with one skill. Donjon: you are imprisoned in the Monastery of the Distressed Body (area M6), leaving your gear behind; draw no more. Euryale: -1 penalty on saving throws. The Fates: erase one event as if it never happened. Flames: the monastery's Grand Master (or Garret Levistusson's devil patron) becomes your enemy. Fool: lose proficiency or gain disadvantage with one skill; discard and draw again. Gem: a 1,000 gp hoard appears. Idiot: Intelligence drops by 1d4 + 1 (min 1); you may draw one extra card. Jester: gain a skill proficiency or draw two extra cards. Key: a common or uncommon weapon you are proficient with, or a spell scroll you can cast, appears. Knight: a hireling NPC joins you loyally under your control. Moon: cast any spell of 5th level or lower 1d3 times. Rogue: an NPC secretly becomes hostile to you (enchantment of 6th level or higher can end it). Ruin: all your nonmagical wealth is lost, recoverable in area M10 or O7. Skull: an avatar of death (bone naga statistics) attacks you alone; helpers summon their own, and those it kills can't be revived. Star: one ability score increases by 1 (max 24). Sun: gain a skill proficiency and a common or uncommon wondrous item. Talons: all your magic items are lost, recoverable in area M10 or O7. Throne: proficiency and double proficiency bonus in Persuasion, and the monastery's brains in jars regard you as its master. Vizier: once, ask a question in meditation and receive a truthful, wise answer. The Void: your soul is held in machinery (area M8 or O7) and your body is incapacitated; divination of 4th level or higher reveals where. Draw no more.

magic-item:galder-s-bubble-pipe.description: This finely carved pipe blows odorless bubbles instead of smoke. It has 3 charges, regained daily at dawn: cast fog cloud as an action (1 charge), cast misty step as a bonus action (2 charges), or summon a friendly steam mephit that obeys your verbal commands and acts on its own turn as an action (3 charges). The mephit vanishes after 1 minute or if it ends its turn more than 60 feet from the pipe.

magic-item:gambler-s-blade.description:
Choose a bonus of +1 to +3 each dawn; the sword gains that bonus to attack and damage rolls, and you take an equal penalty to death saving throws.
Curse. Attuning extends the curse to you until remove curse or similar magic: you are unwilling to part with the weapon.

magic-item:heward-s-hireling-armor.description:
Kwalish's research into the legendary mage Heward's designs. While wearing it you gain a +1 bonus to AC, and its animated straps let you draw or stow two one-handed weapons when you could normally draw or stow one.
It has six extradimensional pockets, each holding up to 20 pounds and 2 cubic feet; the armor always weighs 10 pounds. Retrieving an item takes an action, and the item you want is always on top. Placing the armor inside a bag of holding, Heward's handy haversack, or similar space destroys both and opens a one-way gate to the Astral Plane that pulls in every creature within 10 feet.

magic-item:ioun-stone-of-historical-know.description: When you toss this Ioun stone into the air as an action, it orbits your head at 1d3 feet. Another creature must use an action and hit AC 24 or succeed on a DC 24 Acrobatics check to grasp or net it; you can seize and stow it as an action. It has AC 24, 10 hit points, and resistance to all damage, and counts as a worn object while orbiting. Historical Knowledge. While this polished, steely sphere orbits your head, you gain proficiency in History, or a +1 bonus to History checks if already proficient.

magic-item:ioun-stone-of-language-knowle.description: When you toss this Ioun stone into the air as an action, it orbits your head at 1d3 feet. Another creature must use an action and hit AC 24 or succeed on a DC 24 Acrobatics check to grasp or net it; you can seize and stow it as an action. It has AC 24, 10 hit points, and resistance to all damage, and counts as a worn object while orbiting. Language Knowledge. While this pulsating red crystal orbits your head, you are fluent in one additional language of the DM's choice.

magic-item:ioun-stone-of-natural-knowled.description: When you toss this Ioun stone into the air as an action, it orbits your head at 1d3 feet. magic-item:ioun-stone-of-supreme-intelle.description: When you toss this Ioun stone into the air as an action, it orbits your head at 1d3 feet. While this faceted sphere orbits your head, you gain a +1 bonus to Intelligence checks.

magic-item:leather-golem-armor.description:
Strange rituals turned a flesh golem's body into this partly sentient leather armor. While wearing it you gain a +1 bonus to AC and to saving throws against spells and other magical effects, immunity to effects that would alter your form, and resistance to lightning damage; taking lightning damage grants you 5 temporary hit points.
Curse. Attuning extends the curse to you until remove curse or similar magic: you are unwilling to part with the armor. Taking fire damage gives you disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks until the end of your next turn. When a critical hit is scored against you, roll a d6; on a 6 you go berserk, attacking the nearest creature (or an object) each turn and unable to remove the armor, until you are incapacitated or calmed by magic such as calm emotions or a DC 15 Persuasion check.

magic-item:polymorph-blade.description:
On a natural 20 with an attack using this magic sword, the creature also makes a DC 15 Wisdom save or suffers the effects of polymorph, rolling a d20 on the blade's table for its new form. Creatures immune to the weapon's damage type, shapechangers, and those with legendary actions are immune.
Curse. Attuning extends the curse to you until remove curse or similar magic: you are unwilling to part with the weapon, and when you roll a 1 on an attack with it, you are polymorphed for 1 hour, rolling on the same table.

magic-item:powered-armor.description:
Unusual plate armor with articulated joints of oily black leather, a musclebound shape, a windowless glass-plated helm, and a crystal-tipped rod on the left gauntlet. While wearing it you have a +1 bonus to AC, your Strength is 18 (if lower), and you have advantage on death saving throws.
As a bonus action, spend 1 charge from its energy cell or 5 of your hit points to: gain 2d6 + 5 temporary hit points; gain a 15-foot flying speed for 1 minute; fire its laser (ranged weapon attack, +8 to hit, range 120 feet, 2d6 radiant damage); translate up to one thousand words of nonmagical writing you see over 1 minute; breathe normally in any environment for 1 hour; or gain darkvision 60 feet for 1 hour. It holds one cell at a time and is found with one holding 2d10 charges.
Options. The DM may give it automatic defenses (a shield guardian storing a 4th-level magic missile until reduced to 0 hit points), a will that possesses a new wearer on a failed DC 13 Charisma save (DC 20 daily save to break free), stasis that takes control of a wearer who drops to 0 hit points, or alternative power sources such as rechargeable cells or allies sacrificing hit points through a magical conduit.

magic-item:daoud-s-wondrous-lanthorn.description:
A four-faced lantern of fine yellow gold with faceted gemstone lenses and an unwavering amber flame, symbol of Daoud, a former priest of Istus who urged followers to shun wealth and seek out all fortunes, good and ill.
Random Properties. 2 minor beneficial, 1 major beneficial, and 1 minor detrimental property.
Precious Fuel. It burns only powdered gemstones placed in its base (up to 10,000 gp worth; found with 9,000 gp), consuming 100 gp each year. Fuel can be added during a short or long rest and can't be removed. Its flame can't be extinguished except by running out of fuel, and if it goes out, the attuned creature dies (except as described under Destroying the Lantern).
Revealing Light. Bright light 60 feet and dim light 60 more; invisible creatures and objects are visible in its bright light. While attuned, you can dim it to a 5-foot dim radius or restore it as a bonus action.
Lenses. Found with diamond, emerald, ruby, and sapphire lenses, which you can magically swap for other gems on the Lenses table during a short or long rest. As an action, burn fuel to cast a spell (save DC 20) through one or more current lenses as the Lenses table notes, targeting or originating within its bright light; if fuel runs short, the last is spent and the flame goes out.
Destroying the Lantern. The attuned creature must forsake all possessions but the lantern and common clothes, then willingly snuff the flame intending to destroy it. The gold corrodes, lenses and fuel turn to sand, and the creature is spared.

magic-item:heretic.description:
A blasphemous sword made by a cult to steal power from good-aligned gods. You gain a +3 bonus to attack and damage rolls with it. It has 6 charges and regains 1d4 + 1 daily at dawn.
Destroy Devotion. Once per turn on a hit, expend 1 charge: the target makes a DC 17 Constitution save (celestials with disadvantage) or is paralyzed until the start of your next turn.
Faith Hunter. As an action, expend charges to cast detect evil and good (1), fly (2), or true seeing (3).
Sentience. Chaotic evil, Int 17, Wis 17, Cha 15, hearing and darkvision 120 feet. It speaks, reads, and understands Common and Giant, understands your languages while attuned, and speaks telepathically in a soft, deep voice that rises to a furor near celestials or worshipers of good gods.
Personality. It craves the destruction of good gods and their followers, sneers condescendingly at priests and the pious, and erupts into frenzied violence when it finds its quarry.

magic-item:staff-of-ruling.description:
A red-and-gold staff carved with a spiraling serpent and coursing river. As an action, produce one of these effects; each can't be produced again until the next dawn.
Orb of Lightning. Create a Small orb of lightning within 60 feet, maintained by concentration; move it up to 20 feet as a bonus action. When concentration ends or a creature enters or starts its turn in its space, it detonates in a 20-foot radius: DC 15 Dexterity save, lightning damage equal to its accumulated total (base 6d6, growing by 2d6 at the end of each of your turns it hasn't detonated, to a maximum of 10d6), half on a success.
Staff to Snake. Throw the staff within 10 feet and it becomes a giant poisonous snake under your control, acting right after you; command it mentally within 60 feet unless incapacitated. Speaking the command word again as a bonus action, or reducing it to 0 hit points, returns it to staff form.
Thunderclap. Chosen creatures in a 30-foot radius around you make a DC 15 Constitution save or are deafened and frightened until the end of your next turn.

magic-item:harkon-s-bite.description:
A dire wolf tooth on a simple cord. While you wear it, you gain a +1 bonus to ability checks and saving throws.
Curse. Attuning curses you until Harkon Lukas removes the necklace or you are targeted by remove curse or similar magic; while cursed you can't remove it. Donning or removing it, attuned or not, afflicts you with werewolf lycanthropy until the dawn after the next full moon, recurring if you still wear it then.

magic-item:nepenthe.description:
You gain a +3 bonus to attack and damage rolls with this magic sword, and a fiend or undead you hit takes an extra 2d10 radiant damage. While you hold it drawn, you and friendly creatures within 10 feet (30 feet if you have 17 or more paladin levels) have advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
Sentience. Neutral evil, Int 10, Wis 8, Cha 18, hearing and darkvision 60 feet. It reads and understands Elvish, speaks only through its wielder's voice, and communicates telepathically with its wielder.
Personality. It has beheaded thousands of criminals, guilty or not, and can't tell the difference; each beheading feeds its hunger for more justice and blood. It is corrupt and irredeemable.

magic-item:nightbringer.description:
A heavy mace with a dark oak handle and a gold-trimmed head of blackened steel wreathed in inky energy in combat. You gain a +3 bonus to attack and damage rolls with it, and a target you hit takes an extra 4d4 radiant damage.
If you are evil and attuned, you also gain the following.
Blessing of the Dragon Queen. Immunity to the charmed and frightened conditions and to one damage type chosen on attunement: acid, cold, fire, lightning, or poison.
Eyes of Midnight. Darkvision 60 feet, or +60 feet if you already have it.
Midnight Shroud. It has 6 charges and regains 1d6 daily at dawn. When you hit a creature, expend 1 charge to force a DC 20 Constitution save or it is blinded until the start of your next turn.

magic-item:spell-gem-amber.attunementNote: by a spellcaster, only to imbue the gem
magic-item:spell-gem-amber.description:
This deep gnome gemstone stores up to a 4th-level spell, with save DC 15 and +9 to hit. You learn the stored spell when you learn its properties. While holding it, you can cast the spell as an action, without components or attunement, if you know the spell or it is on your class's list; the spell then leaves the gem. If it is above the level you can normally cast, make a spellcasting ability check (DC 10 + the spell's level) or the spell is lost.
While attuned to an empty gem, you can imbue it by casting a spell of its maximum level or lower with a casting time of 1 action or 1 minute or longer; consumed material components of abjuration spells cost half. It can't be imbued again until the next dawn.

magic-item:blood-of-the-lycanthrope-anti.description: A clear potion flecked with dark red, like clotted blood. Drinking it removes a curse of lycanthropy imposed by a lycanthrope's bite or similar effect.

magic-item:bridle-of-capturing.description: Holding one end, you can speak its command word as an action to lash the other end at a beast you can see within 20 feet. It makes a DC 17 Charisma save or the bridle ties around its neck and it falls under your command as if by dominate beast; you no longer need to hold the bridle. On a success it is immune until the next dawn. You can release a bound creature as a bonus action, and it makes a DC 17 Charisma check each dawn to break free.

magic-item:crown-of-the-forest.description: While wearing this crown, you automatically fail Investigation checks to see through illusions; touching an illusion still reveals it, but you feel so strongly it is real that you may not know which sense to trust. A DC 20 Nature or Perception check on close examination, or detect magic cast at 3rd level or higher, reveals its nature.

magic-item:ioun-stone-of-vitality.description:
When you toss this Ioun stone into the air as an action, it orbits your head at 1d3 feet. Another creature must use an action and hit AC 24 or succeed on a DC 24 Acrobatics check to grasp or net it; you can seize and stow it as an action. It has AC 24, 10 hit points, and resistance to all damage, and counts as a worn object while orbiting.
Vitality. While this luminous green-and-blue marbled sphere orbits your head, you gain a +1 bonus to death saving throws.

magic-item:mummy-rot-antidote.description: White dust swirls within this pale gray potion. Drinking it cures you of mummy rot.

magic-item:ruinblade.description:
Moghadam's sword, its hilt a jade devil face from which a blade that always looks rusted and ruined extends, reflecting its surroundings as if decayed. You gain a +2 bonus to attack and damage rolls with it, and undead you hit take an extra 1d8 force damage.
Blighted Ruin. Cast blight (DC 15) from it once per dawn.
Destructive Ruin. Cast disintegrate against a nonmagical object or creation of magical force, once every seven days.
Curse. Attuning extends the curse to you until remove curse or similar magic: you are unwilling to part with it, and it must help destroy 1,000 gp of materials every seven days or a conflict arises between you.
Sentience. Lawful evil, Int 15, Wis 8, Cha 16, hearing and darkvision 120 feet. It speaks, reads, and understands Common, understands your languages while attuned, and speaks telepathically in a rough, ruined echo.
Personality. Dolorous or frenetic by mood, happiest when destroying. It urges constant ruin so its owner can rebuild the world from a blank slate.

magic-item:the-infernal-machine-of-lum-t.description:
The command console of a planar craft that crashed in the Barrier Peaks, later used by Baron Lum to build his empire. It weighs some 5,500 pounds and is worked by sixty levers, forty dials, twenty switches, and jeweled components. Its effects use save DC 14 or your spell save DC, whichever is higher.
Silver Wire. It can produce an invisible, astral silver wire of virtually infinite length that tethers it to its attuned user, letting them use its powers centered on themselves and concentrate on its effects remotely. If the wire is cut (only by effects that can cut an astral projection's silver cord), the user dies instantly.
Summon Monster. 1/day each: conjure animals, summon lesser demons. 1/7 days each: conjure minor elementals, conjure woodland beings, summon greater demon. 1/month each: conjure elemental, conjure fey.
Wish. Once per month it can produce wish, side effects included; each use adds a cumulative 10 percent chance of malfunction, requiring seven days and 500 gp of repairs (which reset the chance to 10 percent).
Random Properties. At the end of each of the attuned user's long rests, it generates 1d4 + 1 beneficial and 1d4 + 1 detrimental properties from the Infernal Machine Properties table, lasting until the next long rest.
Destroying the Machine. It repairs anything short of catastrophic damage. Rumor holds that one control combination puts it in a repair mode that allows access and stops self-repair, and another teleports its critical parts away into space and time.

magic-item:thessaltoxin-antidote.description: This potion seems to change color and texture each time you look at it. Drinking it ends a polymorph effect imposed by thessaltoxin.

magic-item:winter-s-dark-bite.description: A greatsword of unknown black metal. It is a +1 greatsword, but works as a +3 greatsword against a thessalhydra, and as a +4 greatsword while in the Upside Down.

magic-item:bonecounter.description: A +2 mace. Whenever it is used to destroy an undead creature, a single silver piece appears in the wielder's pocket.

magic-item:gnomengarde-grenade.description: A small object of rune-covered, multicolored metal parts linked by gears and bands that shines with a rainbow in the light. Arm it by turning its key as a bonus action, then hurl it up to 120 feet as an action; it explodes at the end of your turn. Creatures within 60 feet make a DC 15 Dexterity save (28 (8d6) fire damage, half on success) and a DC 15 Constitution save (28 (8d6) thunder damage and stunned until the end of their next turn, or half and not stunned). The wielder also rolls three times on the wand of wonder table, rerolling duplicates: targeted effects hit all creatures in range, and effects on the wielder hit the creature nearest the grenade. It explodes at once if placed in an extradimensional space or if its holder teleports, affecting creatures within 30 feet of both ends.

magic-item:ruinstone.description: A fiery red crystal the size of a human palm. Once per day as a bonus action, a villain can activate it to undo one deed, such as rewinding an action to take it again or rerolling a failed saving throw. Each use erases someone the wielder knows: roll a d20, and on 5-20 one of their allies disintegrates, on 1-4 one of the player characters does. If a creature bound its soul to it in the "Thalivar's Beacon" quest, it explodes when used, and the bound creature disintegrates, returnable only by wish or similar magic.

magic-item:bottled-comet.description:
A glass orb holding a hovering, ignited delerium shard crackling with colored energy.
As an action you throw it up to 30 feet; it bursts in a 20-foot radius. Each creature there makes a DC 15 Constitution save or takes 8d6 necrotic and gains a level of contamination, and an arcane anomaly occurs at the point of impact.

magic-item:chancellor-s-crest.description:
While wearing this amulet you can read all writing and speak and understand any language. As an action you can cast detect thoughts, sending, or telepathic bond, each once per dawn, using Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma and your proficiency bonus for its attack bonus and save DC.
Seal of Drakkenheim. You can attune to only one Seal. Guardian constructs such as wall gargoyles and tower dragons won't attack you while you are attuned to one, unless you attack or cast a spell on that guardian (which then ignores the seal for 24 hours). As an action you can present the seal to rebuke them: make an opposed Charisma check against each such guardian within 30 feet that can see or hear you; each you beat can't move, act, or react for 1 minute or until damaged, and each that beats you is immune for 24 hours.

magic-item:comet-smasher.description: Its head is a massive crackling delerium crystal. Hits with it deal an extra 3d6 necrotic. When you roll a 20 on an attack with it, it unleashes an arcane anomaly; roll twice and choose either result.

magic-item:crown-of-westem-r.description:
Attuning requires a 1-hour ceremony with six other characters, each attuned to a different Seal of Drakkenheim.
The crown has 3 charges and regains one every ten years; as an action, expend 1 to cast wish. While you wear it, Minazorond, the tower dragons, and the wall gargoyles obey your spoken commands. Seated on the Throne of Drakkenheim, as an action you can telepathically command one dragon or twelve gargoyles within 100 miles of Castle Drakken and see and hear through one of them (with its special senses) until the start of your next turn, while deaf and blind to your own surroundings.
Seal of Drakkenheim. You can attune to only one Seal. Guardian constructs such as wall gargoyles and tower dragons won't attack you while you are attuned to one, unless you attack or cast a spell on that guardian (which then ignores the seal for 24 hours). As an action you can present the seal to rebuke them: make an opposed Charisma check against each such guardian within 30 feet that can see or hear you; each you beat can't move, act, or react for 1 minute or until damaged, and each that beats you is immune for 24 hours.

magic-item:delerium-crystal-focus.description: A refined delerium crystal in a glass orb. While holding it you gain +2 to spell attack rolls and spell save DC, and can use it as a spellcasting focus. Once per day, when you cast a spell of 5th level or lower, you can power it from the crystal without a spell slot, triggering a random arcane anomaly.

magic-item:delerium-forged-blade.description:
A glowing meteoric-iron blade infused with delerium dust, a glass-encased sliver set in its hilt.
You gain +2 to attack and damage rolls with it, can use your spellcasting ability modifier instead of Strength or Dexterity for its attack and damage rolls, and can use it as a spellcasting focus. When you roll a 20 to attack a humanoid with it, the target makes a DC 15 Constitution save or takes an extra 3d6 necrotic and gains a level of contamination.

magic-item:flame-lance.description:
A metal lance with a burning tip, fed by a hose from a tank worn on your back.
You gain +1 to attack and damage rolls with it. The tank has 5 charges; as an action you expend 1 or more to cast burning hands (save DC 15), at 1st level for 1 charge and one level higher per extra charge. Once per day, pouring in a vial of alchemist's fire restores all charges; otherwise they don't recover.

magic-item:hardened-delerium-tipped-arro.description: Ammunition tipped with refined delerium. A creature hit by it takes an extra 3d6 necrotic and makes a DC 15 Constitution save or gains a level of contamination. On a hit, the tip crumbles and the ammunition becomes nonmagical.

magic-item:hazewalker-plate.description: Hermetically sealed plate armor with a visored helmet. While worn with the visor closed, you are immune to disease and the poisoned condition, have advantage on saves against effects that cause contamination, have resistance to necrotic and poison damage, and don't need to breathe.

magic-item:helm-of-patron-saints.description:
While wearing it you see invisible creatures and objects within 60 feet, and gain +2 to spell attack rolls and spell save DC.
Relic of Saint Vitruvio. A character attuned to three Relics of Saint Vitruvio can cast heal three times per long rest and can attune to two extra magic items, provided both are also Relics.

magic-item:ignacious-the-sword-of-burnin.description:
A sacred silver blade trailing embers first kindled in the Temple of Lumen.
You gain +3 to attack and damage rolls with it. As a bonus action you speak its name to wreathe it in radiant flame (bright light 40 feet, dim light 40 more), dealing an extra 4d6 radiant on hits until you douse it as a bonus action or drop or sheathe it.
Sentience. Lawful good, Int 11, Wis 19, Cha 23, hearing and darkvision 120 feet; it speaks, reads, and understands Common, Celestial, and Draconic, communicates telepathically, and knows its wielder's thoughts. When drawn it casts zone of truth (save DC 20) centered on itself, maintaining concentration for you.
Personality. Zealously devoted to the Sacred Flame and indifferent to the Falling Fire schism, it seeks to expose deception, always knows when it hears a lie, and a lie spoken by its wielder immediately triggers a conflict.
Relic of Saint Vitruvio. A character attuned to three Relics of Saint Vitruvio can cast heal three times per long rest and can attune to two extra magic items, provided both are also Relics.

magic-item:inscrutable-staff.attunementNote: by a sorcerer, warlock, or wizard
magic-item:inscrutable-staff.description:
A magic quarterstaff granting +2 to attack and damage rolls, and +2 to spell attack rolls and spell save DC while held.
It has 20 charges, regaining 2d10 at dawn; when you spend the last, roll a d20: on a 1 it triggers a random arcane anomaly, on a 20 it regains 1d10 charges. As an action you can spend charges to cast, with your DC and ability: haste or slow (3), arcane eye or dimension door (4), arcane hand or wall of force (5), disintegrate (6), reverse gravity (7), or maze (8). Without charges you can cast detect magic, floating disk, mage armor, mending, message, or misty step.
Seal of Drakkenheim. You can attune to only one Seal. Guardian constructs such as wall gargoyles and tower dragons won't attack you while you are attuned to one, unless you attack or cast a spell on that guardian (which then ignores the seal for 24 hours). As an action you can present the seal to rebuke them: make an opposed Charisma check against each such guardian within 30 feet that can see or hear you; each you beat can't move, act, or react for 1 minute or until damaged, and each that beats you is immune for 24 hours.

magic-item:lord-commander-s-badge.description:
Once per dawn, as an action, you bellow a command audible within 300 feet; up to 12 allies you can see who hear it gain 20 temporary hit points and, while those last, advantage on attack rolls and saves.
Seal of Drakkenheim. You can attune to only one Seal. Guardian constructs such as wall gargoyles and tower dragons won't attack you while you are attuned to one, unless you attack or cast a spell on that guardian (which then ignores the seal for 24 hours). As an action you can present the seal to rebuke them: make an opposed Charisma check against each such guardian within 30 feet that can see or hear you; each you beat can't move, act, or react for 1 minute or until damaged, and each that beats you is immune for 24 hours.

magic-item:purging-rod.description: Once per day, as an action while holding it, you can cast purge contamination. Afterward roll a d20; on a 1 the rod melts into sludge.

magic-item:refined-delerium-dust.description: A pouch holding an ounce of purified, charged delerium dust. Consuming the full pouch as an action gives you advantage on spell attack rolls and on saves against spells for 1 minute, and you gain a level of contamination.

magic-item:saint-vitruvio-s-phylactery.attunementNote: by a bard, cleric, druid, or paladin
magic-item:saint-vitruvio-s-phylactery.description:
As an action you can cast bless, death ward, greater restoration, prayer of healing, or revivify from it, each once per dawn, using your spellcasting ability and save DC.
Seal of Drakkenheim. You can attune to only one Seal. Guardian constructs such as wall gargoyles and tower dragons won't attack you while you are attuned to one, unless you attack or cast a spell on that guardian (which then ignores the seal for 24 hours). As an action you can present the seal to rebuke them: make an opposed Charisma check against each such guardian within 30 feet that can see or hear you; each you beat can't move, act, or react for 1 minute or until damaged, and each that beats you is immune for 24 hours.
Relic of Saint Vitruvio. A character attuned to three Relics of Saint Vitruvio can cast heal three times per long rest and can attune to two extra magic items, provided both are also Relics.

magic-item:sceptre-of-saint-vitruvio.description:
A magic quarterstaff granting +2 to attack and damage rolls. It has 10 charges, regaining 1d6 + 4 at dawn; as an action you spend charges to cast, with your save DC: guiding bolt (1), flaming sphere (2), or flame strike (5).
Relic of Saint Vitruvio. A character attuned to three Relics of Saint Vitruvio can cast heal three times per long rest and can attune to two extra magic items, provided both are also Relics.

magic-item:skymetal-shield.description:
Hammered meteoric iron set with a delerium crystal.
When a melee or ranged attack hits you, you can use your reaction to absorb its residual energy (you still take the hit), giving the shield 1 charge (maximum 5; unused charges vanish at dawn). As an action you can release all charges: each creature within 10 feet makes a DC 15 Constitution save or takes 1d6 force per charge, is flung 10 feet, and is knocked prone.

magic-item:skymetal-staff.description: A refined meteoric-iron quarterstaff with a liquid delerium core. Once on your turn, when you hit a creature with a melee attack using it, the target makes a DC 13 Intelligence save or takes an extra 3d6 psychic, can't take reactions until the start of your next turn, and on its next turn can take only one of an action, a bonus action, or movement.

magic-item:spellpiercing-wand.description: You can use it as a spellcasting focus. Creatures saving against a spell cast through it can't benefit from advantage on the save.

magic-item:spymaster-s-signet.description:
While wearing it you can cast disguise self at will. Once per dawn, as an action, you and your gear turn invisible for 1 minute or until you become visible as a bonus action.
Seal of Drakkenheim. You can attune to only one Seal. Guardian constructs such as wall gargoyles and tower dragons won't attack you while you are attuned to one, unless you attack or cast a spell on that guardian (which then ignores the seal for 24 hours). As an action you can present the seal to rebuke them: make an opposed Charisma check against each such guardian within 30 feet that can see or hear you; each you beat can't move, act, or react for 1 minute or until damaged, and each that beats you is immune for 24 hours.

magic-item:staff-of-contaminated-power.attunementNote: by a sorcerer, warlock, or wizard
magic-item:staff-of-contaminated-power.description:
A magic quarterstaff granting +2 to attack and damage rolls.
It has 20 charges, regaining 1 for each hour it rests in the Deep Haze; touching a delerium crystal to it restores 2d8 + 4 as the crystal crumbles. Spending the last charge gives you 1d6 levels of contamination. As an action you can spend charges to cast, with your DC and ability and without gaining contamination: delerium orb (1), warp bolt (2), ride the rifts (3), delerium blast (4), conjure the deep haze (5), or ray of contamination (6).

magic-item:starcrossed-bow.description:
A bow or crossbow fitted with delerium shards and lenses that conjures its own projectiles.
You gain +2 to attack and damage rolls with it; it deals radiant instead of piercing damage and ignores the ammunition and loading properties. It has 3 charges, regained at dawn; when you hit with it, you can spend 1 to make the bolt burst, and the target and each creature within 10 feet make a DC 15 Constitution save or are blinded until the end of your next turn.

magic-item:steward-s-seal.description:
While wearing this badge you can cast mage hand, prestidigitation, purify food and drink, and unseen servant at will. As an action you can cast animate objects, create food and water, dispel magic, or telekinesis, each once per dawn, using Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma and your proficiency bonus for its attack bonus and save DC.
Seal of Drakkenheim. You can attune to only one Seal. Guardian constructs such as wall gargoyles and tower dragons won't attack you while you are attuned to one, unless you attack or cast a spell on that guardian (which then ignores the seal for 24 hours). As an action you can present the seal to rebuke them: make an opposed Charisma check against each such guardian within 30 feet that can see or hear you; each you beat can't move, act, or react for 1 minute or until damaged, and each that beats you is immune for 24 hours.

magic-item:the-shield-of-sacred-flame.description:
It has 3 charges, regained at dawn. When a spellcaster within 60 feet targets you with a spell or includes you in its area, you can spend 1 charge to cast counterspell as a reaction.
Relic of Saint Vitruvio. A character attuned to three Relics of Saint Vitruvio can cast heal three times per long rest and can attune to two extra magic items, provided both are also Relics.

magic-item:mind-blade.attunementNote: by a specific mind flayer or one of its thralls
magic-item:mind-blade.description: A sword turned into a mind blade by a mind flayer. For its one attuned wielder, it is a magic weapon dealing an extra 2d6 psychic on a hit; for anyone else it is an ordinary sword.

magic-item:mind-carapace-armor.description: Heavy armor altered by mind flayers. For its one attuned wearer (a specific mind flayer or thrall), it grants advantage on Intelligence, Wisdom and Charisma saves and immunity to being frightened; otherwise it is ordinary armor.

magic-item:mind-lash.description: In a mind flayer's hands, this magic whip deals an extra 2d4 psychic, and a creature taking that damage makes a DC 15 Wisdom save or has disadvantage on Intelligence, Wisdom and Charisma saves for 1 minute (repeat at end of each turn). Otherwise it is an ordinary whip.

magic-item:shield-of-far-sight.description: A shield bearing an implanted eye. While on the same plane, its mind flayer creator can see through the eye (darkvision 60 feet) and use Mind Blast as though standing behind it. If the shield is destroyed, the creator is blinded for 2d12 hours.

magic-item:greater-silver-sword.attunementNote: by a creature that has psionic ability
magic-item:greater-silver-sword.description: +3 to attack and damage rolls. While holding it you have advantage on Intelligence, Wisdom and Charisma saves, immunity to being charmed and resistance to psychic damage. A critical hit against a creature's astral body can sever its silver cord instead of dealing damage.

magic-item:helm-of-the-scavenger.description: A spelljamming helm. On a 1 to 100 ton vessel in space it maintains breathable 70-degree air and artificial gravity around the ship out to its beam length. While attuned and seated you can propel it through liquid at mph equal to your highest unexpended slot level (x10 through air or space), steer it clumsily, and see from any point aboard. While attuned you can't expend your own spell slots.

magic-item:bag-of-bounty.description: With the Mark of Hospitality, you can use an action to cast create food and water from the bag, up to three times per day; plain fare needs no check, finer food needs a Charisma check (cook's utensils proficiency applies), with failure producing a sour meal.

magic-item:band-of-loyalty.description: If you are reduced to 0 hit points while attuned, you die instantly.

magic-item:inquisitive-s-goggles.attunementNote: by a creature with the Mark of Finding
magic-item:inquisitive-s-goggles.description: You add your Intuition die to Wisdom (Insight) checks. Examining an object, a Wisdom (Perception) check (DC 13 + days since contact) identifies the species of the last living creature to touch it, and you can use Imprint Prey on that creature.

magic-item:revenant-double-bladed-scimit.description: Wielded two-handed, it has the finesse property and grants +1 AC. After attacking with it as part of the Attack action, you can make a bonus action melee attack with it for 1d4 slashing.

magic-item:rings-of-shared-suffering.description: Linked pair. With the Mark of Sentinel, a bonus action links you to the other ring's wearer at any range: they take half of any damage and you take the rest, until either ends it or removes a ring. You can attune to only one such ring.

magic-item:cartographer-s-map-case.description: Rank 3 franchise item. Once per long rest, an action and a DC 15 Wisdom (Perception) check produces a map of a shortcut that halves travel time (succeeding by 5 grants advantage on the next travel check in the area within the hour). Once every seven days, a DC 15 check finds a map tied to your mission showing terrain within a mile of a landmark.

magic-item:coin-of-decisionry.description: Rank 2 (common): flipped, it shows a random message; as a bonus action you can secretly choose the result when a creature within 10 feet flips it (DC 13 Insight to notice). Rank 3 (uncommon): once per day, flip twice while pondering a plan and a DC 15 Intelligence (Arcana) check tells which result applies better.

magic-item:documancy-satchel.description: Rank 2 (common): sends and receives documents with Head Office and produces standard contracts. Rank 3 (uncommon): one pouch is a bag of holding, and once per day it produces a spell scroll of comprehend languages lasting 10 minutes. Rank 4 (rare): an extradimensional humidor holds 30 documents or scrolls; storing one is an action, drawing one a bonus action.

magic-item:elder-cartographer-s-glossogr.description: Rank 4 franchise item. Advantage on Intelligence or Wisdom checks about geographical features or locations.

magic-item:failed-experiment-wand.description: 2 charges per day. As an action, expend 1 or more charges to cast, at random, a green fireball or blue lightning bolt (save DC 15) at 3rd level plus one level per extra charge. Expending the last charge, roll a d20; on a 1 it crumbles to ash.

magic-item:living-loot-satchel.description: Rank 2 (uncommon): a bag of holding linked to Head Office's vault; a DC 15 Sleight of Hand check as an action transfers franchise funds to it. Rank 3 (rare): also opens a permanent Leomund's secret chest, and as a bonus action with a DC 15 check it draws adventuring gear worth up to 15 gp (five attempts per day). Rank 4 (very rare): the chest holds as much as a portable hole, and That Thing You Need can produce items up to 250 gp.

magic-item:mithral-half-plate-1.description: +1 AC. Mithral removes the armor's Stealth disadvantage and Strength requirement.

magic-item:obviator-s-lenses.description: Rank 2 (uncommon): as a bonus action they function as eyes of minute seeing or eyes of the eagle, chosen until dawn. Rank 4 (rare): both at once, and once per day you gain advantage on a weapon attack, adding a weapon damage die if it hits.

magic-item:occultant-abacus.description: Rank 2 (uncommon): within 5 feet of a creature killed in the last 24 hours, cast augury once per day. Rank 3 (rare): a bead lets you grant advantage or impose disadvantage on a creature's check, attack or save as a reaction once per day. Rank 4 (very rare): another bead, once per day, grants a d10 to a creature when another rolls with disadvantage; and once per seven days a DC 15 Religion check reveals ways to mitigate consequences of a death.

magic-item:piercer.description: +1 to attack and damage rolls. While attuned you regain the maximum hit points from expended Hit Dice, but you must eat twice as much food each day (at least 2 pounds) to avoid exhaustion.

magic-item:portfolio-keeper.description: Rank 2 (uncommon): stores details and a sketch of everyone you meet, readable as a bonus action, and endless brochures.
