Rank 3 (rare): up to five handed-out business cards let recipients reach you as if by sending for seven days, and once every seven days you can send to a cardholder. Rank 4: handing over a card can cast charm person (DC 15), ending if the card is lost.

magic-item:sending-stone.description: An Acquisitions Incorporated stone with no partner stone: once per day, a DC 15 Intelligence (Arcana) check contacts Head Office or a known or nearest secretarian. Higher ranks add a DC 15 History check for three mission rumors, and later a sense of which are false.

magic-item:spyglass-of-clairvoyance.description: Once per day, as an action look at an obstruction within 1 mile and make a DC 15 Wisdom check with cartographer's tools to map the natural terrain within 3 miles of that point.

magic-item:travel-alchemical-kit.description: Miniature alchemist's supplies and poisoner's kit usable without drawing them; grants poisoner's kit proficiency. Finding it on a search takes a DC 20 Investigation or Insight check.

magic-item:vicious-rapier-1.description: +1 to attack and damage rolls; on a natural 20 the target takes an extra 7 damage of the weapon's type.

magic-item:voting-kit.description: Rank 4 item. As a bonus action, store or retrieve one proficient tool kit in its extradimensional space (DC 20 Investigation or Perception to find). Once per day it casts charm person (DC 15).

magic-item:whisper-jar.description: Rank 1 (common): records and plays back speech without limit. Rank 2 (uncommon): once per day, a DC 15 History check plays a recording on a chosen subject. Rank 3 (rare): once per day functions as a wand of enemy detection. Rank 4: once per day casts detect evil and good, detect magic, detect poison and disease, find traps, identify, or locate animals or plants.

magic-item:alchemy-jug-blue.description: A 12-pound ceramic jug. As an action name a liquid from its table, then uncork it to pour up to 2 gallons per minute, up to that liquid's daily maximum; it can't switch liquids until dawn.

magic-item:alchemy-jug-orange.description: A 12-pound ceramic jug. As an action name a liquid from its table, then uncork it to pour up to 2 gallons per minute, up to that liquid's daily maximum; it can't switch liquids until dawn.

magic-item:masque-charm.description: A silver pin. As an action cast disguise self (DC 13) once per sunset, lasting 1 hour, or 6 hours after which the charm becomes nonmagical; removing it ends the spell.

magic-item:murgaxor-s-orb.description: Sentient chaotic evil orb (Int 20, Wis 16, Cha 16; hearing and darkvision 30 feet; speaks Common and telepathy by touch) that can cast suggestion (DC 17) on you or anyone who touched it in 24 hours. Humanoids you touch while holding it make a DC 10 Wisdom save or are cursed; as an action the orb can make a cursed creature fall unconscious for 1 hour or see non-cursed creatures as monsters and attack them for 10 minutes, ending the curse after. Detect magic reveals the curse. The orb has AC 18, 20 hit points, immunity to necrotic, poison and psychic and resistance to other damage.

magic-item:earring-of-message.description: 5 charges, regaining 1d4 + 1 at dawn. As an action, expend 1 to cast message.

magic-item:jewel-of-three-prayers.description: Vestige of Divergence. Dormant: +1 AC, sheds light on command, and 3 charges (regained at dawn) to cast invisibility. Awakened: +2 AC, 5 charges; expend 1 to end grappled, paralyzed or restrained on yourself, or as a reaction let a creature within 60 feet reroll a failed save. Exalted: +3 AC, 7 charges; you and allies within 30 feet breathe water and swim at walking speed, and as a bonus action a charge teleports you or a willing creature 15 feet in a radiant flash (DC 18 Constitution save for creatures within 5 feet of arrival: 4d10 radiant and blinded, half on success).

magic-item:medal-of-muscle.description: Squeezing it as an action grants advantage on Strength checks and saves for 1 hour, then it becomes nonmagical.

magic-item:medal-of-the-conch.description: Rubbing it as an action grants a swimming speed equal to your walking speed for 1 hour, then it becomes nonmagical.

magic-item:medal-of-the-horizonback.description: When an attack would hit you, use your reaction to gain +5 AC until your next turn (including against that attack); you must see the attacker. It then becomes nonmagical.

magic-item:medal-of-the-maze.description: Tracing it as an action grants advantage on Wisdom checks and the quickest route through any nonmagical path or maze for 1 hour, then it becomes nonmagical.

magic-item:medal-of-the-meat-pie.description: Pressing it to your mouth as an action grants 2d4 + 2 temporary hit points, then it becomes nonmagical.

magic-item:medal-of-the-wetlands.description: Tracing it as an action lets you ignore difficult terrain for 1 hour, then it becomes nonmagical.

magic-item:medal-of-wit.description: Pressing it to your temple as an action grants advantage on Intelligence checks and saves for 1 hour, then it becomes nonmagical.

magic-item:ring-of-red-fury.description: You can breathe water and swim at your walking speed. Once per long rest, as a bonus action, enter a ruidium rage for 1 minute: advantage on Strength checks and saves, add your proficiency bonus to damage, ignore difficult terrain, and immunity to paralyzed and restrained; doing so forces a DC 20 Charisma save. Ruidium Corruption: on failure you gain 1 level of exhaustion and become corrupted if not already. If all ruidium is destroyed, it becomes a ring of free action.

magic-item:ruidium-armor.description: Resistance to psychic damage, water breathing and a swimming speed equal to your walking speed. Rolling a 1 on a save while wearing it forces a DC 15 Charisma save. Ruidium Corruption: on failure you gain 1 level of exhaustion and become corrupted if not already. If all ruidium is destroyed, it becomes +1 armor.

magic-item:ruidium-shield.description: Resistance to psychic damage, water breathing and a swimming speed equal to your walking speed. When you take psychic damage, your reaction redirects it to a creature you can see within 30 feet, then you make a DC 20 Charisma save. Ruidium Corruption: on failure you gain 1 level of exhaustion and become corrupted if not already. If all ruidium is destroyed, it becomes a +2 shield.

magic-item:ruidium-weapon.description: Water breathing and a swimming speed equal to your walking speed; hits deal an extra 2d6 psychic. Rolling a 1 on an attack with it forces a DC 20 Charisma save. Ruidium Corruption: on failure you gain 1 level of exhaustion and become corrupted if not already. If all ruidium is destroyed, it becomes a +2 weapon.

magic-item:teleportation-tablet.description: A clay tablet bearing a permanent teleportation circle's sigils (10 minutes of study and a DC 21 Arcana check reveals the destination). Breaking it as an action on the same plane creates a 10-foot circle within 30 feet linked to that destination until the end of your next turn.

magic-item:talarith.attunementNote: by the reigar who created it
magic-item:talarith.description: Jewelry of the reigar's chosen form. Its weapons deal an extra 1d6 force. As an action, summon a Construct duplicate of the reigar (no talarith) that obeys it for 1 hour or until reduced to 0; usable again after a short or long rest.

magic-item:horizon-puzzle-cube.description: An 8-inch cube worth 5,000 gp to collectors. Solving it (30 minutes, DC 25 Investigation) opens a two-way 30-foot portal to Horizon's Edge for 10 minutes or until reconfigured. It doesn't work on Horizon's Edge except in reverse from a device there.

magic-item:helm-of-disjunction.attunementNote: by a sorcerer, warlock, or wizard
magic-item:helm-of-disjunction.description: As an action, emit a 300-foot antimagic pulse: potions and scrolls are destroyed and other non-artifact magic items not on you are suppressed for 1 minute, spells touching the area end, and creatures within 30 feet make a DC 15 Strength save or fall prone. Usable again after 1d4 days.

magic-item:hither-thither-staff.description: 4 charges, regaining 1d4 at dawn. As an action, spend 1 to create or relocate two linked portals (6 by 4 feet) on surfaces within 1,500 feet that act as one doorway for 24 hours, ending if they move over 1 mile apart. As a bonus action, close both or suppress one.

magic-item:horn-of-beckoning-death.attunementNote: by a sorcerer, warlock, or wizard
magic-item:horn-of-beckoning-death.description: As an action, summon a crimson cloud (30-foot radius, growing 30 feet each turn, concentration up to 10 minutes) at the start of your next turn; any creature with 9 or fewer hit points ending its turn in it dies, and Humanoids rise as zombies obeying Szass Tam. Usable once per year.

magic-item:red-wizard-blade.description: Melee hits deal an extra 3d12 necrotic. A creature it kills can be raised only by a deity or by true resurrection from a tablet of reawakening.

magic-item:tablet-of-reawakening.description: As an action, cast true resurrection from it; it then turns to dust.

magic-item:end-crystal.description: A Large object (AC 11, 30 hit points, vulnerable to bludgeoning and thunder, resistant to piercing and slashing, immune to poison and psychic). Destroyed, it explodes: DC 15 Dexterity save within 20 feet, 21 (6d6) force, half on success.

magic-item:ender-pearl.description: Worth 500 gp. Thrown up to 60 feet, it teleports the thrower and their gear to where it lands if there is room, then vanishes.

magic-item:amethyst-die.description: 3 charges, regained daily at dawn. When you make an ability check, attack roll or saving throw, spend 1 charge to add a d6 to the d20 roll; afterward you take psychic damage equal to twice the d6 roll.

magic-item:boog-s-ball.description: A dense 3-inch stone sphere. As an action, throw it at a point within 60 feet; it grows to a 5-foot radius (within 30 feet) or 10-foot radius (farther). Creatures in the area make a DC 15 Dexterity save or take 14 (4d6) bludgeoning. It then shrinks and teleports to your hand or a pack you wear.

magic-item:bracers-of-the-spellbreaker.description: Mithral bracers inlaid with gem bands. While worn, you have advantage on saves against spells and magical effects, and damage from your spell attacks ignores the target's resistances. Sentience: the item is sentient with Argan Rael's alignment and mental scores, hearing and 60-foot darkvision, speaks that persona's languages and talks telepathically with the wearer. Curse: attunement can't be ended without remove curse or similar; starting seven days after attuning, the wearer makes a DC 18 Wisdom save every 24 hours, losing 1 Wisdom on each failure while attuned. After three failures the item's soul possesses the wearer, who becomes that persona and only observes; ending attunement or death frees them, but after 1d6 + 12 months of possession the wearer's soul is destroyed.

magic-item:crown-of-majesty.description: A mithral circlet set with a hue-shifting diamond. While worn, you resist psychic damage and can't be charmed or frightened. 3 charges (regains 1d3 at dawn): spend 1 as an action to cast command or charm person (save DC 18). Sentience: the item is sentient with Prince Ellan Farra's alignment and mental scores, hearing and 60-foot darkvision, speaks that persona's languages and talks telepathically with the wearer. Curse: attunement can't be ended without remove curse or similar; starting seven days after attuning, the wearer makes a DC 18 Wisdom save every 24 hours, losing 1 Wisdom on each failure while attuned. After three failures the item's soul possesses the wearer, who becomes that persona and only observes; ending attunement or death frees them, but after 1d6 + 12 months of possession the wearer's soul is destroyed.

magic-item:eye-of-sunrise.description: A black iron gauntlet with a crimson gem. Bonus action: shed red bright light 10 feet and dim 10 more, or extinguish it. Once per dawn, as an action, emit a 30-foot cone explosion audible 300 feet away: DC 15 Dexterity save, 5d6 fire plus 5d6 force, half on success; unattended objects and structures take 10d6 fire plus 10d6 force.

magic-item:iron-ring.description: Speak the High Command's passphrase as an action to teleport: into the Cyst demiplane if you are outside it, or from the Cyst to a place you have visited. Two uses, regained daily at dusk. Curse: once attuned you can't remove it or end attunement without a 4th-order or higher cure ailment power or greater restoration.

magic-item:mantle-of-the-lightbender.description: Once per dawn, when hit by an attack, use your reaction to reveal the attacker struck a past image of you: you appear within 30 feet of it and the attack misses. Doesn't work against attackers using non-sight senses or truesight.

magic-item:mindrazor.description: +1 to attack and damage rolls. 3 charges, regained daily at dawn: when you hit a creature, spend 1 to force a DC 17 Intelligence save or it becomes vulnerable to psychic damage for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn).

magic-item:pathfinder-s-boots.description: +2 AC and +10 feet walking speed while worn. 7 charges (regains 1d6 + 1 at dawn): spend 1 to cast feather fall, jump or shield. Sentience: the item is sentient with Kishina Darrowind's alignment and mental scores, hearing and 60-foot darkvision, speaks that persona's languages and talks telepathically with the wearer. Curse: attunement can't be ended without remove curse or similar; starting seven days after attuning, the wearer makes a DC 18 Wisdom save every 24 hours, losing 1 Wisdom on each failure while attuned. After three failures the item's soul possesses the wearer, who becomes that persona and only observes; ending attunement or death frees them, but after 1d6 + 12 months of possession the wearer's soul is destroyed.

magic-item:pendant-of-grave-regeneration.description: While worn, your skin grows pale and cold and you regain 5 hit points at the start of your turn if you have at least 1. Curse: attuning extends the curse to you; until remove curse or similar, you can't remove it and your creature type is Undead.

magic-item:poison-popper.description: Throw this fruit at a point within 60 feet to release a 10-foot-radius cloud of gas for 1 minute that spreads around corners (moderate wind disperses it in 4 rounds, strong wind in 1). The area is lightly obscured; a creature entering it the first time on a turn or starting its turn there makes a DC 13 Constitution save or takes 14 (4d6) poison and is poisoned with half speed for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn); half damage only on success.

magic-item:ring-of-scarlet-shadows.description: Grants 60 feet of darkvision (or +60 feet) and advantage on Stealth checks to hide. Shadow Blade: as a bonus action, extend a shadow shortsword dealing necrotic damage that you can't drop; dismiss it as a bonus action. Sentience: the item is sentient with Scarlet Shadow's alignment and mental scores, hearing and 60-foot darkvision, speaks that persona's languages and talks telepathically with the wearer. Curse: attunement can't be ended without remove curse or similar; starting seven days after attuning, the wearer makes a DC 18 Wisdom save every 24 hours, losing 1 Wisdom on each failure while attuned. After three failures the item's soul possesses the wearer, who becomes that persona and only observes; ending attunement or death frees them, but after 1d6 + 12 months of possession the wearer's soul is destroyed.

magic-item:star-of-iron.description: A light, long-hafted maul with 10-foot reach. A creature you hit is hexed until the end of its next turn, subtracting 1d4 from attack rolls and saving throws. As an action you can reshape and recolor its head.

magic-item:sun-eater-s-mind.description: Three times per dusk, when a creature within 60 feet makes a spell attack against you or forces you to save against its spell, use your reaction so your next attack against it before your next turn ends is a critical hit. Sun Eater's Gift: three times per dusk, as a bonus action, swap places with a willing creature within 30 feet attuned to the Sun Eater's Soul.

magic-item:sun-eater-s-soul.description: Three times per dusk, when a creature within 30 feet is hit, use your reaction to halve that damage. Sun Eater's Grace: three times per dusk, when your spell restores hit points, a creature within 30 feet attuned to the Sun Eater's Mind regains the same amount.

magic-item:tome-of-the-ethereal.description: While held, you see 120 feet into the Ethereal Plane. 3 charges, regained daily at dusk: when a creature within 60 feet targets you with a power, spell or attack, spend 1 as a reaction to slip into the Ethereal Plane until your next turn starts, or teleport up to 60 feet.

magic-item:treant-arrow.description: A creature damaged by this arrow is restrained by sprouting vines until it or another creature in reach succeeds on a DC 15 Athletics or Acrobatics check as an action. After restraining a creature, or if its source treant dies, it becomes mundane.

magic-item:visionary-s-cloak.description: While worn, you have advantage on initiative and can't be surprised. With the hood up (an action to raise or lower), you have 60 feet of truesight and your eyes glow blue-white. Sentience: the item is sentient with Radlee Thugram's alignment and mental scores, hearing and 60-foot darkvision, speaks that persona's languages and talks telepathically with the wearer. Curse: attunement can't be ended without remove curse or similar; starting seven days after attuning, the wearer makes a DC 18 Wisdom save every 24 hours, losing 1 Wisdom on each failure while attuned. After three failures the item's soul possesses the wearer, who becomes that persona and only observes; ending attunement or death frees them, but after 1d6 + 12 months of possession the wearer's soul is destroyed.

magic-item:waning-moon.description: +1 to attack and damage rolls. Hits against a creature that can't see you deal an extra 2d6 force. Once per dusk, on a hit, you can turn invisible for 1 minute and Hide as part of the attack; it ends if you attack, cast a spell or manifest a power.

magic-item:dissimortuum-s-cursed-mask.description: A nigh-indestructible mask that survives its dissimortuum. A humanoid or giant donning it takes 7 (2d6) necrotic and makes a DC 15 Wisdom save or is slowly dominated: after a day or two it loses stretches of time gathering grisly parts, and after a week the dissimortuum rises anew and reclaims the mask, freeing the wearer.

magic-item:vanisher-hat.description: A plain burlap tam that looks like a jeweled coronet to those who see through illusions. Once per dawn, as an action, speak its command word to become invisible with your gear and gain a 40-foot flying speed for up to 1 minute, ending if you repeat the word, attack or cast a spell.

magic-item:aastrika-s-crown.description: Resizes to its wearer; grants fire resistance. Blend with the Blaze (2/dawn): as an action, touch a Small or larger mundane flame without harm, learn the location of every such flame within 10 miles, and optionally teleport next to one. Magma Transport: within 10 feet of a Molten Enclave lava pool, use an action to teleport yourself and one willing creature to another pool in the lair.

magic-item:bag-of-eyes.description: Holds five eyeballs. As an action, place one on a surface with a command word; it melds in, invisible, for 24 hours with normal vision and 60-foot darkvision in all directions (up to five active). As an action you see through an active eye on your plane, blind to your own senses; switching eyes takes an action. After 24 hours an eye returns to the bag if on the same plane, otherwise it is lost.

magic-item:blade-of-forlorn-hope.description: +2 to attack and damage rolls. On a hit, deal an extra 2d6 radiant or give an ally within 30 feet of the target 2d6 temporary hit points. Immolating Surge (1/dawn): right after attacking on your turn, take one additional action; at the end of the turn you take 6d8 radiant, and if it drops you to 0 you die and burn to nothing.

magic-item:draconic-visage.description: A dragon mask whose scale color can be changed after a long rest. While worn: +1 AC, resistance to the color's damage type, Draconic, and advantage on Charisma checks to influence dragons. Three times per dawn, when you deal damage, add 3d10 damage of the color's type.

magic-item:essence-of-shadowkeep.attunementNote: by an evil illrigger, paladin, or warlock
magic-item:essence-of-shadowkeep.description: A sentient black mist; inhale it as an action to attune instantly, exhale as an action to end it. While attuned: red eyes, necrotic resistance, +1d6 necrotic on weapon attacks, once per dusk regain hit points equal to weapon damage dealt, and knowledge of the Devil's Influence in Shadowkeep. Sentience: lawful evil, Int 14, Wis 15, Cha 18; domineering and action-hungry, it conflicts with a wielder who ignores it three times.

magic-item:foresight-weapon.description: +1 to attack and damage rolls. Your first attack against each creature in an encounter has advantage, and if it hits, its weapon dice are maximized. Once per dawn, when you miss, use your reaction to turn the miss into a hit.

magic-item:lava-crucible.description: While carried: fire immunity, Draconic and Ignan. Bonus action command fills it with lava (harmless to you; 33 (6d10) fire to others who touch it). While filled: as an action, melee attack within 5 feet at +11, emptying it, 33 (6d10) fire; cast scrying (DC 20) with the image in the lava; or cast conjure elemental for fire elementals only. Another bonus action empties it.

magic-item:millstone-of-grinding.description: A 5-ton, 10-foot millstone inscribed All is Grist. While the mill runs, it turns any Small or Tiny mundane object placed in its center into a pinch of magic flour; adding the flour to water as an action restores the object.

magic-item:monocle-of-secrets.description: While worn, advantage on checks to find secret doors and traps. As an action while holding a mundane object, learn its exact value, materials, and whether it is genuine or counterfeit.

magic-item:nine-lives.description: +1 to attack and damage rolls; hits deal an extra 1d6 necrotic. Starts with 3 charges (gray bloodstones): when you fail a save holding it, spend 1 to succeed instead and take 2d6 necrotic that can't be reduced. Once per dawn, damaging a Dragon while below 9 charges restores 1 charge.

magic-item:overmatter-totem.description: As an action, detach an ear, eye or hand (AC 10, hit points equal to half your maximum, hover flying at half your best speed) that acts on your turn by telepathic command: the ear hears and can make Perception checks, the eye sees with your senses except tremorsense, the hand carries Tiny objects, interacts, or attacks with a light weapon using your bonuses. It reattaches as an action within 5 feet; at 0 hit points or beyond 60 feet it falls lifeless and takes 1 hour to reattach.

magic-item:psi-lenses.description: A matched pair of glass shards. Touching one while the other is on your plane, use an action to teleport to the other lens (or the nearest free space). Once used, the pair can't be used again until dawn.

magic-item:rod-of-the-sovereigns-servant.description: While held, cast speak with dead at will. You can also cast animate dead (5th level), bestow curse, geas and raise dead with your save DC, each once per dusk.

magic-item:sands-of-war.description: A 15-foot sand table; while touching it you have advantage on History checks about military lore and on Intimidation. A command phrase turns it into a half-pound hourglass and back. Carrying the hourglass grants fire resistance; once per dawn, a bonus action flip lets you add 1d4 to attacks and saves for 10 minutes. Smashing it as an action destroys it in a 30-foot-radius explosion: DC 16 Dexterity save, 44 (8d10) fire, half on success.

magic-item:shield-of-shadow-form.description: +1 AC. Once per dusk, as an action, become a shadowy cloud with your gear for 10 minutes (ends at 0 hit points or as an action): fly 10 feet, occupy creatures' spaces (6d8 necrotic to a creature whose space you end your turn in), resistance to mundane damage, advantage on Strength, Dexterity and Constitution saves, pass through cracks, hover; you can't speak, manipulate objects, attack, cast or manifest powers.

magic-item:shtriga-nonna-s-pot-of-plenty.description: A 2-pound iron pot. Once per dusk, as an action, a command phrase fills it with tasty stew for fifteen Humanoids that spoils after 24 hours, or with poisoned stew (DC 16 Constitution save or poisoned for 24 hours).

magic-item:soul-lamp.description: 6 charges. As an action, spend 1 to summon a specter within 5 feet that speaks your languages, obeys you and acts after you, lasting 1 hour or until destroyed; one at a time. It regains 1 charge when a non-Construct, non-Undead creature dies within 20 feet.

magic-item:the-closing-argument.description: A golden feather quill with endless red ink. While held, advantage on checks to create or interpret contracts and documents and to conduct legal disputes or negotiations. Creatures who sign a document with it can't willingly break its terms while the document exists; it supplies ink for 5 minutes, then can't sign again for a month.

magic-item:wand-of-restoration.description: 6 charges, regains 1d4 + 2 at dawn. As an action, spend 2 to cast lesser restoration or 4 to cast greater restoration. Spending the last charge: on a d20 roll of 1 it crumbles to dust.

magic-item:watch-of-prospecting.description: Its second hand ticks loudly within 30 feet of an unattended gold item worth at least 100 gp. You have advantage on checks to find hidden treasure.

magic-item:xaantikorijek-s-looking-glass.description: While carried, resistance to lightning and thunder. Once per dawn, while holding it and seeing a creature or object reflected, ask about its past; the reflection shows an event from its history in the Mundane World.

magic-item:alluring-dye.description: A thick paste that permanently dyes feathers, fur or hair. You gain +2 to Charisma saves for 24 hours after first applying a new color. Re-dyeing more than once in ten days: on a d4 roll of 1 you turn shocking yellow and have disadvantage on Charisma checks for 1d6 days.

magic-item:antlers-of-the-true-path.description: An antler-shaped divining rod. Once per dawn, after 10 minutes visualizing a familiar person, place or object within 1,000 feet on your plane, the rod pulls you toward it while you concentrate.

magic-item:band-of-fruitfulness.attunementNote: by a bard, cleric, or druid
magic-item:band-of-fruitfulness.description: A gold bangle with 6 charges (regains 2 at dawn). Spend up to 6 to make it a table of food for 5 creatures, eaten for 10 minutes per charge. Benefits accumulate by charges: 1, heal 5d8; 2, advantage on saves against poisoned and frightened for 1 hour; 3, cured of diseases and poisons; 4, one level of exhaustion removed; 5, hit point maximum and hit points +2d10 for 1 hour; 6, another exhaustion level removed and 1-hour benefits last 24 hours.

magic-item:basilisk-crystal.description: A crystal shed from a basilisk's back; only adamantine can cut or damage it. It serves as an excellent arcane focus.

magic-item:belt-of-the-weald.description: A belt of polished wooden links. In forests you have advantage on Survival checks and ignore difficult terrain. Once per dawn you can cast longstrider on yourself.

magic-item:chronicle-of-fools.description: An indestructible, self-mending journal of adventurers' tales; only the attuned can write in it. As an action, you or a creature who hears you gains advantage on an ability check and doubles its proficiency bonus for it (unless already expert). Curse: you must keep it with you and feel compelled to write brutally honest entries revealing your and your friends' secrets.

magic-item:cloak-of-spines.description: Unarmored, your AC is 14 + your Dexterity modifier. Once per dawn, when hit in melee, use your reaction to reduce the damage by 2d4 and deal 2d4 magical piercing to the attacker (4d4 each for a hedge).

magic-item:cogwork-wings.description: A 20-pound brass-and-cloth contraption set with levers before donning. With wings flapping you gain a fly speed based on total weight for up to 1 hour total, dropping when time runs out. As a reaction while falling you can lock them to glide, but there is a 50 percent chance they jam until 2d12 hours after landing. Regains 10 minutes of flight per 4 hours unused.

magic-item:crown-of-daffodils.description: Blooms 1d4 daffodils at dawn (max 4). With at least one bloom you gain +1 to ability checks and saves. As an action, give a daffodil to another creature, granting it +1 to checks and saves for 1 hour. When the last flower is removed, on a d20 roll of 1 the crown withers away.

magic-item:draught-of-feather-shine.description: Grants advantage on Charisma checks and saves for 24 hours and makes feathers noticeably shiny.

magic-item:draught-of-slime-curse-cure.description: A bubbly green potion that grants the benefits of remove curse and advantage on saves against curses for 1 hour.

magic-item:egg-of-rebirth.description: An unbreakable golden egg holding part of your life force; you always know its direction and distance on your plane, and only power word kill destroys it (killing you). Once per dawn, use your reaction for advantage on a save against an effect on you. When you die within 20 feet of it, it shatters and you return to life at full hit points; hostile creatures within 60 feet make a DC 17 Constitution save: 12d6 radiant and blinded for 1 minute, half and not blinded on success.

magic-item:eye-of-starsight.description: A cogwork amulet with 3 charges (regains 1d3 at dusk). Cosmic Insight: spend a reaction and charge to reroll a check, attack or save. Stellar Eye: remove the orb to float it (bonus action), move it 30 feet as an action, and spend a charge to see through it for 10 minutes with 30-foot truesight in all directions; unlimited range on your plane, passes 1-inch gaps.

magic-item:fangs-of-guile.description: Advantage on Deception, Insight and Persuasion. 3 charges (regains 1d3 at dusk): as an action spend 1-3 for a spectral bite on a creature within 5 feet (+7 to hit, 3d6 magical piercing per charge), gaining temporary hit points equal to the damage. If empty at dusk, on a d6 roll of 1 it loses its magic.

magic-item:feather-robe.attunementNote: by a sorcerer, warlock, or wizard
magic-item:feather-robe.description: A robe of a single birdfolk spellcaster's feather endlessly copied. Your Intelligence or Charisma becomes 22 (chosen at attunement) and you gain +1 to saves, plus a further benefit based on the donor's birdfolk race (GM's choice or d10).

magic-item:flame-of-ingenuity.attunementNote: by a bard, sorcerer, or wizard
magic-item:flame-of-ingenuity.description: A wooden lantern with an undying flame (quenched only by antimagic): bright light 30 feet and dim 30 more, in which invisible things become visible and illusions show as spectral forms; a bonus action dims it to 5 feet. Reroll Intelligence checks of 1 or 2. Once per dawn, meditate 1 minute to regain up to 5 levels of spell slots.

magic-item:glowing-ember.description: A warm crystal. A command word within 60 feet makes it shed bright light 20 feet and dim 20 more and grant cold resistance within 20 feet; another makes it hover and follow within 20 feet. If blocked from following for 3 rounds while lit, or reduced to 0 hit points (AC 16, 30 hit points, resists nonmagical slashing and piercing, immune to fire), it explodes: 8d6 fire within 20 feet, DC 13 Dexterity save for half.

magic-item:kwark-s-wondrous-kernels.description: A velvet pouch of 2d4 one-inch kernels, either all planters or all tossables, of types chosen by the GM or a d8 roll.

magic-item:marotte-of-chance.description: A bird-shaped jester's baton usable as an arcane focus and as a magical club using Charisma for attack and damage. On a hit, a d100 roll of 10 or less triggers a random d10 effect from the Chance Table.

magic-item:pathfinder-s-pebble.attunementNote: by a nature cleric, druid, or ranger
magic-item:pathfinder-s-pebble.description: Outdoors you always know north. Once per dawn, as an action, cast commune with nature. Naming a familiar fixed location on your plane while gripping it tells you its distance, direction and the shortest route until you arrive, choose another, or dismiss it.

magic-item:potion-of-rest.description: Drunk before a short or long rest, you wake with 1d10 + 5 temporary hit points and one fewer level of exhaustion, in addition to the rest's normal benefits.

magic-item:recall-crystal.description: As an action, smash it to teleport yourself and your gear to the Alderheart council chambers. It is destroyed.

magic-item:ring-of-plant-speech.description: You can speak with plants and plant creatures within 30 feet; non-sentient plants gain sentience and can tell you telepathically about the past day's events.

magic-item:ring-of-the-sky-hunter.description: 3 charges (regains 1d3 at dawn). Stooping Talons: as an action spend charges for spectral talons to attack a creature within 60 feet (+7 to hit, 2d8 magical piercing per charge). Raising Talons: spend 1-3 to grapple a Large or smaller creature within 60 feet (DC 15 Strength save if unwilling) and lift it 20 feet per charge for that many rounds, repeating the save each turn.

magic-item:saber-of-unity.description: +2 to attack and damage rolls. While wielded, you and allies within 10 feet are immune to frightened. A critical hit against a larger foe gives you and allies within 10 feet 2d10 temporary hit points.

magic-item:shroud-of-ending.description: Tyton's cloak of night. On attuning, a DC 12 Constitution save or age 5d10 years (disadvantage on everything for 1 hour; death if past your lifespan, rising as a guardian ghost). While attuned you stop aging, need no food or sleep, harm plants you touch, and beasts and plants within 30 feet turn hostile; ending attunement ages you all at once. Blessings: +2 AC and saves, see in darkness, immune to poison and disease, advantage on death saves and against instant death. Hasten the Sunset (weekly): a creature within 120 feet makes a DC 17 Constitution save or ages 6d10 years and is cursed. Shade's Form: etherealness once per dusk. Step of the Night's Shadow: teleport up to 500 feet between areas of dim light or darkness with one creature. Only a 17th-level cleric of Ardea at dawn can destroy it.

magic-item:slimeforged-blade.description: +2 to attack and damage rolls. On a natural 20 against a creature, it is paralyzed until the end of its next turn.

magic-item:staff-of-climbing-ivy.attunementNote: by a bard, druid, sorcerer, or warlock
magic-item:staff-of-climbing-ivy.description: Three command words: Growth (bonus action, up to 120 feet of vines grow 30 feet per round toward a surface or object), Grasp (no action, anchor them), Grapple (action, retract 30 feet per round, pulling you to the surface or the object to you). Vines have AC 14, 45 hit points, vulnerability to fire and slashing, bear 240 pounds; at 0 the staff is destroyed.

magic-item:strig-feather-robe.attunementNote: by a sorcerer, warlock, or wizard
magic-item:strig-feather-robe.description: Your Intelligence or Charisma becomes 22 and you gain +1 to saves. Strig feather: whenever you cast a spell with a slot, you gain 2d10 + the spell's level temporary hit points.

magic-item:talon-tincture.description: Applied to talons or claws, it grants advantage on Dexterity checks and saves for 24 hours.

magic-item:talons-of-the-squall.description: Leg-bracers granting lightning resistance, advantage against being moved by strong winds, and no disadvantage on ranged attacks or Perception in strong wind, heavy rain or snow; you fly at normal speed in such weather.

magic-item:the-thorn-of-kren.description: Touching it barehanded forces a DC 18 Wisdom save or you attune (displacing another item if needed). Advantage on Perception and Survival; a 1d8 bite usable as a bonus action; +2 to unarmed and natural weapon attacks and damage. Curse: insatiable hunger for beast flesh; each hour without it, a DC 13 Wisdom save (rising 1 per hour) or frenzy: disadvantage on checks not about hunting, advantage on attacks against beasts and attacks against you. Destroyed only by an Evertree purification ritual or wish.

magic-item:whistle-of-freedom.description: Blown, creatures within 100 feet that hear it gain advantage on their next save against an effect on them, and those under mind control are freed. A creature benefits once per 24 hours.

magic-item:arcane-oil.description: Distilled from the jelly around a xakalonus brain. As an action, coat one weapon or 20 pieces of ammunition. Nonmagical coated objects gain +2 to attack and damage rolls for 1 minute. Magical ones gain no bonus, but for 1 minute their attacks fully damage the hraptnon.

magic-item:brazen-armor.description: Plate fashioned from an Empyrean brazen bull, gleaming in sunlight. You gain +1 AC and resistance to fire and radiant damage.

magic-item:coat-of-lies.description: A coat of severed tongues. You gain +1 AC and advantage on Deception checks. Three times per day, as a bonus action, the next spell you cast before your next turn starts needs no verbal or somatic components.

magic-item:glass-studded-armor.description: You have resistance to radiant damage. A creature making a melee attack against you takes 3 piercing damage unless it attacks with disadvantage.

magic-item:knifewing-cape.description: A cloak of 20 knifewing skins. You gain +1 AC, and when you fall you descend 60 feet per round and take no falling damage.

magic-item:lindwyrm-venom.description: Delivered by ingestion or wound. A creature exposed makes a DC 18 Constitution save or takes 36 (8d8) poison damage and is poisoned for 1 minute, with disadvantage on Strength and Dexterity checks and saves while poisoned.

magic-item:lycan-weapon.description: Made from lycanthrope claws, teeth and bones. +2 to attack and damage rolls. A lycanthrope hit is forced into human form unless it makes a DC 10 Charisma save, and vampires can't regenerate damage from it until they finish a short rest.

magic-item:lycanthropy-antidote.description: A silvery, red-flecked potion made with fzeg blood. Drinking it removes the curse of werewolf lycanthropy.

magic-item:ready-gunk.description: Paste of powdered bone-trader armor. A treated one- or two-handed item within 30 feet can be summoned and equipped as a bonus action. Three uses before it loses potency.

magic-item:wand-of-silence.description: 7 charges. As an action, expend 1 charge to cast silence (save DC 15). Regains 1d6 + 1 charges at dawn; expending the last charge, on a d20 roll of 1 it crumbles to ash.

magic-item:a-new-look.description: Your head transforms into a random anthropomorphic animal (horse, panda, pig, raccoon and so on) until removed as if a curse. Doesn't count against the number of potions affecting you at once.

magic-item:animal-affinity.description: A violet, meadow-scented potion. For 1 hour you gain +3 to Animal Handling checks.

magic-item:arcane-solvent.description: Applied to a magic item, it ends any creature's attunement to it; a creature wearing or carrying the item resists with a DC 13 Wisdom save.

magic-item:astounding-vigor.description: You gain temporary hit points equal to your hit point maximum, lasting 24 hours or until lost.

magic-item:audio-oddity.description: Sounds like a man sobbing when opened. For 1 hour, spells you cast make no sound.

magic-item:beard-brew.description: You instantly grow random facial hair, which stays until shaved. Doesn't count against the number of potions affecting you at once.

magic-item:beast-hide.description: Your skin thickens with fur patches. For 1 minute you have resistance to cold damage.

magic-item:blessing-of-the-moon-spirit.description: Permanent. Your hit point maximum increases by 2d10 when first drunk, and once per long rest while touched by moonlight you can spend three Hit Dice as a bonus action. Doesn't count against the number of potions affecting you at once.

magic-item:bottled-bind.description: Thrown at a creature within 30 feet, it covers it in glue: DC 15 Strength save or restrained for 1 minute, ending with a DC 15 Strength check as an action.

magic-item:bottled-bomb.description: Thrown at a point within 60 feet, it explodes: creatures within 5 feet make a DC 14 Dexterity save, 1d8 force, half on success.

magic-item:bottled-slime.description: A slime that sometimes forms in place of a potion. Thrown to a space within 30 feet, it releases a soda slime that acts on its own.

magic-item:bottled-torch.description: Uncorked, it spews a blade-shaped flame for 1 minute that you can attack with as an improvised weapon, dealing 2d4 fire on a hit; water ends it.

magic-item:bowark-s-bombastic-beer.description: A hoppy brew of euphoric calm. Until it wears off, you can reroll any ability check, attack roll or save, 7 rerolls in total.

magic-item:breakfast-in-a-bottle.description: Makes d4 servings of breakfast. A serving (1 minute to eat) sates a creature for the day and reduces its exhaustion by 1, once per long rest. Spoils after 24 hours.

magic-item:brute-brew.description: For 1 hour you gain +3 to Athletics checks.

magic-item:bubble-message.description: As part of the bonus action to drink it, you speak a message into a hiccupped bubble that floats at 1 mile per hour to a creature you're familiar with and pops, repeating it in your voice; damage pops it early.

magic-item:candlecap.description: Your hair becomes flame for 1 hour (bright light 20 feet, dim 20 more). Once per turn a head unarmed strike deals an extra 1d4 fire. As an action you can burst the flame for 2d4 fire to all other creatures within 5 feet, ending the effect.

magic-item:carbonated-snake.description: Shaken and pointed, its contents shoot out and become a poisonous snake within 10 feet.

magic-item:carla-cackletooth-s-corruptio.description: Poured out, it summons 10 corrupted muks under your control until destroyed.

magic-item:cat-s-eye.description: Your eyes become catlike. For 1 hour you gain 60-foot darkvision, or +30 feet to existing darkvision.

magic-item:catspeed.description: Once within 24 hours when you take the Attack action, you make two additional attacks, ending the potion. Meanwhile you can purr.

magic-item:cave-diver.description: Poured on hands and feet, for 10 minutes you can climb walls and ceilings hands-free with a climbing speed equal to your walking speed.

magic-item:chicken-chaser.description: Your hair turns dark red and you can permanently speak with chickens. Once, you can crow to summon 100 chickens in a 20-foot radius: other creatures there make a DC 19 Dexterity save, 30d6 slashing, half on success. Doesn't count against the number of potions affecting you at once.

magic-item:cinderskin.description: For 1 hour you have resistance to fire damage.

magic-item:claws-of-the-crab-king.description: For 1 minute your hands are crab claws: unarmed strikes deal double damage to objects and structures and you grapple with advantage, but you can't wield weapons, shields, tools or magic items or perform somatic components.

magic-item:crafter-s-brew.description: Added to water, the first nonmagical object submerged for 1 minute gains a random permanent magical effect of uncommon rarity or higher.

magic-item:crt-tv-and-chicken-timer.description: As an action, set the timer to eleven minutes and fourteen seconds; until it goes off, the TV shows fuzzy video of a 10-foot sphere around the timer. Once per dawn.

magic-item:crystal-clear.description: Poured into a nonmagical liquid no larger than a 20-foot cube, it turns the liquid invisible for 1d4 hours.

magic-item:dancing-feet.description: You now dance everywhere: +10 feet walking speed, +5 to dance Performance checks, and proficiency in Dexterity saves, until you dismiss it as an action.

magic-item:dancing-juice.description: Coat a melee weapon for 1 hour. On a hit you can force a DC 12 Constitution save; on a failure the coating is used and the target convulses with speed 0 until the end of its next turn.

magic-item:demonskin.description: For 1 minute you gain +2 AC and resistance to cold, fire and lightning and to nonmagical bludgeoning, piercing and slashing, and your type becomes Demon (Fiend).

magic-item:detective-s-tonic.description: For 1 hour you gain +3 to Investigation checks.

magic-item:disappearing-act.description: Your body and gear vanish and your sentience transfers into a random object within 100 miles.

magic-item:displacement-field.description: You appear beside your actual location; attacks against you have disadvantage until the start of your next turn.

magic-item:don-t-hit-me-juice.description: Thrown at a creature within 30 feet: DC 16 Wisdom save or pacified for 1 minute (can't attack, cast a spell affecting an enemy, or deal damage), save ends at end of turn.

magic-item:don-t-eat-dirt.description: For 10 days you are immune to the prone condition and can't go prone even by choice.

magic-item:dragon-frog-transmutation.description: You become an Elder Dragon Frog as if by true polymorph for 1 minute, or 10 minutes if brewed with a Dragon Fang of Yutro.

magic-item:duck-foot.description: Your hands and feet become webbed. For 1 hour you gain a 40-foot swimming speed and a convincing quack.

magic-item:duko-the-trickster-s-elixir.description: You can produce an egg, rock, coin or 2-foot string from your mouth, once, whenever you choose. Doesn't count against the number of potions affecting you at once.

magic-item:durability.description: For 1 minute you gain 10 temporary hit points at the start of each of your turns.

magic-item:eagle-s-vision.description: For 1 minute, attacking at long range doesn't impose disadvantage on your ranged weapon attacks.

magic-item:elder-elixir.description: Your age temporarily doubles for 1d12 months. Doesn't count against the number of potions affecting you at once.

magic-item:elixir-of-echoes.description: Within the next minute you can cast, once and without a slot or material components, a spell another creature cast within 100 feet in the last minute that you were aware of, using that caster's DC and attack bonus.

magic-item:elixir-of-jipampa.description: For 24 hours you gain +5 to initiative, and once you can take a second reaction in a round, ending the potion.

magic-item:elixir-of-omnimind.description: For 1 minute you can concentrate on two spells at once, saving separately for each.

magic-item:enhanced-bottled-bomb.description: Thrown at a point within 60 feet, it explodes: creatures within 5 feet make a DC 16 Dexterity save, 3d8 force, half on success.

magic-item:enhanced-lightning-breath.description: Within 24 hours, as a bonus action you exhale lightning at a creature within 30 feet: DC 16 Dexterity save, 3d10 lightning, half on success. This ends the potion.

magic-item:enhanced-static-shock.description: Within 24 hours, right after a creature touches you or hits you with a metal melee weapon, you can use your reaction to deal it 3d10 lightning, ending the potion.

magic-item:epic-bottled-bomb.description: Thrown at a point within 60 feet, it explodes: creatures within 30 feet make a DC 19 Dexterity save, 20d6 force, half on success.

magic-item:essence-of-great-rivers.description: For 24 hours, up to three times, you can turn a failed save into a success.

magic-item:essence-of-the-river-spirit.description: Poured into a small pool, it becomes a healing pool for 1 hour: a creature soaking 10 minutes regains 4d4 + 4 hit points, up to six creatures.

magic-item:essence-of-umami.description: Poured on food, it gives the taster their personal ultimate culinary experience.

magic-item:eyes-of-akibu.description: Poured over your eyes, for 4 hours you see up to 300 feet away as if it were one-tenth as far.

magic-item:face-of-fugari.description: For 1 minute you have advantage on Intimidation checks.

magic-item:fire-shield.description: Within 24 hours, the next time you would take fire damage you take none and regain half that much instead.

magic-item:flip-and-skip.description: For 1 hour you gain +3 to Acrobatics checks.

magic-item:fluffplum-tonic.description: For 1 hour you are under feather fall and weigh no more than 1 pound.

magic-item:gardener-s-solution.description: Rubbed on a plant, it grows to full maturity, stopping once it reasonably fills the space. Drunk, it does nothing but tastes like maple syrup.

magic-item:gargoyle-hooch.description: For 1 hour your skin is living stone: +2 AC and walking speed reduced by 5 feet.

magic-item:glowskin.description: For 4 hours your skin sheds bright light 30 feet and dim light 30 more.

magic-item:gobble-gunk.description: For 1 hour you can eat anything that fits in your mouth without ill effect; magic objects eaten are hurled back up afterward.

magic-item:grand-friendship.description: Split among up to eight drinkers; for 24 hours they gain 60-foot flight while all are holding hands.

magic-item:healing-gas.description: Thrown at a point within 60 feet, creatures within 5 feet regain 1d4 + 1 hit points.

magic-item:herbalist-s-aid.description: For 1 hour you gain +3 to ability checks to locate an ingredient.

magic-item:hero-s-blade.description: Poured over a weapon, for 1 minute it gains +3 to attack and damage rolls, and creatures it hits lose their damage immunities and resistances for 1 minute.

magic-item:heroism.description: You have advantage on your next attack roll within 24 hours.

magic-item:hidden-hand.description: For 24 hours you have telekinetic powers as if under telekinesis.

magic-item:hindsight.description: Poured over an object and licked off, it reveals a minor but useful bit of information about it.

magic-item:homeward-tonic.description: For 24 hours you know the direction of the place you consider home on the same plane.

magic-item:hsirebbig.description: For 24 hours your speech is gibberish to anyone not also under this potion, even to comprehend languages.

magic-item:hunter-s-speed.description: For 1 minute you gain 90-foot flight, and Attack actions grant 1 + 1d4 additional attacks (roll once).

magic-item:illusion-in-a-bottle.description: Poured out, it creates an illusion of your choice as major image for 1 hour; DC 18 Investigation as an action reveals it.

magic-item:incoming.description: For 1 minute you gain +2 AC against ranged attacks.

magic-item:incredible-luck.description: You have advantage on your next 1d4 ability checks, attack rolls or saves.

magic-item:intoxicating-aroma.description: You smell of fine perfume for 22 years. Doesn't count against the number of potions affecting you at once.

magic-item:invisible-tonic.description: Poured over a Small or smaller object, it becomes invisible until removed as if a curse.

magic-item:invulnerability.description: Until the start of your next turn you are immune to all damage, but on that turn you can't move or take actions.

magic-item:iron-belly.description: For 1 hour you gain 5 temporary hit points and resistance to poison damage.

magic-item:iron-mind.description: For 1 hour you have advantage on saves against being charmed and resistance to psychic damage.

magic-item:irresistible-charm.description: For 10 minutes you gain expertise in Persuasion.

magic-item:island-nectar.description: You regain 100 hit points, and as part of the bonus action to drink it you can make a melee weapon attack, cast a single-target spell, or move your speed.

magic-item:keening-voice.description: For 1 hour, as a bonus action you make a ranged attack against a creature within 60 feet that can hear you, using your Performance bonus, dealing 1d6 thunder on a hit.

magic-item:kinetic-pop.description: Poured over a nonmagical weapon, the next hit within 1 hour doubles the weapon's damage dice.

magic-item:ladybug-kinship.description: Opened, it releases 500 ladybugs per round for 1 minute as it evaporates.

magic-item:language-lore.description: For 1 hour you understand the literal meaning of any spoken language you hear.

magic-item:last-resort.description: A crystalline cocoon forms around you at the start of your next turn, immune to all damage and unmovable short of wish; you are in stasis. It lasts 1d4 units of a time measure (hours to decades) rolled on the book's table.

magic-item:life-steal.description: As an action, point it at a creature within 10 feet: it takes 3d6 necrotic and the potion becomes a healing elixir restoring that many hit points.

magic-item:lifetime-supply.description: You grow (1d4 + 2) x 100 feet of hair; after 1 minute it all falls out.

magic-item:lightning-breath.description: Within 24 hours, as a bonus action you exhale lightning at a creature within 30 feet: DC 12 Dexterity save, 1d10 lightning, half on success. This ends the potion.

magic-item:liquid-arcana.description: Restores one expended spell slot of up to a level the brewer rolls on a d4.

magic-item:liquid-cat.description: Poured out, it becomes a friendly cat familiar (as find familiar) for 24 hours.

magic-item:liquid-dispel.description: Thrown at a creature, object or magical effect within 30 feet, it ends any spell of 3rd level or lower on the target.

magic-item:liquid-lockpick.description: Poured into a lock, it reduces the DC to pick it by 1d4 for 1 hour; a lock can benefit only once.

magic-item:liquid-mending.description: Poured over an object, it repairs a single break or tear as mending.

magic-item:lunar-elixir.description: Poured out, for 8 hours a 20-foot-radius, 300-foot-high cylinder has moon gravity: jump distances triple and falling damage is halved.

magic-item:machine-oil.description: Poured over a working machine, it powers it for 1 minute as if whelmed by a spirit or activated by jolt.

magic-item:manifested-nostalgia.description: For 4 hours you become your child self: one size smaller (minimum Small), and Strength and Dexterity become 10 if higher.

magic-item:many-hands.description: Spectral arms burst from you. Creatures that see them emerge make a DC 19 Wisdom save (friends with advantage) or are frightened until your next turn starts. Other creatures within 20 feet make a DC 19 Constitution save: 10d6 necrotic and no healing until your next turn starts, half damage only on success.

magic-item:meditative-trance.description: Your next short rest grants the benefits of a long rest, even if you had one in the past 24 hours.

magic-item:melodious-bird-calls.description: For 24 hours you can perfectly mimic any songbird.

magic-item:merriment.description: For 1 hour you are very drunk: expertise in a chosen skill, but disadvantage on all other ability checks.

magic-item:mind-transfer.description: The first creature to touch you receives your mind and soul for up to 1 hour (ended as an action or by dispel evil and good); your body lies unconscious. At the start of each of its turns you can win a contested Intelligence or Wisdom check to control it until its next turn. If it dies with you inside, you die.

magic-item:mosspot.description: You polymorph into a mossling spirit for 1 hour, no concentration.

magic-item:move-a-thing.description: Poured over an object of 500 pounds or less, it loses up to 1d100 pounds each hour until it weighs 10 pounds, staying so for 1 week.

magic-item:musical-mixer.description: Uncorked, it plays ethereal music for 1 hour as it evaporates.

magic-item:newly-found-magic.description: Permanent. You learn a random 3rd-level spell, castable once per long rest without a slot. Doesn't count against the number of potions affecting you at once.

magic-item:object-embodiment.description: You become an object of your choice as true polymorph for 1 hour, no concentration.

magic-item:oil-of-the-trademark-flourish.description: Applied to an object, it gives it a signature sound when used, permanently unless removed as a curse.

magic-item:paradise-plumage.description: For 24 hours you have dazzling plumage and advantage on Performance checks to distract or amaze.

magic-item:paranoia.description: For 8 hours you can't be surprised.

magic-item:passing-memory.description: Stores one of the brewer's memories; the drinker gains it.

magic-item:pathseeking.description: For 1 hour you see secret path tracks as glowing footprints and can see into the Spirit Realm (Ethereal Plane).

magic-item:perfect-memory.description: For 1 hour everything you see and hear is perfectly recorded, recallable for 24 hours before fading.

magic-item:phoenix-elixir.description: For 24 hours you are immune to fire damage; then you burn to ash and 1 hour later are reborn in the nearest bonfire, your belongings left behind.

magic-item:photosynthetic-skin.description: For 24 hours, while the sun is out, you regain 1 hit point at the start of every hour.

magic-item:pig-snout.description: For 1 hour you grow a pig snout, love truffles, and have advantage on smell-based Perception.

magic-item:pigment.description: For 8 hours you produce endless oil paint of any color from your fingertips.

magic-item:pocket-portal.description: Buried for 24 hours, it sprouts a portal to the Spirit Realm that stays open 24 hours.

magic-item:potion-of-attunement.description: As an action, pour a drop on a magic item requiring attunement and drink the rest to attune to it instantly.

magic-item:potion-of-exertion.description: You take another action this round at initiative count 1.

magic-item:potion-of-freezing.description: Poured into a liquid, up to a 20-foot cube freezes solid for 1 hour.

magic-item:potion-of-healing-touch.description: Poured on your hands; within 1 hour, as a bonus action, you touch a creature to restore 2d4 hit points, ending the potion.

magic-item:potion-of-holistic-wellness.description: You regain 4d8 + 4 hit points and end all conditions except grappled, prone and restrained.

magic-item:potion-of-reprieve.description: For 1 hour you gain one greater restoration benefit of your choice; the ill effect returns afterward.

magic-item:potion-of-soft-steps.description: For 10 minutes you float an inch up, gaining +2 to Stealth checks and leaving no tracks.

magic-item:prickleskin.description: For 1 minute, when you grapple a creature and as a bonus action while it remains grappled, you deal it 1d4 piercing.

magic-item:projected-thoughts.description: For 1 hour a 1-foot bubble above your head shows your thoughts as silent illusory words or images anyone can see.

magic-item:pumpkin-patch-guard.description: For 1 minute your head is a jack-o'-lantern casting a 15-foot cone of faerie fire, aimed and toggled at the start of each of your turns.

magic-item:rabbit-s-speed.description: For 10 minutes your walking speed increases by 5 feet.

magic-item:rapid-withdrawal.description: For 1 minute, when a hostile creature damages you, you can use your reaction to teleport up to 15 feet.

magic-item:ratatam-s-glowskin-elixir.description: For 8 hours you shed dim light 10 feet, intensified to bright light as a bonus action. As an action you flare: creatures within 30 feet that can see make a DC 16 Constitution save or are blinded for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn), ending the potion.

magic-item:respiratory-distress.description: Thrown at a point within 60 feet, it releases a 15-foot-radius gas cloud: creatures inside make a DC 15 Constitution save or spend their reaction coughing and lose concentration.

magic-item:rubberskin.description: For 1 hour you have resistance to lightning damage.

magic-item:secret-path.description: Applied to boots, for 24 hours they leave invisible tracks (color chosen by the brewer) lasting one month, visible only to those who see invisible things or drank pathseeking.

magic-item:seeking-smoke.description: Thrown at a creature within 30 feet: DC 12 Dexterity save or it is cloaked in smoke for 1 minute, with disadvantage on Stealth to hide.

magic-item:sensorius-maximus.description: For 1 hour you gain +3 to Perception checks.

magic-item:severed-reaction.description: Permanent. You can take two reactions per round, losing hit points equal to half your level each time you take the second. Doesn't count against the number of potions affecting you at once.

magic-item:shadow-child.description: An apparition only you can see serves you as unseen servant for 1 hour.

magic-item:sharp-mind.description: For 8 hours you gain +2 to Intelligence saves, resistance to psychic damage, and read 10 times faster.

magic-item:sheep-dragon-brew.description: For 1 hour you grow sheep dragon wool: +1 AC and resistance to cold damage.

magic-item:shepherd-s-bane.description: For 1 hour you grow claws; your unarmed strikes deal 1d6 + Strength modifier slashing.

magic-item:simulacrum-elixir.description: You fall into deep sleep and your mind takes over a perfect construct clone with half your hit point maximum and only mundane clothes; it can't level up or regain spell slots. Your body sleeps without nourishment but can be harmed. When dismissed or reduced to 0 the clone becomes butterflies and your mind returns.

magic-item:sky-swimming.description: For 10 minutes you gain a 15-foot flying speed and can hover, swimming through the sky under underwater combat rules.

magic-item:slugskin.description: For 1 minute you have resistance to piercing damage and can leave a slime trail.

magic-item:soft-paw.description: For 10 minutes you have advantage on Dexterity checks.

magic-item:spirit-appendage.description: You grow a 6-foot prehensile tail usable as a third arm that supports your weight, for 1d12 days.

magic-item:spirit-armor.description: Poured on an unarmored creature, for 1 hour its AC is 15 while unarmored.

magic-item:spirit-of-salyri.description: For 24 hours you gain proficiency with one type of armor.

magic-item:spirit-repellent.description: Drunk or poured on a 1-foot square: spirits of CR 5 or lower within 30 feet make a DC 15 Charisma save or are teleported 35 feet away and can't willingly come within range for 1 minute; spirits entering range must save too.

magic-item:spirit-sweets.description: A spirit of CR 8 or lower that drinks it is drunk and happy for 1d4 days. Poured out, it attracts spirits of CR 2 or lower within 1 mile for 8 hours.

magic-item:spiritual-rebuke.description: Poured out, it creates a 10-foot cube void of the island's magic, as antimagic field, for 1 year.

magic-item:static-shock.description: Within 24 hours, right after a creature touches you or hits you with a metal melee weapon, you can use your reaction to deal it 1d10 lightning, ending the potion.

magic-item:stink-brew.description: For 1d4 rounds, other creatures within 15 feet make a DC 13 Constitution save or can't willingly move closer; newcomers save on entering.

magic-item:sunken-suitcase.description: An indestructible, sealed suitcase that locks itself when closed, with a lock DC of 1d20 + 5.

magic-item:super-singing.description: For 1 hour you can only speak by singing and have advantage on vocal Performance checks.

magic-item:thunderbelch.description: After 1d4 rounds you must use your action to belch: other creatures within 10 feet make a DC 14 Constitution save, 3d8 thunder and deafened until the end of your next turn, half and not deafened on success.

magic-item:tiny-bubbles.description: Bubbles fill a 20-foot cube within 30 feet for 1 hour; a creature entering for the first time on a turn makes a DC 13 Dexterity save or they pop, dealing 1d6 thunder to all creatures in the cube, audible a mile away.

magic-item:tiny-telekinesis.description: For 1 minute, as an action you move an unattended object of up to 1 pound and 5 inches within 60 feet up to 30 feet.

magic-item:tunnel-vision.description: For 1 minute your first weapon hit each turn deals an extra 1d12 of its type, but you take -2 to AC.

magic-item:twin-telepathy.description: Shared between two drinkers, they communicate telepathically at any distance for 24 hours.

magic-item:twin-vision.description: Shared between two drinkers within 1 mile; for 8 hours the first can see through the second's eyes and senses (blind to its own meanwhile), toggled by either as an action.

magic-item:umi-s-powerful-undertow.description: For 1 hour, spells that produce or manipulate water are cast one slot level higher, and water-damage spells deal an extra 2d12 bludgeoning. Or throw it within 30 feet to summon three water elementals under your control until destroyed.

magic-item:uncanny-focus.description: For 1 minute you have advantage on concentration saves, and becoming incapacitated doesn't break concentration.

magic-item:unified-might.description: For 1 hour two ability scores of your choice become 25.

magic-item:unknown-elixir.description: You can cast one random spell of 6th level or lower without a slot (DC 17, +9), once. Doesn't count against the number of potions affecting you at once.

magic-item:ups-a-daisy.description: Poured over a creature or object, it awakens it as awaken; it stays charmed by you for 1 year.

magic-item:vocal-stranger.description: For 1 hour you perfectly mimic the voice of someone you don't know, or a random voice.

magic-item:water-breathing.description: You can breathe underwater for 1 hour.

magic-item:weapon-master-s-elixir.description: For 24 hours you gain proficiency with a melee weapon of your choice.

magic-item:witch-s-hidden-gem.description: For 1 hour any liquid you drink turns to wine.

magic-item:witch-s-lament.description: A rain cloud weeps over you and your head permanently becomes an anthropomorphic animal of the GM's choice.

magic-item:wonder-juice.description: For 1 minute everything you wear or carry counts as magical, overcoming resistance and immunity to nonmagical attacks.

magic-item:wrathful-spirit.description: Roll 2d8. For 1 minute, when you cast a spell, one target it damaged takes that much extra force damage.

magic-item:aboleth-ramen.description: Magical meal: 10 minutes to eat, feeds one Large or four Medium or smaller creatures, lasts 8 hours or until dispelled or another meal is eaten. Bonus values scale by rarity (uncommon to legendary). Ingredient: broodmother tentacle. Boss Meal: your melee weapon reach increases on your turn. Aberration Flesh: your first hit each turn deals bonus psychic damage.

magic-item:astral-luggage.attunementNote: Uncommon or very rare; attunement optional
magic-item:astral-luggage.description: Luggage holding a filtered portal to the Astral Plane: its 2-by-1-foot opening repels creatures, and objects placed inside drift away. Its fastenings each work once per dawn (DC by rarity). Ebony Clasp: as an action, throw it within 30 feet to fill a 20-foot square with black tentacles for 1 minute without concentration (an attuned wielder is immune).

magic-item:bomboozler.description: A polyhedron holding a phial of ooze acid. Once per dawn (and with a fresh phial), as an action, throw it up to 60 feet: a 20-foot-radius acid blast, Dexterity save (DC by rarity), 4d6 acid, half on success. Failures also roll a d10 biomantic effect: no healing, 2d6 acid per turn, disadvantage on attacks, restrained, blinded, faerie fire, bane, reduce, zippit!, or roll twice; 1-minute effects allow a Constitution save each turn.

magic-item:breastplank.attunementNote: Breastplate, half plate or plate; uncommon to very rare
magic-item:breastplank.description: Mimic-wood armor with sprouting eyes and teeth. Creatures have disadvantage to avoid or escape your grapples, and creatures you grapple take 1d10 acid at the start of their turns. Rare: 1d12 acid and Quick Grip (grapple as a bonus action). Very rare: also Tongue Lash (bonus action, a creature within 15 feet makes a DC 16 Strength save or takes 1d6 bludgeoning and is pulled 15 feet, then you can grapple it; Huge or larger auto-succeed).

magic-item:broodmother-s-embrace.description: A rubbery tentacled overcoat. Underwater you breathe water and gain a swimming speed by rarity. Tentacle Lash: as an action, a melee spell attack at reach by rarity dealing bludgeoning by rarity, with a Strength save against prone for creatures of a certain size. Chrysalis (once per dawn): as an action, encase yourself for temporary hit points by rarity; while encased your speed is 0, you can only act to emerge, and you regain hit points each turn up to a cap, ending after 1 minute or when the temporary hit points are gone.

magic-item:broodmother-s-eye.description: Socketed in an item, it grants Intense Stare: once per dawn, a non-hostile humanoid within 60 feet is fixed by the eye and you have advantage on Persuasion and Intimidation with it for 1 minute, after which it realizes magic was used.

magic-item:broodslinger.description: A forearm-mounted broodling symbiote holding charges up to a maximum by rarity, recharged by spending Hit Dice on a rest (each die plus Constitution modifier). Your unarmed strikes deal bonus piercing by rarity. Mucous Spit: as an action, a ranged spell attack within 60 feet for acid by rarity; spend 1 charge for Splashing Mucous, forcing the target and creatures within 5 feet to make a Dexterity save or take acid damage.

magic-item:caltrooze.description: A bag of 20 acid-filled caltrops. As an action, cover a 5-foot square: a creature entering makes a DC 15 Dexterity save (advantage at half speed) or stops, takes 1 piercing and loses 10 feet of walking speed until healed. Failures roll a d4: 6d6 acid; slippery (DC 15 Dexterity save each turn or prone); 1d4 acid per 5 feet moved; or disadvantage on Dexterity saves. Once triggered, refill with 10 minutes of decanting biomantic acid.

magic-item:dreamy-the-lucid.description: A stuffed toy. While you carry it, magic can't put you to sleep; asleep while holding it, you dream lucidly, know if the dream spell targets you, and wake unsurprised when initiative is rolled.

magic-item:dumpleyengs.description: Magical meal: 10 minutes to eat, feeds one Large or four Medium or smaller creatures, lasts 8 hours or until dispelled or another meal is eaten. Bonus values scale by rarity (uncommon to legendary). Ingredients: dreamholder subeye, blood, heart. Boss Meal: cast daydream once per hour without components. Aberration Eye: detect magic at a radius by rarity. Blood: your first hit each turn against the blood's creature type deals bonus damage. Heart: you sense the direction of hearts of that creature type within a range by rarity.

magic-item:eyes-of-googly.description: A pair of wandering, slightly moist eyes. Placed on an object that fits in a 5-foot cube, the object becomes sentient (it can't speak; statistics as the GM deems).

magic-item:flooze.description: An ooze-crafted flail. It deals an extra 1d6 acid to the first target it hits each turn, and has 8 charges (regains 1d4 + 4 at dawn). Reachier: spend up to 4 charges to add 5 feet of reach each until the end of your turn. Very rare: an extra 1d8 acid on every hit, plus Sticky Fingers: instead of damage, a Medium or smaller target makes a DC 16 Strength save or its held item sticks in the flail (up to 2; freed with a DC 16 Strength check action that costs 1d4 acid; nonmagical weapons dissolve in 1 minute); while holding weapons the flail can deal piercing or slashing.

magic-item:goo-luck-dice.description: Sticky dice that grant one reroll of a 1 per dawn. On a weapon handle, the wielder rerolls a 1 on an attack roll. Hung from a mount or vehicle, it rerolls a 1 on an attack roll, ability check or save.

magic-item:grill-of-barbecuing.description: A portable grill backpack that serves as cook's utensils. Extra-Dimensional Pantry: a pocket refills at dawn with enough food for one magical meal or a day's rations, and rejects anything put in. Sous-Chef: magical meals cooked on it gain one random cooking boon (d8): poison resistance and advantage against poison, advantage on Charisma checks against creatures that smell you, a language, advantage on concentration saves, frightened immunity, advantage on Strength checks and larger carrying size, extra rest healing, or +5 feet speed.

magic-item:haemscale.attunementNote: Medium or heavy; uncommon, rare or legendary
magic-item:haemscale.description: Magnetite dragon armor with 7 charges (regains 1d4 + 3 at dawn). Spend 1 charge for Repulse (reaction, disadvantage on a ferrous weapon attack against you) or Aura (bonus action, a 20-foot aura of difficult terrain for chosen ferrous creatures until your next turn). Rare: cold resistance, 30-foot aura, and Superconductor (taking cold damage grants 30-foot flight until the end of your next turn). Legendary: 40-foot aura and flight, plus Swordstorm (once per dawn, cast blade barrier at DC 17, possibly +2d10 with many ferrous objects nearby).

magic-item:haemstrike.attunementNote: Any hammer; uncommon to very rare; attunement optional
magic-item:haemstrike.description: +2 to attack and damage against ferrous targets. Attuned (each use risks a d4 roll of 1 disabling these until dawn): Attraction, a bonus action pulling an object under 300 pounds or a creature (DC 13 Strength, disadvantage if ferrous, Large+ immune) 15 feet toward you. Rare: +1 weapon (+3 against ferrous), DC 15, 600 pounds, Huge+ immune, plus Magnetic Shockwave (once per turn on a hit, creatures within 5 feet of the target make a DC 15 Dexterity save, 1d6 cold and 1d6 piercing, half on success). Very rare: +2 (+3), DC 16, 1,000 pounds, Gargantuan immune, plus Dragon's Roar (bonus action, creatures within 15 feet make a DC 16 Wisdom save or are frightened until the end of your next turn).

magic-item:hammer-time.attunementNote: Any hammer; uncommon or very rare
magic-item:hammer-time.description: A +1 hammer with an hourglass of platinum sand and charges by rarity, regained at dawn. Chronal Blink: as a bonus action spend 1 charge; the next creature you hit within 1 minute makes a Charisma save (DC by rarity) or vanishes forward in time, reappearing at the end of your next turn.

magic-item:headbanger-lute.attunementNote: Club or greatclub; uncommon or very rare
magic-item:headbanger-lute.description: A mimic-infused lute that deals an extra 1d8 acid to the first target it hits each turn; lute proficiency counts. Ventriloquism: as a bonus action it mimics sounds from a point within 30 feet (DC 13 Investigation to tell). Very rare: DC 16, plus Club Music, two songs each once per dawn: Panic! at the Tavern (chosen creatures within 15 feet, DC 16 Wisdom save, 6d6 psychic and frightened for 1 minute, half only on success) and Mithrallica (25-foot cone, DC 16 Strength save, 6d6 thunder, pushed 20 feet, prone and deafened for 1 minute, half only on success).

magic-item:heliana-s-guide-to-monster-hu.description: A heavy, homemade-feeling tome. As an action, it shows the harvestable parts and Component DCs of the nearest corpse. Know Thy Enemy: an object from a creature placed inside reveals facts about it after 1 minute (number by rarity). It works as a simple melee weapon (1d6 bludgeoning), with proficiency if you're proficient in Arcana, History, Nature or Religion.

magic-item:jello-shot.description: Magical meal: 10 minutes to eat, feeds one Large or four Medium or smaller creatures, lasts 8 hours or until dispelled or another meal is eaten. Bonus values scale by rarity (uncommon to legendary). Ingredients: polyhedrooze mucus, fat. Boss Meal: right after taking damage you gain resistance to that type for 1 minute, up to a maximum number by rarity. Ooze Blood: your first hit each turn on an ooze deals bonus damage. Fat: damage of the type tied to the fat's creature type (aberration psychic, beast cold, celestial radiant, construct lightning, fey and plant poison, fiend fire, monstrosity thunder, ooze acid, undead necrotic, dragon or giant by breath or theme) is reduced by a die by rarity.

magic-item:l-ars-ne-s-quadnoculars.description: Filtered goggles. As an action, stare at a corpse within 60 feet to learn the function of the magic items craftable from its components and the effects of magical meals made from it.

magic-item:magnetite-curry.description: Magical meal: 10 minutes to eat, feeds one Large or four Medium or smaller creatures, lasts 8 hours or until dispelled or another meal is eaten. Bonus values scale by rarity (uncommon to legendary). Ingredients: magnetite dragon flesh, liver, spice. Boss Meal: damage from nonmagical ferrous weapons is reduced. Dragon Flesh: your first hit each turn deals bonus piercing. Liver: a creature of the liver's type that hits you in melee takes necrotic damage, once per your turn. Spice: by type, celestial feather fall, elemental a random elemental cantrip at will, fey detect evil and good, fiend temporary hit points each minute, plant speak with plants, undead extra hit points.

magic-item:magnetite-horn.description: On a ferrous weapon: when a visible ferrous weapon attack hits you, use your reaction for +1 AC against it. On a worn iron item: when a creature within 5 feet is targeted by a ferrous weapon attack, use your reaction and roll a d20; on 11 or higher you become the target.

magic-item:mawling-maul.description: A chained, mimic-infused +1 hammer. As a bonus action, loosen the chains: hits deal extra piercing by rarity, but ending your turn without hitting with it deals you acid by rarity. The chains retighten after 1 minute unheld or as a bonus action.

magic-item:mimickey.description: A bone and flesh keyring socketed on a weapon or held item. As an action, spin it to shrink the item to key size, or back again.

magic-item:noradreno-mucorales.description: An electric-blue mushroom. Eaten as an action, it grants haste for 1 minute, but at the start of each of your turns you make a DC 15 Constitution save or can't move or act until your next turn. Loses potency 1 hour after picking.

magic-item:oozemat-coat.description: An ooze-polymer lab coat. After each long rest, choose resistance to acid, fire, lightning or poison until the next. You take half damage from failed Harvesting checks.

magic-item:robes-of-beaur-ve.description: Dream-stuff robes (with pockets) holding charges by rarity, regained at dawn. Incorporeality: as a bonus action spend 1 charge to become incorporeal until your next turn (resistance to nonmagical bludgeoning, piercing and slashing, move through creatures and objects; shunted out for 1d10 force per 5 feet if you end inside). Spend charges equal to spell level to cast daydream, sleep or dreamwalk (DC by rarity). You can't be put to sleep unwillingly, and can perform a chosen light task while sleeping without spoiling a long rest.

magic-item:second-chance.description: A pocketwatch socketed on clothing or armor. Once per dawn, as a bonus action before an ability check or attack roll, set a marker; after seeing the result you can rewind and reroll, using the new result.

magic-item:shard-crown.description: A magnetite crown. Critical hits against you with ferrous weapons become normal hits. You know magnetobolt and, in extreme cold, cast levitate or fly on yourself at will (by rarity). Charges by rarity. Bloodbend: as an action spend 1 charge; a creature with blood within 30 feet makes a Wisdom save (DC by rarity) or uses its reaction to obey a one-word command: Throw (hurls a held object), Sit (falls prone and stays until the end of its next turn) or Attack (one weapon attack against a creature you choose).

magic-item:slime-in-a-skull.description: A skull housing a friendly ooze, with 2 charges regained at dawn. As an action spend 1 charge to summon the Large ooze (statistics by rarity) for 1 hour or until it drops to 0 (then not for 1 hour); it acts after you and obeys your commands, otherwise Dodging.
