magic-item:snow-wolf-cowl.description: A shaman-enchanted snow wolf head. Once per dawn, as an action, polymorph yourself into a winter wolf without concentration, speaking Common, Giant and Winter Wolf, with attack bonus and Cold Breath and Bite DCs by rarity; end it as a bonus action.

magic-item:spelleater-tome.description: A spellbook and wizard focus with 8 charges (regains 1d4 + 4 at dawn). As an action it devours a spell scroll (level by rarity) and stores the spell, up to a number by rarity; cast stored spells for charges equal to their level (1 for cantrips), DC and attack by rarity. Found with one random 1st- and one 2nd-level spell.

magic-item:time-splitter.description: A chronomantic axe with 4 charges (regains 1d4 at dawn). Pause: as a bonus action spend 1 charge; until the end of your next turn, moving creatures and objects leave ghost images you can target as if they were still there. Time Dilation (once per dawn): as a bonus action cast haste on yourself without concentration for a secret 1d3 rounds. Rare: 9 charges (regains 1d6 + 3) and 1d4 + 1 rounds.

magic-item:tinytar.description: A phial of friendly tar applied to a held item's handle: the first creature to hold it can't be disarmed against its will. As an action, recall the tar to its phial.

magic-item:tome-of-living-memories.attunementNote: Uncommon to very rare; optional attunement by a wizard
magic-item:tome-of-living-memories.description: An aboleth broodmother's shifting memories. Over 1 minute, a DC 10 Intelligence check grants proficiency in Arcana, History, Nature and Religion for 10 minutes (failure deals psychic damage equal to your level). Over 10 minutes you can try to cast identify, augury or clairvoyance without a slot or material components (Intelligence check DC 10 + spell level; failure deals twice the spell level in psychic). Attuned wizards can use it as a spellbook and focus with comprehend languages and detect thoughts prepared.

magic-item:tongue-twister-tart.description: Magical meal: 10 minutes to eat, feeds one Large or four Medium or smaller creatures, lasts 8 hours or until dispelled or another meal is eaten. Bonus values scale by rarity (uncommon to legendary). Ingredients: tavern mimic tongue, brain. Boss Meal: as an action transform into furniture your size (speed 5 feet, only Dash or revert; Investigation DC by rarity to spot). Monstrosity Flesh: your first hit each turn deals bonus thunder. Brain: by type, aberration short-range telepathy, celestial or fiend a Charisma check bonus, construct an Intelligence check bonus, fey a Wisdom check bonus, humanoid a bonus to one random skill.

magic-item:ventilation-unit-d-20.description: An icosahedral helmet making breathable gas from ooze. You breathe normally anywhere and have advantage on saves against inhaled gases and vapors. Biomantic Overload (once per dawn): as a bonus action, for 1 minute each time you take damage you gain resistance to that type until you take a different type.

magic-item:wyrm-s-breath-grenade.attunementNote: Bronze or copper rare, brass or gold very rare, silver legendary
magic-item:wyrm-s-breath-grenade.description: A grenade housing a metallic dragon's toxin gland. As an action, throw it within 60 feet to release a 15-foot-radius cloud for 1 minute (or until a strong wind); creatures starting or entering it make the dragon's associated save or suffer its effect, even if not breathing. Once per dawn, refilled with 100 gp of incense and diamond dust.

magic-item:amanita-rotgut.description: A red, yellow-dotted toadstool. Eaten as an action, you take 2d6 poison and are poisoned for 1 minute; afterward you have poison resistance and immunity to poisoned for 1 hour. Loses potency 1 hour after picking.

magic-item:bonze-s-bokken-wind-ripper.description: A training sword dealing bludgeoning damage, with 5 charges (regains 1d4 + 1 at dawn). Gale: as an action, winds fill a cube up to 15 feet from you until your next turn ends, dispersing gases. Gust Rider: as a bonus action spend 1 charge for 40-foot flight until the end of your turn. Wind Rip: replace any attacks with ranged spell attacks (30/60 feet) dealing 1d10 thunder, deafening on a critical hit. Uncommon: 1d8 and no Gust Rider. Very rare: +1, 1d12, 50-foot flight. Legendary: +2, 2d8, 60-foot flight, Auran, and 2 charges to cast fly on yourself.

magic-item:claws-of-corruption.description: Rakshasa-claw gauntlets with 4 charges regained at dawn. On a hit, spend 1 charge: the target makes a DC 13 Wisdom save or is cursed for 1 minute, taking 1d6 necrotic whenever it starts its turn under or concentrating on a spell. You gain a climbing speed equal to your walking speed. Very rare: 5 charges, DC 16, 2d6, and +1 to attack and damage.

magic-item:collar-of-the-cat.description: Socketed on armor, clothing, a focus or weapon: advantage on checks to keep your footing, and subtract up to 20 feet from falls.

magic-item:crawly-rolly-turrit.description: A 10-pound turret. Once per dawn, as an action, deploy it for 10 minutes under your mental control within 100 feet; it acts after you and Dodges unless you command it with a bonus action. Mending restores 2d6 hit points; at 0 it shatters until repaired with 1 hour and a DC 15 (16 crawly) smith's or tinker's tools check. Uses the rolly or crawly turrit statistics.

magic-item:dimensional-doorknob.description: As an action, place it on a keyhole: within 1 minute it acts as thieves' tools, opening DC 15 or lower locks and otherwise rolling +7. Once per dawn, as an action, cast dimension door, leaving a portal in your space until your next turn that creatures up to one size larger can use.

magic-item:dragonmaw-shield.description: A dragon-mouth shield opening onto a pocket-dimension forge. Gnash: when a creature misses you with a melee weapon attack, use your reaction to force a DC 15 Dexterity save; on a failure it takes 1d10 fire and flammable parts of a nonmagical weapon are destroyed.

magic-item:eye-of-the-tiger.description: A rakshasa-eye ring, charges regained at dawn. When targeted by a spell or saving against a spell's area, use your reaction and 1 charge; against a spell of 2nd level or lower, roll a d4: the caster saves (Wisdom, DC by rarity) or takes 1d6 force plus 1d6 per spell level, half on success; the spell is weakened (disadvantage to hit you or advantage on your save); you gain 1d6 + 1d6 per level temporary hit points for 1 minute; or you're unaffected.

magic-item:feline-s-fury.description: A five-bow tommybow, each bow set with a random gem pair (d4: diamond, emerald, ruby, sapphire). As an action, imbue and fire ammunition carrying daylight (diamond), stench (emerald), fireball (ruby) or sleet storm (sapphire), DC 15 and no concentration, centered where it hits; the gems are destroyed. Replace a pair with matching gems worth 100 gp each over 1 minute; they power up at dawn.

magic-item:felinobelix.description: A black stone cat statue with 3 charges regained at dawn. Whenever you roll a die, spend 1 charge to roll another and choose. A 1 on the extra die summons the same hostile devil, scaled by your level (imp, barbed, bone, ice devil or pit fiend), which hates you for stealing its luck. Legendary: 6 charges, and you can use your reaction to force a creature within 30 feet to roll a second die and choose for it.

magic-item:gunnspier.description: A +1 matchlock polearm. When you hit with it loaded, use a bonus action to fire for 2d8 extra bludgeoning; reload as an action. If both dice show 8, it backfires: creatures within 10 feet (including you) make a DC 15 Dexterity save or take 4d6 piercing.

magic-item:infested-cultist-s-skull.description: A skull with 7 alien petals, regrowing 1d4 at dawn (destroyed when the last is plucked). As an action, pluck a petal to cast guiding bolt (+5) dealing necrotic (very rare: blight, DC 16). Plucking 3 or more in a day curses you: you keep the skull close, grow an unremovable black petal each long rest (1d4 more on changing planes; removing one deals 2d6 necrotic), and at the seventh you die and your skull becomes a new one. Remove curse ends it.

magic-item:jaw-breakers.attunementNote: Any two melee weapons; optional attunement
magic-item:jaw-breakers.description: A pair of +1 tar-rasque jaw weapons dealing piercing. Chomp: hitting one target with both while two-weapon fighting adds 1d8 to the second hit. Attuned as one item, Swirling Dervish: as an action, leap up to 20 feet in a line without provoking, making one alternating attack against a creature beneath each 5-foot space. Very rare: +2 and a 25-foot leap.

magic-item:kobbold-flaymefrower.description: A scrap-metal flamethrower backpack holding 12 charges, refueled over an hour (wood 1d4, quality coal or oil 1d4 + 3, a core of fire or fire dragon breath sac full). As an action spend 1 charge for a 10-foot cone or 20-foot line of flame, plus up to 3 more charges to add 5 feet of cone or 20 feet of line each: DC 13 Dexterity save, 2d10 fire, half on success, igniting objects. A damage total of 19+ backfires: creatures within 10 feet make a DC 13 Dexterity save or take 4d6 fire. Very rare: a bonus action toggles cold flame.

magic-item:kobold-wristbow.description: A wrist-mounted bow needing no free hand to fire. As a bonus action, fire it with a mental command; reload with an action or bonus action (one free hand). Mastery: Vex.

magic-item:lady-s-veil.description: A mesh shroud socketed on headgear or armor. Once per dawn, as an action, you know the location of every corpse and undead within 60 feet not behind total cover or warded from divination until the end of your next turn.

magic-item:longspike.description: Squeeze it on your turn to add 5 feet of reach until the end of the turn. Attuned, Hyphal Grasp: as a bonus action, your next hit within 1 minute forces a DC 13 Strength save or the target is restrained for 1 minute (action to repeat); afterward a d6 roll of 1-2 disables it until dawn. Very rare: DC 16, +2 weapon, and Hyphal Parasite (bonus action on a hit to cast fungal infection, DC 16, no concentration; same d6 recharge).

magic-item:magik-oil.description: A dripping oil spout socketed on an item: metal can't corrode from acid and wood and cloth stop being flammable (6th-level magic or higher overcomes this). On a weapon its damage becomes magical; on armor it removes Stealth disadvantage.

magic-item:mushroom-m-lange.description: Magical meal: 10 minutes to eat, feeds one Large or four Medium or smaller creatures, lasts 8 hours or until dispelled or another meal is eaten. Bonus values scale by rarity. Ingredients: hyphan spores, fat. Boss Meal: you know the direction and distance of corpses within a radius by rarity (blocked by thick stone, metal, lead or earth). Plant Spice: speak with plants. Fat: damage of the type tied to the fat's creature type is reduced by a die by rarity.

magic-item:mycelial-cloak.description: A mycelia cape. Detritivore (once per rest): as a bonus action, drain a Small or larger corpse or 0-hit-point creature within 15 feet; a living target makes a DC 15 Constitution save (undead with disadvantage) or fails a death save, and on a failure or a corpse you regain 6d6 hit points. Mycelial Deconstruction (once per rest): as an action dissolve into threads, gaining a burrow speed through earth and stone, passing microscopic gaps and resisting bludgeoning, piercing and slashing, but unable to talk, handle objects, cast or attack; reform as an action.

magic-item:overgrown-barkshield.description: Bark Armour (once per long rest): as an action wrap it around you for 1 hour (no shield meanwhile), gaining 1d8 temporary hit points, barkskin without concentration, and advantage against poison. Vines and Thorns: as an action, +5 melee attack within 30 feet for 2d8 piercing, pulling a Large or smaller target 10 feet closer. Rare: 3d8 temporary hit points, +8 and 3d8. Very rare: 5d8, +10 and 4d8.

magic-item:painblinder-mycaxe.description: Painblind Spores (once per long rest): as a bonus action, until your next turn you gain +2 damage with it and resistance to bludgeoning, piercing and slashing; renew each turn for up to 1 minute, then you are poisoned for 10 minutes per round used. Rare: +3, advantage on Strength and Constitution checks and saves while active, usable once per short or long rest.

magic-item:pneuma-blade.description: A kobold-built pneumatic sword. After an attack roll, use a bonus action for +4 to it; a hit deals 1d8 extra poison. If that die shows 8, creatures within 10 feet (including you) make a DC 15 Constitution save or take 4d6 poison and are poisoned until the end of their next turn.

magic-item:psilocybin-kwikitrippiae.description: An iridescent mushroom. Eaten as an action, you are confused (as confusion) for 10 minutes, saving with DC 15 Constitution at the end of each minute; afterward you have advantage on Wisdom saves for 1 hour. Loses potency 1 hour after picking.

magic-item:raging-henbane.description: A black, bark-skinned mushroom. Eaten as an action, you resist nonmagical bludgeoning, piercing and slashing for 1 minute, but at the start of each turn you must use your reaction to attack a random creature in reach or range. Loses potency 1 hour after picking.

magic-item:rakoyaki.description: Magical meal: 10 minutes to eat, feeds one Large or four Medium or smaller creatures, lasts 8 hours or until dispelled or another meal is eaten. Bonus values scale by rarity. Ingredients: pygmy rakshasa brain, blood. Boss Meal: spells up to a level by rarity can't affect or detect you unless you wish. Fiend Brain: +1 to Charisma checks. Blood: your first hit each turn against the blood's creature type deals 1d4 bonus damage.

magic-item:ring-of-birdseye-maple.description: 5 charges (regains 1d4 + 1 at dawn). Touching a plant or wooden surface, spend 1 charge to grow an eye on it within 60 feet for 1 hour while you touch it; you see through it (darkvision 60 feet, blind to your own senses). The eye has Stealth +8, AC 10, 5 hp, and damage to it is dealt to you as psychic. Attuned, the eye persists after you let go, and within 300 feet you can look through it as an action and move it 30 feet along the surface.

magic-item:ring-of-fungal-symbiosis.attunementNote: Rare or very rare; optional attunement
magic-item:ring-of-fungal-symbiosis.description: Each long rest wearing it grows two random mushrooms (four if attuned), lasting until the next long rest and magical for 10 minutes once plucked: Boomshroom (thrown 60 feet, 10-foot fire burst, DC 13 Dexterity, 4d6), Bloomshroom (eat for 2d4 + 2 hit points and advantage on Constitution saves for 1 minute), Doomshroom (thrown, DC 13 Constitution or bane for 1 minute), Gloomshroom (eat for darkvision 60 feet, or +30, for 1 hour). Very rare: DC 16, a d6 adding Rheumshroom (slow) and Zoomshroom (haste, ending on a d6 roll of 1), and attuned Fungal Plating (barkskin for 24 hours after each long rest plus 5 temporary hit points each turn).

magic-item:skrapyard-sosig.description: Magical meal: 10 minutes to eat, feeds one Large or four Medium or smaller creatures, lasts 8 hours or until dispelled or another meal is eaten. Bonus values scale by rarity. Ingredients: koboldzilla tubing, egg. Boss Meal: gain 2 + Charisma modifier temporary hit points at the start of each turn. Construct Flesh: your first hit each turn deals bonus lightning. Egg: by type, aberration a grappling tentacle, beast environmental adaptation, dragon a fanged bite, fey chameleon skin, humanoid a flying speed, monstrosity scaled natural armor.

magic-item:splinterspray-tommybow.attunementNote: Any tommybow; uncommon to very rare
magic-item:splinterspray-tommybow.description: A self-loading tommybow with 6 charges regained at dawn (reload 3). As an action spend 1 charge to attack two creatures within 5 feet of each other separately, 2d4 piercing plus modifiers each. Rare: 9 charges and 3d4. Very rare: 12 charges and 4d4.

magic-item:sporespreader.attunementNote: Rod, staff or wand; requires attunement by a spellcaster; uncommon or rare
magic-item:sporespreader.description: A hyphan focus with 7 charges (regains 1d4 + 3 at dawn): cast calm emotions (2) or charm person (1) with your DC, and spore cloud and smokescreen at will. Rare: 10 charges (1d6 + 4), adding mortiferous pulse (2) and enrage (3).

magic-item:suncatcher.attunementNote: Rod, staff or wand; requires attunement by a spellcaster; uncommon to very rare
magic-item:suncatcher.description: Advantage against being charmed; you sense and can end dream contacting you. 7 charges (1 per hour in sunlight, 1d6 + 1 at dawn). Radiant Absorption: reaction and 1 charge to reduce radiant damage to a creature within 30 feet by 1d8 + your spellcasting modifier. Radiant Deliverance: spend up to 3 charges on a spell attack hit for 1d6 radiant each. Rare: flare and light cantrips, 2d8 reduction, daydream for 1 charge. Very rare: +2 to flare, 3d8 reduction, daydream (1) or blinding radiance (4).

magic-item:suneater-featherfrond.description: Socketed on a held or worn item, it becomes attuneable with Sun Torch: as a bonus action light or snuff it, shedding bright light 20 feet and dim light 20 more.

magic-item:suneater-steak-and-eggs.description: Magical meal: 10 minutes to eat, feeds one Large or four Medium or smaller creatures, lasts 8 hours or until dispelled or another meal is eaten. Bonus values scale by rarity. Ingredients: suneater flesh, blood, egg. Boss Meal: regain hit points at the end of each turn in sunlight. Suneater Flesh: your first hit each turn deals bonus radiant. Blood: bonus damage on your first hit each turn against the blood's type. Egg: by type, a grappling tentacle, environmental adaptation, a 1d12 bite, chameleon skin, 30-foot flight, or AC 15 + Dexterity.

magic-item:sunfeather-shroud.description: In bright light, as a bonus action teleport up to 60 feet to a visible space in bright light; then roll a d6, and on a 1 it can't be used again until dawn.

magic-item:sunwing-bow.description: A +2 bow. In sunlight it makes its own radiant arrows dealing radiant damage. Creatures it deals radiant damage to leave an invisible trail for 1 hour (seen with truesight or detect magic). Attuned, 3 charges (1 at dawn, all if exposed to dawn's light): as an action spend 1 for a 60-foot by 5-foot solar beam, DC 15 Dexterity, 3d8 radiant, half on success.

magic-item:tail-s-end.attunementNote: Any sword; rare or very rare
magic-item:tail-s-end.description: A segmented khopesh that becomes a whip (and back) as a bonus action. On a natural 20, the target makes a DC 15 Constitution save or takes 6d6 necrotic and is desiccated for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn), taking 1d4 extra slashing whenever it takes bludgeoning, force, piercing, slashing or thunder damage; half damage only on success. No effect on skinless or necrotic-immune creatures. Very rare: DC 16, 10d6, and +1d8 slashing on attacks against desiccated creatures.

magic-item:tar-rasque-marrow-broth.description: Magical meal: 10 minutes to eat, feeds one Large or four Medium or smaller creatures, lasts 8 hours or until dispelled or another meal is eaten. Bonus values scale by rarity. Ingredients: tar-rasque marrow, heart. Boss Meal: taking damage from magic empowers your next hit within 1 minute for 1d4 extra necrotic (more by rarity). Heart: you sense the direction of hearts of that creature type within a range by rarity.

magic-item:tarrobe.description: Oilcloth robe with 7 charges (regains 1d6 + 1 at dawn): cast grease (1), create or destroy oil (2) or an oily mireball (3) at DC 15, +7. Spell Reflection: when targeted by magic missile, a line spell or a ranged spell attack, on a d8 roll of 8 the spell reflects back at the caster. Legendary: Terran, 12 charges (1d8 + 4), bone cage and conjure elemental (tar elemental) for 5 charges each, and reflection on 7-8.

magic-item:terrorasque.attunementNote: Any two-handed melee weapon; rare or very rare
magic-item:terrorasque.description: A +1 tar-rasque tooth blade with 5 charges (regains 1d4 + 1 at dawn). Ferocious Blow: as an action spend 1 charge for an attack that rolls four times its weapon dice on a hit; on a miss you fall prone with speed 0 until your next turn. Terrorise (once per hour): as a bonus action (or with Rage), hostile creatures within 60 feet that hear you make a DC 15 Wisdom save or are frightened for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn). Very rare: +2, 7 charges (1d6 + 1), DC 16, five times the dice, and Tar Strike (action and 1 charge for an attack that also restrains for 1 minute, DC 16 Strength check action to escape).

magic-item:viscous-symbiote.description: A tar ooze coating your arms. Treat Strength check d20 rolls of 7 or lower as 8, and your melee reach on your turn is 5 feet greater. Very rare: 3 temporary hit points each turn and claws (2d4 + Strength slashing unarmed strikes). Legendary: 5 temporary hit points each turn, claws, Mask (once per dawn, reaction on initiative: advantage on initiative and Dexterity saves and 30-foot blindsight for 1 minute) and Reactive Tentacles (reaction to a melee attacker within 10 feet, +9 attack for 2d8 piercing).

magic-item:agony.attunementNote: Non-good creature; Vestige; dormant, awakened and exalted states
magic-item:agony.description: A blood-crusted hooked flail. Dormant: +2 to attack and damage; a creature you damage is marked for 10 minutes or until you damage another, and your hits on it deal an extra 1d6 piercing. Awakened: the extra damage is 1d8, a marked creature has disadvantage on Constitution checks and saves, and when you drop a creature to 0 hit points you can make another attack as a bonus action. Exalted: +3, extra damage 2d8, and on a critical hit the target makes a DC 17 Wisdom save or is frightened of you for 1 minute (immune for 24 hours on a success).

magic-item:armor-of-the-valiant-soul.attunementNote: Scale mail; Vestige; dormant, awakened and exalted states
magic-item:armor-of-the-valiant-soul.description: Jade and black-dragon-scale armor. Dormant: +1 AC, and once per long rest cast command (DC 14). Awakened: +2 AC, acid resistance, immunity to frightened, and command at DC 16 targeting up to three creatures. Exalted: +3 AC, acid immunity, friendly creatures within 15 feet are immune to frightened while you are conscious, and command at DC 18 targeting up to five creatures.

magic-item:boots-of-haste.description: Once per dawn, click your heels as a bonus action to cast haste on yourself, with no lethargy when it ends.

magic-item:boots-of-the-vigilant.description: Once per dawn, after rolling initiative, add 1d8 to the roll.

magic-item:cabal-s-ruin.attunementNote: Vestige; dormant, awakened and exalted states
magic-item:cabal-s-ruin.description: A gold-trimmed dark cloak that sparks with arcane energy. Dormant: 4 charges (regains 1d4 at dawn); on a hit, spend any number for 1d6 extra lightning each against one target. Once per short or long rest, when targeted by an enemy's spell, use your reaction to absorb it: the spell still affects you, but the cloak gains charges equal to its level. Awakened: advantage on saves against spells and magical effects, 6 charges (1d4 + 2 at dawn), and absorbing a spell also grants resistance to one of its damage types until the end of your next turn. Exalted: 10 charges (1d6 + 4 at dawn).

magic-item:cataclysm-bolts.description: Kraghammer crossbow bolts, usually in sets of ten. A hit deals normal damage, then roll a d6: 1-2, fire blast for 3d8 to the target and creatures within 5 feet; 3-4, those creatures make a DC 17 Dexterity save or take 1d10 cold and are restrained until the end of your next turn; 5, the target takes 2d6 necrotic and makes a DC 16 Strength save or is stunned until the end of your next turn; 6, six extra ranged attacks against the target at +7, each dealing 1d6 piercing. The bolt then becomes mundane.

magic-item:circlet-of-barbed-vision.attunementNote: Non-good creature; Vestige; dormant, awakened and exalted states
magic-item:circlet-of-barbed-vision.description: A barbed onyx circlet of the Spider Queen. Dormant: advantage on initiative but -2 Charisma while worn; removing it deals 4d6 psychic. Once per short or long rest, use your reaction to add +5 to an attack roll after seeing it. Awakened: poison resistance, immunity to poisoned, and the +5 twice per rest. Exalted: poison immunity, truesight 60 feet, and the +5 three times per rest.

magic-item:coat-of-the-crest.description: A high-collared Clovis Concord brocade coat granting +1 AC, wearable over light armor. 3 charges, regaining 1d3 at dawn: when targeted by an attack, use your reaction and 1 charge for resistance to one damage type from that attack until the start of your next turn.

magic-item:condemner.attunementNote: Heavy crossbow; Vestige; dormant, awakened and exalted states
magic-item:condemner.description: A shadow-touched heavy crossbow. Dormant: +1 to attack and damage and an extra 1d4 poison on a hit; instead of dealing damage on a hit you can cast fog cloud or silence centered on the target, each once per short or long rest. Awakened: +2, 1d6 poison, and a hold person (DC 15) option. Exalted: +3, 1d8 poison, hold person at DC 17, and a blight (DC 17) option, each once per short or long rest.

magic-item:corecut-dagger.description: A hooked dark-metal dagger with +1 to attack and damage. On a hit, spend 1 Hit Die for an extra 3d6 necrotic. Curse: attuning curses you until remove curse; whenever you receive magical healing you must spend a Hit Die to regain any hit points, and if you ever spend all your Hit Dice, you die.

magic-item:dagger-of-denial.description: A silver stiletto with +2 to attack and damage. As an action, insert it into a keyhole to seal it until the dagger is inserted again (the door can still be broken); sealing a new keyhole unseals the previous one.

magic-item:deathwalker-s-ward.attunementNote: Studded leather; Vestige; dormant, awakened and exalted states
magic-item:deathwalker-s-ward.description: Black scrollwork studded leather with a raven-feather mantle. Dormant: +1 AC and advantage on death saving throws. Awakened: +2 AC and resistance to acid, cold, fire, lightning, necrotic or poison (your choice, changeable on a short rest). Exalted: +3 AC, and once per long rest as a bonus action grow raven wings giving a 60-foot flying speed for 1 hour.

magic-item:doublet-of-dramatic-demise.description: A striking satin jacket. At 0 hit points you don't fall unconscious; you are incapacitated with speed 0 but can speak. You make death saves normally, but a natural 1 means you swoon with a gasp and die instantly.

magic-item:earthboard.description: A 9-foot granite slab weighing 40 pounds while attuned. Standing on it, your speed becomes 60 feet over solid ground, you can ramp off earth to long jump 60 feet and slam down so creatures on the ground within 20 feet make a DC 14 Strength save or fall prone, and you gain a 20-foot burrowing speed through earth and rock (60 feet until your next turn as an action), leaving a tunnel. It moves with you until you dismount; benefits end if you end your turn off it.

magic-item:echo-stone.description: A soft dull-blue river stone. Squeeze it as an action to record sound within 15 feet for 1 minute, after which it replays the recording every 5 minutes until squeezed again to silence it. Two quick squeezes replay the latest recording instead of recording.

magic-item:fenthras.attunementNote: Longbow; Vestige; dormant, awakened and exalted states
magic-item:fenthras.description: A living everbark longbow from the Fey Realm. Dormant: +1 to attack and damage; once per short or long rest declare an oracle shot to perceive around the arrow for 10 minutes; creatures it kills sprout a rooting six-foot tree. Awakened: +2 and an extra 1d4 lightning on a hit; once per rest declare a bramble shot for an extra 3d8 piercing, and the target makes a DC 15 Strength save or is restrained (save at end of each turn). Exalted: +3, lightning 1d6, and two bramble shots per rest at DC 17.

magic-item:flamefriend-lantern.description: A lantern housing a fire elemental spirit; attuning also needs a DC 10 Charisma check. It glows on request with bright light up to 60 feet and dim light as far again, and you can cast produce flame from it at will (Wisdom). Once per dawn, as an action, gain for 1 hour fire resistance, fire damage equal to your proficiency bonus to creatures that hit you in melee, or one casting of burning hands at 3rd level (DC 15). Angering the spirit ends attunement, and reattuning has disadvantage until you make amends.

magic-item:graz-tchar-the-decadent-end.description: A ruby-inlaid silver greatsword with +3 to attack and damage. Against a creature with Intelligence 4 or higher, a hit deals an extra 3d6 acid and the target makes a DC 17 Charisma save or is charmed for 1 hour; attacking it again while charmed deals 10d6 instead and ends the charm (24-hour immunity after). Its acid looks like radiant damage except to true seeing, which shows a rusted, dripping blade. Sentient neutral evil (Int 14, Wis 12, Cha 18; darkvision 120 feet; Common; telepathy), it is secretly the voice of the Demon Prince of Indulgence (DC 26 Insight to notice) urging chaos; if long disobeyed, the wielder makes a DC 17 Charisma save or is charmed for 24 hours and compelled to one action per hour, ending if it harms a trusted ally.

magic-item:honor-s-last-stand.attunementNote: Shield; non-evil creature; Vestige; dormant, awakened and exalted states
magic-item:honor-s-last-stand.description: A warm silvered shield bearing the Platinum Dragon's crest. Dormant: +1 AC beyond the shield's normal bonus and you can't be knocked prone. Awakened: +2, creatures you shove take 2d6 force, and when a creature within 5 feet misses you, you can shove it as a reaction. Exalted: +3, shoves can push 15 feet, and as a bonus action grant an ally within 5 feet +3 AC until your next turn starts or they move away.

magic-item:inescapable-lash.description: A barbed bronze-gleaming whip with +1 to attack and damage and 20-foot reach. When you hit a creature or object, you can try to grapple it as a bonus action. While grappling with it, use your action to pull the creature up to 20 feet toward you or restrain it until you let go; it escapes with an Athletics or Acrobatics check as an action against DC 8 + your proficiency bonus + Strength modifier.

magic-item:kiss-of-the-changebringer.attunementNote: Vestige; dormant, awakened and exalted states
magic-item:kiss-of-the-changebringer.description: An emerald amulet on a silver chain. Dormant: +1 to saving throws and immunity to grappled. Awakened: +2, immunity to restrained, and once per long rest cast blink on yourself as an action. Exalted: +3, immunity to paralyzed and petrified, and once per short or long rest roll an extra d20 for an attack, check or save before the outcome and use either.

magic-item:magician-s-judge.description: An Age of Arcanum executioner's greatsword. Once per dawn, cast dispel magic from it on a creature you hit as part of the attack, or on any target as an action, using a +3 modifier or your spellcasting modifier, whichever is higher, for any check.

magic-item:mirror-of-infinite-transponde.description: Paired silver hand mirrors. As an action, one opens a two-way visual window to its twin for 10 minutes, even across planes; the link can be activated three times per dawn from either end. The GM decides who holds a lone mirror's twin.

magic-item:mythcarver.attunementNote: Bard; longsword; Vestige; dormant, awakened and exalted states
magic-item:mythcarver.description: The silvered longsword of master bards, resonating with music. Dormant: +1 to attack and damage and the finesse property; targeting an ally with Bardic Inspiration gives you advantage on its attacks until the end of your turn. Awakened: +2, an extra 1d6 force on a hit, and an enemy you target with Bardic Inspiration has disadvantage on its next save. Exalted: +3, and once per long rest as an action make 4 melee attacks with it, then gain 1 level of exhaustion.

magic-item:oceanic-weapon.description: A dolphin-engraved ranged or thrown weapon with +1 to attack and damage that ignores underwater ranged penalties. Holding it ahead with both hands gives a 30-foot swimming speed, and once per dawn you can cast water breathing from it as an action.

magic-item:plate-of-the-dawnmartyr.attunementNote: Plate; Vestige; dormant, awakened and exalted states
magic-item:plate-of-the-dawnmartyr.description: Ruby-studded brass-and-gold plate. Dormant: +1 AC, and when a creature within 5 feet hits you in melee, you can use your reaction to deal it 1d6 fire. Awakened: +2 AC, immunity to frightened, fire resistance, and the rebuke deals 2d6. Exalted: +3 AC, the rebuke can be fire or radiant, and once per long rest when dropped to 0 hit points you regain 1, stand, and enemies within 10 feet take 2d6 fire or radiant.

magic-item:pyremaul.attunementNote: Maul; Vestige; dormant, awakened and exalted states
magic-item:pyremaul.description: A red-iron maul set with a burning fire opal. Dormant: +1 to attack rolls, an extra 1d6 fire on a hit, and optional bright light 30 feet and dim light 30 feet beyond. Awakened: +2 to attack, 2d6 fire, once per short or long rest slam it to cast burning hands at 2nd level (DC 15), and critical hits force a DC 15 Strength save or prone. Exalted: +3, 3d6 fire, burning hands at 3rd level (DC 17), the prone DC is 17 and criticals add 3d6 fire, and once per 7 days when you kill a creature you can take 10d10 unreducible fire damage (dying at 0) to turn it to ash, restorable only by true resurrection or wish.

magic-item:raven-s-slumber.description: A black crystal pendant holding a pocket dimension. Make a melee or ranged attack with it as an improvised weapon against a Large or smaller creature; on a hit it makes a DC 10 Wisdom save (willing creatures can fail) or is trapped inside, aware and seeing out. It holds one creature, released within 5 feet as a bonus action. Your class-granted or tamed companion dropped to 0 hit points within 100 feet is drawn in and stabilized if it is empty.

magic-item:rod-of-mercurial-form.description: A steel rod monogrammed T.D. As a bonus action, name any simple or martial weapon and it becomes an ordinary one of that type; as a ranged weapon it makes its own vanishing ammunition.

magic-item:skysail.description: Air Ashari bat-like wings on a sturdy pole. Riding it with wings open, you glide with a 60-foot flying speed, descending at least 10 feet per turn and unable to climb. Once per dawn (or when recharged by powerful elemental air magic), cast fly on yourself as an action for 1 minute without concentration, ending if you lose contact. Retracted, the pole serves as a quarterstaff.

magic-item:spire-of-conflux.attunementNote: Spellcaster; Vestige; dormant, awakened and exalted states
magic-item:spire-of-conflux.description: The Ashari leaders' relic staff. Dormant: 8 charges (1d4 + 2 at dawn) to cast burning hands (1) or fireball (3), and +1 to spell attacks and spell save DC. Awakened: 12 charges (1d6 + 2), adds conjure elemental (5) and ice storm (4), and you reroll 1s on damage dice for bludgeoning, cold, fire, lightning or thunder spells. Exalted: 20 charges (1d6 + 4), adds chain lightning (6) and fire storm (7), and the spell bonus becomes +2.

magic-item:star-razor.attunementNote: Longsword; Vestige; dormant, awakened and exalted states
magic-item:star-razor.description: A rune-etched silver longsword, also called Dwueth'var. Dormant: as a bonus action speak its command word to glow (bright 20 feet, dim 20 more); while glowing it has +1 to attack and damage and you resist radiant damage; cast faerie fire (DC 13) from it once per dawn. Awakened: +2, when hit in melee from within 5 feet use your reaction for a 1d8 radiant burst against the attacker, cast see invisibility once per dawn, and spell DC 15. Exalted: +3, the burst deals 1d12 and lets you teleport 15 feet, cast fly once per dawn, and spell DC 17.

magic-item:stormrider-boots.description: Plain-looking boots with storm-cloud soles. Once per dawn, activate them as part of your movement: until the end of your turn you have a 90-foot flying speed, opportunity attacks against you have disadvantage, and a hostile creature you move within 5 feet of makes a DC 15 Dexterity save or takes 3d8 lightning (once per creature per turn).

magic-item:summer-s-dance.description: A flexing golden scimitar with +1 to attack and damage and 3 charges, regaining 1 at dawn; spend 1 as a bonus action to cast misty step.

magic-item:tinkertop-boltblaster-1000.description: A Hupperdook-made geared hand crossbow with +1 to attack and damage. On a natural 20 you can immediately attack again after the critical hit; on a natural 1 you make a DC 14 Dexterity save or take 1d6 piercing from loose gears.

magic-item:titanstone-knuckles.attunementNote: Vestige; dormant, awakened and exalted states
magic-item:titanstone-knuckles.description: Gauntlets carved from an earth primordial's heartstone. Dormant: your Strength becomes 22 and your weapon attacks deal double damage to objects and structures. Awakened: Strength 24, and once per long rest cast enlarge (from enlarge/reduce) on yourself for 10 minutes as an action. Exalted: Strength 26, and while enlarged this way you resist cold, fire, lightning and thunder damage.

magic-item:whisper.attunementNote: Dagger; Vestige; dormant, awakened and exalted states
magic-item:whisper.description: A shimmering dagger of otherworldly metal with two raven feathers on its pommel. Dormant: +1 to attack and damage, and a critical hit forces a DC 13 Wisdom save or frightened of you for 1 minute (24-hour immunity on a success). Awakened: +2, an extra 1d6 psychic on a hit, and the fear DC is 15. Exalted: +3, 1d8 psychic, fear DC 17, and when you throw it you can merge with it, appearing within 5 feet of the target on a hit or where it lands on a miss, dagger in hand.

magic-item:wraps-of-dyamak.attunementNote: Monk; Vestige; dormant, awakened and exalted states
magic-item:wraps-of-dyamak.description: Blood-crimson hand wraps. Dormant: +1 to unarmed strike attack and damage, and after a short or long rest you gain temporary hit points equal to your total ki points. Awakened: +2, and cast misty step as a bonus action, recharging on a short or long rest or an unarmed critical hit against a hostile creature. Exalted: +3, and once per long rest (or after an unarmed critical hit) make a ravenous strike dealing an extra 6d6 necrotic and healing you that much.

magic-item:blade-of-the-wood.description: An etched sword humming with life, with +1 to attack and damage and 2 charges (regains 1 at dawn). Spend a charge and speak its command word to cast spike growth (DC 16) centered on yourself; you pass through it unharmed.

magic-item:feathered-helm.description: A helm bearing a birdfolk's gifted feather, with 3 charges (regains 1d3 at dawn); powers depend on the giver. Corvum: hideous laughter (1) or detect thoughts (2). Gallus: bless (1) or aid (2). Luma: a random 1st-level sorcerer spell (1), then roll a d20; on a 20 the charge isn't spent, on a 1 the spell also targets you (or fizzles if you were its only target). Raptor: hunter's mark (1) or magic weapon (2). Strig: divine favor (1) or pass without trace (2). Spell save DC 16.

magic-item:necronomicon-ex-corvis.description: The mad corvum Lathrus's spellbook of necromancy. A week of study raises your Intelligence by 2 and lowers your Wisdom by 1. Once per week, a minute-long ritual summons 1d4 + 2 loyal shadows. You can copy animate dead, bestow curse, vampiric touch, blight, circle of death, magic jar and finger of death into your spellbook before you can cast them, paying in blood (1 damage and 1 level of exhaustion) instead of gold. After copying a spell, make a DC 16 Wisdom save or be cursed (as bestow curse, GM's choice) for 2d4 days, resetting with each copy, unless ended by remove curse at 5th level or higher. Removed pages lose their magic in a day, and 8 hours of sunlight destroys its magic.

magic-item:nest-charm.description: A metal-branch sphere. Once per dawn, set it down and speak its command word: it unfolds into a 30-foot-diameter woven platform raised 50 feet on a magic tree, carrying passengers, for up to 8 hours or until dismissed by command word.

magic-item:red-feather-bow.description: A mistral raptor hunting bow with +1 to attack and damage and 3 charges (regains 1d3 at dawn). After firing, speak the command word and spend a charge as a bonus action to see from where the arrow lands for 1 minute, or through the eyes of a creature it strikes.

magic-item:the-borealus.description: A numbingly cold staff carved from an ancient frost aspect's finger. While attuned you resist fire, are immune to cold and know ray of frost. Breath of Winter (once per dawn): as an action, a 100-foot cone of hoarfrost deals 9d8 cold (DC 18 Constitution save for half). Glacial Prison (once per 3 days): as an action, touch it to a surface to create wall of ice as a 6th-level spell at a point within 200 feet (DC 18). A boreal wind within 30 feet of you snuffs nonmagical flames. Only flames of an equally powerful fire elemental can destroy it, over centuries.

magic-item:wing-crest-shield.description: A shield granting +1 AC beyond its normal bonus. Once per dawn, speak its command word as an action to cast gust of wind (DC 15).

magic-item:ale-seed.description: When thrown, it becomes a 4-gallon cask of wholesome ale with four tankards. Illusion seed: throw it at least 5 feet away to trigger it; outside the Shadow Realm the effect lasts 2d12 hours, and dispel magic (DC 13) unravels it.

magic-item:armor-of-the-black-river.description: Heavy armor granting +1 AC and immunity to shadow corruption and void taint. Once per dawn, as an action, you and up to ten creatures you touch take ghostly form for 10 minutes (200-foot flying speed, movement only). Paired with Styx boots, once per week you can walk a planar waterway for 8 hours as a shadow road to any plane.

magic-item:armor-of-the-white-rose.description: Heavy armor that makes you immune to necrotic and cold damage but vulnerable to fire and radiant. Your melee hits deal an extra 3d6 necrotic and heal you 3d6; healing above your maximum gives you a level of exhaustion and shuts off the effect until the next dawn.

magic-item:bearskin-cloak.description: As an action, take the form of a brown bear, gaining its attacks (including Multiattack), AC and speeds while keeping your ability scores, hit points and saves.

magic-item:blade-of-grass.attunementNote: Druid or Cleric; sword or axe
magic-item:blade-of-grass.description: A sword or axe with 7 charges, all regained on a short or long rest. As a bonus action, spend 1 to grow a 10-foot-radius thicket that is difficult terrain and gives cover from ranged attacks, lasting until you speak the command word again.

magic-item:bonfire-seed.description: When thrown, it becomes a 5-foot roaring bonfire lasting 1d4 hours. Thrown at an occupied space, make a ranged attack: on a miss the creature knocks it aside; on a hit, a creature in the fire takes 2d6 fire at the start of its turn. Illusion seed: throw it at least 5 feet away to trigger it; outside the Shadow Realm the effect lasts 2d12 hours, and dispel magic (DC 13) unravels it.

magic-item:book-of-ebon-tides.description: A twilight-hued shadow weave tome that opens only for wizards, elves and shadow fey, with 15 charges (regains 2d6 + 3 before dawn; on spending the last, a d20 roll of 1 ends its spells). Ebon Tides: after 100 hours of study, spend 5 charges and 1 minute to reshape nearby natural Shadow Realm terrain, with an Arcana check against DC 8 to 22 setting the scale (from hiding a trail to raising a mountain); a 1 summons a hostile overshadow, a 20 allows two effects. Shadow Lore: 10 minutes of research doubles your proficiency (or grants it) on Arcana, History and Religion about the Shadow Realm for 24 hours. Spells: cloak of shadow (1), darkness (2), mirror image (2), phantasmal killer (4), see invisibility (2), seeming (5), shadow gateway (5), shadow step (4) or slither (2), plus douse light and minor illusion at will. Retributive Shadows: tear it in half to release four spreading cubes of creeping darkness dealing an extra 1d6 necrotic per remaining charge.

magic-item:boots-of-dancing.description: You leap 10 feet vertically without effort and take no damage from falls up to 30 feet. Paired with a ring of dancing, you have advantage on Charisma checks.

magic-item:boots-of-shadow-walking.description: Your overland travel pace, including on shadow roads, is doubled; combat speed is unchanged.

magic-item:bridge-seed.description: When thrown, it becomes a wooden bridge on stone piers spanning up to 40 feet; a creature in the space ends up safely on the deck. It can be flooded out or burned. Illusion seed: throw it at least 5 feet away to trigger it; outside the Shadow Realm the effect lasts 2d12 hours, and dispel magic (DC 13) unravels it.

magic-item:cloak-of-splendor.description: An ermine cloak trimmed with sun and candle motifs. Once per day, grip its edges to cast sunbeam, which ends if you let go. Once per day, as an action, create 10 lantern-bright sunlight orbs (20-foot radius) that you can move 60 feet as a bonus action, each within 30 feet of another and winking out beyond 100 feet from you.

magic-item:cloak-of-the-raven.description: You have advantage on Perception checks. In dim light or sunlight, grip its edges with both hands to fly at 30 feet, losing flight if you let go or leave such light. Once per dawn, in dim light or sunlight, cast daylight as a readied action and carry it into darkness.

magic-item:collapsible-mountain.description: A 4-inch statuette of a forested peak. As an action, speak its command word to raise a 2,500-foot pine-covered mountain under you (scattering nearby creatures 2d6 x 100 feet apart and ending combat between non-adjacent creatures) or under a visible creature at least 120 feet away. It provides food and water for 15 humanoids or five steeds daily. Speaking the word again collapses it safely; unaware combatants are treated as surprised.

magic-item:crown-of-infinite-midnight.description: A helm set with 1d12 sapphires, 2d12 black opals and 3d12 obsidians, which crumble if pried out; it loses its magic when all are gone. As an action, spend a gem to cast darkness (obsidian), vampiric touch (black opal) or wall of ice (sapphire) at DC 17. With a sapphire left, you have blindsight 120 feet and living creatures starting their turn there take 1d6 necrotic; with a black opal, necrotic resistance; with an obsidian, as an action wreathe a held weapon in black flame for an extra 1d6 fire. If you fail a save against a necrotic spell, roll a d20; on a 1 it bursts, and creatures within 60 feet make a DC 17 Dexterity save or take necrotic damage equal to its gems.

magic-item:dragon-seed.description: When thrown, it becomes a friendly illusory dragon (rolled on a d20 table, from lantern dragonette to adult red dragon) that keeps you company and defends itself and possibly you for 24 hours. After each further 24 hours, make a Charisma save (DC 8 to 22 by dragon); on a failure it vanishes. Illusion seed: throw it at least 5 feet away to trigger it; outside the Shadow Realm the effect lasts 2d12 hours, and dispel magic (DC 13) unravels it.

magic-item:earrings-of-eclipse.description: Smoky quartz earrings. While motionless in dim light or darkness, you can Hide even when seen or unobscured, with advantage in darkness; any action other than staying still reveals you.

magic-item:ebony-beetle-armor.description: Medium or heavy darakhul armor of carrion beetle chitin at half the usual weight. It has no Stealth disadvantage or Strength requirement, and you are immune to slashing damage while wearing it.

magic-item:emerald-goblet.description: A silver goblet with an emerald cup that turns any liquid into a green potion. Drinking from it protects against shadow corruption for a day and grants advantage on Survival checks to forage in the Shadow Realm and darkvision 30 feet (or +30 feet).

magic-item:fey-blade.description: A sword or axe so light and compact it fits a dagger sheath, even if two-handed or a polearm; draw or sheathe it as a bonus action.

magic-item:forest-seed.description: When thrown, it becomes a forest scaled by a Nature or Survival check: a 50-foot copse (10 or less), a 500-foot pine grove with a secret path (11-15), a mile-wide mixed forest with hidden paths and wildlife (16-19), or a 50-mile woodland with a friendly treant (20+). Burning a whole tree in it within its first month turns it all to smoke in 10 minutes. Illusion seed: throw it at least 5 feet away to trigger it; outside the Shadow Realm the effect lasts 2d12 hours, and dispel magic (DC 13) unravels it.

magic-item:frostglow-weapon.description: A mithral rapier or dagger that sheds chilling blue light on command. Once per dawn, as a bonus action, speak its command word: creatures within 30 feet make a DC 15 Constitution save, becoming paralyzed on a failure or having speed 0 on a success, until the start of your next turn.

magic-item:ghost-armor.description: Light or medium armor. As a bonus action, speak its command word to move incorporeally for 1 round, passing through creatures and objects as difficult terrain (5 (1d10) force if you end your turn inside an object). Usable a number of rounds per day equal to your level.

magic-item:gloves-of-the-walking-shade.description: Black-ivory ring gloves chained to onyx cuffs. You resist necrotic damage, can spend a Hit Die on a short rest to remove a level of exhaustion instead of healing, and once per nightfall can become a living shadow as an action, squeezing through 1-inch gaps and Hiding as a bonus action in dim light or darkness.

magic-item:glowstone-helmet.description: A gnomish helm that lets you cast its particular cantrip (often dancing lights, light, mending or produce flame) as an action. With a frostglow weapon or find the path, you sense the direction and distance to the nearest ley line, shadow road or similar arcane landmark.

magic-item:hecate-s-dagger.description: An adamantine dagger etched with moon phases and a +3 bonus to attack and damage. Speaking Hecate's name while wielding it gives your counterspell rolls advantage. Once per day each, cast geas on a cleric, paladin or devout follower of Hecate, and cast ebon tide or dimension door.

magic-item:hecate-s-lantern.description: A gold and mithral lantern whose ever-burning candle looks like three. Brandishing it, use its 12 charges (regains 1d12 + 1 at dawn; on spending the last, a d20 roll of 1 returns it to Hecate): create a 40-foot shadow mire around you (5), force a visible shapeshifter within 120 feet to change form, DC 13 Charisma save if unwilling (3), or cast moonbeam at any visible point (2) or child of light and darkness (8).

magic-item:instant-door.description: An ornate copper key. Turn it to open a door through a wall up to 5 feet thick within 5 feet, lasting until you remove it; turn it the other way to seal a nonmagical door into matching wall.

magic-item:knightly-seed.description: Crack and throw it with an Athletics or Acrobatics check; a knight and steed appear to serve you for a week and a day (as squire if you are already a knight): a knight with warhorse (10 or less), green knight of the woods (11-15), wyvern knight on a war wyvern (16-19) or infernal knight on a nightmare (20+). Illusion seed: throw it at least 5 feet away to trigger it; outside the Shadow Realm the effect lasts 2d12 hours, and dispel magic (DC 13) unravels it.

magic-item:labyrinth-rope.description: On command, this rope slithers at 20 feet per round toward the nearest exit of a maze or dungeon for 1 hour, then coils up and waits.

magic-item:lunar-lances.description: Weightless, dagger-sharp shadow goblin polearms that add 10 feet to your reach when attacking with them.

magic-item:messenger-owl-seed.description: When thrown, it becomes an owl (Intelligence 14, speaks Common and Umbral) that carries a spoken message and up to 1 pound up to 30 miles to a named person, title or place, then waits up to 4 hours for a reply before returning or vanishing. Illusion seed: throw it at least 5 feet away to trigger it; outside the Shadow Realm the effect lasts 2d12 hours, and dispel magic (DC 13) unravels it.

magic-item:midnight-armor.description: Light or hide armor of pure shadow, invisible in sunlight, granting +1 AC, radiant resistance and advantage on Stealth checks.

magic-item:moonbeam-chain-mail.description: Bearfolk chain mail of woven moonlight that weighs 5 pounds and always glows. It grants +1 AC (+2 in moonlight) and an extra use of Wild Shape, and you count as proficient with it.

magic-item:mooncatcher-s-net.description: A tough net with +1 to attack rolls. Escaping takes a DC 16 Strength check or 15 slashing damage; it has AC 14 and 25 hit points, regaining 1 every 5 minutes unless destroyed. Dragged through dark water, it gathers 1d4 random memory fragments (d10 table), each usable to make a memory philter; transferring each needs a DC 15 Sleight of Hand check.

magic-item:moonseeker-s-lantern-of-safe-.description: A crystal and silver-woven iron lantern. On command it floats beside you shedding bright light 30 feet and dim light 30 more; you and companions within 30 feet can't be surprised unless incapacitated by more than natural sleep. In the Shadow Realm it points toward Corremel, City of Lanterns.

magic-item:moonsteel-weapon.description: A softly shining rapier or dagger dealing an extra 1d6 radiant. A creature hit while not in its true form is frightened until the start of your next turn and must make a DC 13 Charisma save at the start of its turn or revert to its true form.

magic-item:moonstone-banded-armor.description: Glowing shadow goblin heavy armor of woven moonlight at half the usual weight, granting advantage on saves against spells and effects involving radiant, cold or necrotic damage.

magic-item:orchard-seed.description: When thrown, it becomes a ripe orchard scaled by a Nature or Survival check: two nut trees (10 or less), 1d6 + 4 fruit trees giving a day's nourishment (11-15), 3d6 trees whose fruit acts as goodberry, healing up to 10 total (16-19), or 3d12 trees whose fruit nourishes, acts as a long rest and heals up to 10 per creature on the first day (20+). Burning a whole tree within its first month unravels it. Illusion seed: throw it at least 5 feet away to trigger it; outside the Shadow Realm the effect lasts 2d12 hours, and dispel magic (DC 13) unravels it.

magic-item:philter-of-boundless-joy.description: A memory philter of pure happiness. You gain advantage on Charisma checks for 1 hour and the benefits of a short rest. It cancels a philter of deep despair.

magic-item:philter-of-deep-despair.description: A memory philter of heart-rending grief. For 1 hour you have advantage on Wisdom saves but can't take bonus actions. It cancels a philter of boundless joy.

magic-item:philter-of-enchanted-fortune.description: A memory philter of staggering success. You have advantage on your next three ability checks, attack rolls or saving throws, including death saves.

magic-item:philter-of-innocence.description: A memory philter of childhood. For 1 hour you resist psychic damage and have advantage on Constitution checks.

magic-item:philter-of-loving-kindness.description: A memory philter of love and acceptance. For 1 hour you can't be affected by enchantment spells.

magic-item:philter-of-lust.description: A memory philter of consuming desire. Make a DC 13 Wisdom save or for 1 minute you single-mindedly pursue a person or object you crave (save at the end of each turn); on a success you receive only the memories.

magic-item:philter-of-mercy.description: A memory philter of forgiveness. For 1 hour you are immune to being frightened and have advantage on Wisdom checks. It cancels a philter of righteous anger.

magic-item:philter-of-righteous-anger.description: A memory philter of betrayal and injustice. Make a DC 13 Wisdom save or rage for 1 minute (save at the end of each turn): advantage on melee attacks and an extra 3 (1d6) melee weapon damage, but you must attack the nearest creature, friend or foe, or Dash toward one. On a success you receive only the memories. It cancels a philter of mercy.

magic-item:philter-of-waking-dreams.description: A memory philter of a pivotal scene. You can take no action for 1 round, then permanently remember the scene and anyone in it by face and name; a DC 13 Insight check reveals relationships, status and location within it. It can't create false memories.

magic-item:quickstep-weapon.description: A rapier or dagger. When a visible creature targets you with an attack, use your reaction to move 5 feet without provoking opportunity attacks; if that takes you out of its reach, the attack has disadvantage.

magic-item:rain-and-thunder-seed.description: Thrown outdoors, it gives you control of the weather within 5 miles for 1d8 hours, shifting precipitation, temperature and wind within 30 minutes, but only ever toward worse weather. Its lightning won't strike near you but isn't yours to direct. Control weather or counterspell ends it. Illusion seed: throw it at least 5 feet away to trigger it; outside the Shadow Realm the effect lasts 2d12 hours, and dispel magic (DC 13) unravels it.

magic-item:rattling-armor.description: Splint armor of humanoid bones that grants necrotic resistance. Once per dawn, cast fear as an action.

magic-item:ring-of-dancing.description: Your performances are thrilling; you have advantage on Persuasion checks with fey, giants and humanoids who watched you perform within 24 hours. With boots of dancing, you instead have advantage on all Charisma checks.

magic-item:ring-of-daylight.description: 3 charges, regaining 1d3 at dawn. On command, spend one to shed bright light 60 feet and dim light 60 more for 1 hour (blocked by covering your hand), dispelling overlapping darkness spells of 3rd level or lower. Your attacks deal radiant damage instead of their normal type.

magic-item:ring-of-the-ghouls.description: 3 charges, regaining 1d3 at dawn. When you hit with a melee attack, use your reaction and a charge: the target makes a DC 13 Constitution save or is paralyzed until the end of its next turn.

magic-item:ring-of-winter-s-kiss.description: When you take cold damage, on your next turn you can make a +7 attack against a creature within 30 feet; on a hit it takes the same cold damage.

magic-item:road-seed.description: Thrown outdoors, it builds a well-made road up to 5 miles long through any terrain, with one bridge up to 50 feet and causeways or levelling for one difficult section; with a tavern seed it doubles in length. Earthquake removes it. Illusion seed: throw it at least 5 feet away to trigger it; outside the Shadow Realm the effect lasts 2d12 hours, and dispel magic (DC 13) unravels it.

magic-item:road-warden-shield.description: On command, it seals a stretch of shadow road into a loop: walkers return to their start after 120 feet until one steps off the path, the shield is destroyed or you repeat the command.

magic-item:scepter-weapon.description: A club, hammer, mace or staff. As a bonus action, speak its command word to shine a harsh purple light that gives advantage on Intimidation with beasts, dragons, fey, giants, humanoids and monstrosities. Anything you strike glows (dim light 10 feet), giving seeing attackers advantage against it and negating invisibility.

magic-item:sealskin-cloak.description: As an action, take the form of a seal with a 1d8 piercing bite, AC 12 and 40-foot swim speed, keeping your ability scores, hit points and saves.

magic-item:serpent-hide.description: Hide armor. On command, take the form of a giant constrictor snake for as long as you like; once you revert, you can't do so again until after a long rest.

magic-item:shadow-portal-scroll.description: A glowing-lettered black leather invitation from a Shadow Realm arcanist. Reading it transports all creatures within 10 feet of you to the Shadow Realm, usually near its maker.

magic-item:shield-of-blinding.description: On command, a visible creature in range makes a Constitution save or is blinded for 1 minute (save at the end of each turn).

magic-item:shield-of-crows.description: On command, it summons a raven swarm that scouts, warns of enemies and keeps watch for up to 12 hours but won't fight. It recharges when you leave food on it during a short rest. While holding it you can speak with corvids.

magic-item:shield-of-dawn-s-herald.description: 3 charges, regaining 1d3 at dawn. Spend 1 to project a 10-foot-wide, 120-foot-long beam for up to 1 minute (concentration) that shows creatures in their true forms, defeating shapeshifting and illusory disguises; undead in it take 1d6 radiant each round.

magic-item:shield-of-otters.description: On command, it summons two otters (giant weasel statistics) that scout waterways, warn of enemies and keep watch for up to 12 hours but won't fight. It recharges when you leave fish or shellfish on it during a short rest. While holding it you can speak with otters, seals and other aquatic mammals.

magic-item:shield-of-swans.description: 3 charges, regaining 1d3 at dawn. On command, spend 1 to gain a 60-foot fly speed for 1d4 rounds (you know when it will end). While holding it you can speak with swans and other waterfowl.

magic-item:staff-of-radiance.description: A bleached yarrow staff flecked with golden light. While holding it you resist radiant damage. 10 charges (regains 1d6 + 4 at dawn; on spending the last, a d20 roll of 1 turns it to fireflies): burning radiance (4), daylight (2), searing sun (3) or sunburst (5), plus douse light and light at will.

magic-item:staff-of-the-void.description: A gnarled ironwood staff with writhing purple motes. While holding it you resist psychic damage. 10 charges (regains 1d6 + 4 at midnight; on spending the last, a d20 roll of 1 destroys it): life drain (5), living shadows (4), maddening whispers (2) or void strike (3), plus word of misfortune at will.

magic-item:stallion-seed.description: When thrown, it becomes a swift courser (Intelligence 14, speaks Common and Umbral) that carries you up to 30 miles to a named place or along a route. In combat it acts as a warhorse and flees with you at the first chance. Illusion seed: throw it at least 5 feet away to trigger it; outside the Shadow Realm the effect lasts 2d12 hours, and dispel magic (DC 13) unravels it.

magic-item:styx-boots.description: Heavy planar-hide boots. You walk on water as normal ground and slide over calm water, snow, ice, sand, magma or other smooth surfaces at double speed (triple downhill on snow or ice). Paired with Armor of the Black River, once per week you can walk a planar waterway for 8 hours as a shadow road to any plane.

magic-item:tavern-seed.description: Thrown outdoors (or into a settlement, nudging neighbors aside), it creates a snug 40-by-20-foot regional-style tavern with one room for rent and a staff of three locals; with a road seed it also has secure stables. Illusion seed: throw it at least 5 feet away to trigger it; outside the Shadow Realm the effect lasts 2d12 hours, and dispel magic (DC 13) unravels it.

magic-item:trickster-s-boots.description: Brightly colored boots that let you leave the tracks of any creature, or of footwear you have seen, in snow.

magic-item:umbral-armor.description: Dull grey armor that trails obscuring shadows: tracking you and ranged attacks against you have disadvantage. In bright light these effects end and attacks against you gain +2.

magic-item:unerring-dowsing-rod.description: A dark forked willow root. Held in both hands, it tugs you toward the nearest fresh water, dipping above underground sources; in the Shadow Realm it may lead to water barrels or creatures carrying water.

magic-item:wand-of-shadows.description: 5 charges (regains 1d6 + 1 at midnight; on spending the last, a d20 roll of 1 destroys it). While holding it you have advantage on Stealth against sighted creatures. As an action, spend 1 or more charges to cast darkbolt (DC 15) at 2nd level, plus one level per extra charge.

magic-item:wand-of-tides.description: 5 charges (regains 1d4 + 1 at midnight; on spending the last, a d20 roll of 1 destroys it). While holding it you can't be paralyzed. As an action, spend charges to fill the space around you with shadows for 3 rounds: creatures moving toward you treat it as difficult terrain, and attacks against you have disadvantage.

magic-item:whispering-cloak.description: A bat-pelt cloak granting blindsight 60 feet. Raising the hood (an action) turns you to shadow for up to 1 hour per dusk, spent in 1-minute increments: +2 AC, advantage on Stealth, squeezing through 1-inch gaps and normal spellcasting, but no nonmagical weapon attacks and no picking up or handing over objects.

magic-item:wine-of-the-starry-void.description: Roll 10d20 and record them; you must use these results, in any order, for your next ten ability checks, attack rolls, saves or death saves before rolling normally again.

magic-item:wine-of-the-summer-court.description: A rose-tinted white wine that evaporates within an hour of opening. For 1 hour you have advantage on Charisma checks and can reroll one failed ability check, attack roll or save.

magic-item:wine-of-the-winter-court.description: A syrupy near-black wine of heartbreak. For 1 hour you have disadvantage on Charisma checks but are immune to being charmed and add your proficiency bonus to Wisdom saves (doubled if already proficient).

magic-item:witchlight-scimitar.description: As a bonus action, speak its command word to make it blaze with golden light (bright 30 feet, dim 30 more) and deal an extra 2d6 radiant on hits, until you repeat the command or drop or sheathe it.

magic-item:wolfskin-cloak.description: As an action, take the form of a dire wolf, gaining its bite, speed, AC and Keen Hearing and Smell while keeping your ability scores, hit points and saves.

magic-item:chitinous-club-of-c-naazo.description: A chitin club from the monstrosity c'Naazo, glowing with green magic. You have a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. Venomous Spray: as an action, each creature in a 15-foot cone makes a DC 14 Dexterity save, taking 10 (3d6) poison damage on a failure or half as much on a success; once per short or long rest.

magic-item:combined-mirror-shards.description: When all five of the Dusk Queen's mirror shards are stacked together, anyone holding them can cast sacred flame three times per day as an 11th-level caster, or instead once per day cast a sacred flame that deals maximum damage (24) and imposes disadvantage on the save for creatures vulnerable to radiant damage. Each shard is quasi-intelligent and urges its bearer toward the Queen's Tower, forcing compliance on a failed DC 11 Wisdom save. A shard has AC 13, 5 (2d4) hit points, and damage threshold 20.

magic-item:goblin-chisel.description: A chisel of hardened grick beak. While using it, your proficiency bonus is doubled for ability checks that use your proficiency with mason's tools or woodcarver's tools.

magic-item:liliana-s-rose.description: A blood-red crystal rose on a green-gold stem. While carrying it: Rose of Radiance, it sheds candlelight that you can adjust from off to hooded-lantern brightness as a bonus action. Not Yet My Love, as an action you touch a creature and cast spare the dying at will. Shared Suffering, as a bonus action you prick yourself for 7 (2d6) damage, then as an action touch a creature to heal it 2d6 or grant that many temporary hit points (you can't heal the self-inflicted damage until those are spent); once per long rest. Inspiration of the Muse, as an action you give one creature inspiration that expires at your next long rest; once per long rest.

magic-item:night-messenger-s-coat.description: A long black woolen coat embroidered with shadowy horses. While wearing it, you can cast find steed at will to summon the same shadow-touched fey mount (it vanishes if you remove the coat, and find steed from other sources fails), you can see witchlight trails, you have advantage on Wisdom (Survival) checks to navigate the Shadow Realm, and you have advantage on saves against shadow corruption.

magic-item:painted-stones.description: Magic stones from the Whispering Plains that lose their magic if removed. Each has one charge, spent as a bonus action; only one stone affects a creature at a time. Puce: weapon attacks deal extra fire damage equal to twice your proficiency bonus for 1 minute. Indigo: invisible for 1 minute until you attack or cast. Violet: you and one willing creature within 30 feet are immune to charmed and frightened for 1 minute. Slate: attacks against you have disadvantage for 1 minute. Mustard: enhance ability with two effects for 1 hour, no concentration. Juniper: a shield with hit points equal to five times your proficiency bonus for 1 minute. Umber: for 1 minute, as a reaction fling a spike that auto-hits a target within 60 feet for force damage equal to your proficiency bonus. Bone: for 1 minute, regain hit points equal to your proficiency bonus each time you damage a creature with a weapon or spell attack.

magic-item:shadow-grimoire.description: A sentient neutral fabled spellbook bound in nightmare hide (Int 15, Wis 15, Cha 14; AC 15, 20 hit points; telepathy 60 feet; Common and Umbral). Unattuned, it grants advantage on checks about shadow magic and the Shadow Realm. It can Shadow Jump 60 feet between shadows 3/day, takes 1d8 radiant per minute in sunlight, and holds a glyph of warding (DC 13, 5d8 cold in a 20-foot radius) once per dusk; it can try to charm its owner (Charisma save DC 12 + its Charisma modifier). Attuned: at 5th level it is a spellbook of Deep Magic shadow spells with a rotating scroll page usable 3 times per dusk; at 9th level you gain 30-foot darkvision (or see in magical darkness) and the glyph improves to DC 14, 6d8; at 13th level you can shadow-step 200 feet as a bonus action and its statistics and glyph improve (DC 15, 7d8); at 17th level you can plane shift yourself and up to eight creatures to the Shadow Realm once per long rest and choose the scroll page.

magic-item:shroud-of-kairious.description: A brass censer that, on command, emits a 15-foot-radius jasmine vapor for 2 hours. Creatures inside are immune to temporal distortions and time-altering spells such as slow, haste, and time stop. Once per day while it emits vapor, you can use the command word to jump back 1 hour in time, which ends the vapor. It can't be used again until noon the next day.

magic-item:the-luminous-codex.description: A spellbook containing an archmage's spells plus fireball, sunbeam, sunburst, plane shift, demiplane, and imprisonment. While attuned, you know light and can cast daylight at will; once per short or long rest you can change a spell's damage type to radiant; and you are immune to radiant damage and ignore sunlight penalties.

magic-item:umbril-opal-necklace.description: A silver and black opal necklace. While attuned, your Charisma score increases by 2 and you have advantage on saving throws against being charmed.

magic-item:bloodsbane.description: A clear oil smelling of parchment and sulfur, activated by mixing in a component and a drop of a willing creature's blood over 1 minute. It coats one slashing or piercing weapon or up to 5 such pieces of ammunition. A creature hit must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or suffer the component's effect: mentha arvensis oil, zone of truth for 10 minutes; nightshade oil, paralyzed for 1 minute; bloodhound fur, the blood donor knows its direction and distance for 24 hours; rose oil, charmed by the blood donor for 1 hour. If the blood came from an illrigger, a failed save also places one of that illrigger's seals on the target (not counting against their Baleful Interdict).

magic-item:true-name.attunementNote: Requires attunement by an illrigger; any weapon
magic-item:true-name.description: A brimstone and obsidian weapon that takes your whispered true name in fading Infernal runes. When you roll an 18-20 on an attack with it and place a seal, you can place an additional seal. Rare: +1 to attack and damage rolls and seals deal an extra 1d6. Very rare: +2, seals deal an extra 2d6, and once per dusk you regain a seal when you reduce an enemy to 0 hit points. Legendary: +3, seals deal an extra 3d6, and once per dusk you regain two seals and gain temporary hit points equal to your illrigger level when you reduce an enemy to 0 hit points.

magic-item:abjurer-s-bangle.description: As an action you can clasp this bracelet onto or remove it from yourself or a willing creature within reach. It holds a ward with hit points by rarity: 30 (uncommon), 75 (rare), 120 (very rare). When the wearer takes damage, it can use its reaction and speak the command word so the ward takes the damage instead; excess damage carries over once the ward hits 0 hit points, and the bangle then becomes nonmagical.

magic-item:aciurgist-s-blade.attunementNote: Requires attunement by a paladin; glaive
magic-item:aciurgist-s-blade.description: While holding this glaive, your reach increases by 5 feet when you use Lay on Hands. Once on each of your turns when you spend a spell slot on Divine Smite with an attack using this glaive, you can apply one effect to the target until the start of your next turn, plus one more effect per slot level above 1st (each no more than once): disadvantage on its next attack roll; speed reduced by 10 feet; it takes an extra 1d8 necrotic or radiant damage (your choice) the next time it takes damage; the next attack against it has advantage; it can't regain hit points.

magic-item:acorn-charm.description: While wearing this charm, you have advantage on Charisma checks to interact with plants and can communicate with plant creatures as if you shared a language.

magic-item:adventurer-s-overcoat.description: While wearing this coat, you and friendly creatures within 5 feet of you have resistance to cold damage.

magic-item:aged-goodberry-wine.description: The bottle holds 8 servings, each taking 1 minute to drink. When you drink a serving, you can spend any number of Hit Dice to regain hit points as if you finished a short rest, regaining 1 extra hit point per Hit Die spent. A serving nourishes a creature for one day, and for the next hour you add 1d4 to your Wisdom and Charisma ability checks and saving throws.

magic-item:air-render.description: When you make a ranged attack with this bow, you can fire a mote of wind instead of an arrow, gaining a +1 bonus to the attack and damage rolls and choosing bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage. On a roll of 20 with a mote: bludgeoning forces a DC 15 Strength save or the target is knocked prone or pushed 15 feet (Huge or larger targets automatically succeed); piercing lets you immediately attack another creature within 15 feet of the target with the same mote (piercing damage); slashing forces each other creature within 5 feet of the target to make a DC 15 Dexterity save or take 2d6 slashing damage.

magic-item:alchemist-s-potion-belt.description: This belt holds up to two potions of any bottle size; attaching a bottle takes an action. While wearing it, you can drink a potion carried on it as a bonus action. When you roll a 1 on a Dexterity saving throw or are hit by a critical hit, roll a d20; on a 1, one carried bottle shatters and is destroyed.

magic-item:ambitious-medic-s-box.description: Anyone can use the box. From dawn until dusk its left side opens and works as a healer's kit, regaining all expended uses each dusk. From dusk until dawn its right side opens, holding three steins, a pipe refilled with tobacco at dusk, and a flask: as an action, speak its command word and a drink to fill it with up to 4 gallons of beer, 1 gallon of wine, or 8 ounces of whiskey (pours up to 1 gallon per minute), usable once until the next dusk. Each dawn the right side closes and its removed contents return. While attuned, you are proficient in Medicine (or double your proficiency bonus if already proficient) and can open either side at any time.

magic-item:amulet-of-buoyancy.description: While wearing this amulet, you can use your reaction to stand up immediately when knocked prone; your speed is then halved until the end of your next turn. If you start your turn underwater with 0 hit points, you immediately rise 60 feet toward the surface.

magic-item:amulet-of-immutability.description: While wearing this amulet, you have advantage on saving throws against transmutation spells of 5th level or lower that would transform or control you (such as enlarge/reduce, levitate, or slow). When targeted by polymorph, you can choose to automatically succeed on the saving throw.

magic-item:amulet-of-the-lycanthrope.description: If you aren't a lycanthrope, you can use a bonus action to take on bestial features of a bear, rat, tiger, or wolf for 1 minute (or until you drop to 0 hit points or revert as a bonus action). Your unarmed strikes become claws dealing 1d8 + Strength modifier slashing damage, and you have advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks relying on hearing or smell. This can't be used again for 12 hours or until the next dusk, whichever is sooner (6 hours if within 24 hours of a full moon). If you are a lycanthrope, your claw and bite attacks in animal or hybrid form deal an extra 1d8 necrotic damage and count as magical, and your bite save DC increases by 3. Curse: attuning curses you, giving disadvantage on saves against being cursed by lycanthropy.

magic-item:amulet-of-the-sentinel.description: The amulet has 8 charges and regains 1d6+2 daily at dawn. Alertness: when you roll initiative, use your reaction and 1 charge to add your proficiency bonus. Protection: when a creature you can see within 30 feet suffers a critical hit, use your reaction and 2 charges to make it a normal hit, canceling critical-hit effects. Vigilance: when creatures you can see within 30 feet must make a saving throw, use your reaction and 2 charges to give one of them advantage, plus one more creature per additional charge; you choose after seeing the roll but before the outcome is declared.

magic-item:amulet-of-the-spirit-naga.description: While wearing this pendant, you are immune to poison damage and the poisoned condition. If you die while wearing it, you return to life with half your hit points, with missing body parts restored and poisons and normal diseases cured (no effect if you die of old age); the amulet then loses this property.

magic-item:angler-s-armor.description: While wearing this armor, you gain a swimming speed of 30 feet and the normal and long ranges of nets are doubled for you. When you fish while wearing it, you catch twice as many fish as normal.

magic-item:angler-s-worldly-fisher.description: While holding this fishing rod, you can use an action to speak its command word and cast at a point within 30 feet that you can see; the line's end reappears in a random body of water elsewhere on the Material Plane, and fish caught appear at the point you cast to. You have advantage on ability checks to catch fish with this rod.

magic-item:life-turner.description: When a creature you can see within 120 feet dies, you can use your reaction to speak the command word and spin this hourglass, taking an extra turn immediately (interrupting the current one).
