Pinch: as an action expend 1; a creature within 60 feet makes a DC 16 Intelligence save, taking 3d4 psychic plus 3d4 force damage or half, with disadvantage on concentration saves from it. Taunt: as an action expend 1 to mime-slap a creature within 30 feet (DC 16 Wisdom save, 2d4 psychic plus 2d4 force damage and disadvantage on attacks against others until your next turn, or half and no disadvantage).

magic-item:gloves-of-the-great-badger.description: While wearing them, your unarmed strikes deal 1d4 + Strength modifier slashing damage, and you have a 5-foot burrowing speed. Once per dawn, as a bonus action for 1 minute: doubled burrowing speed through unworked stone, +1 to attack and damage rolls with unarmed strikes, and critical hits on a 19 or 20 with them.

magic-item:gnashing-key.description: Placed in a lock, it chews it apart over 1 minute (audible 90 feet), forcing it open. For a lock DC above 15, it has a chance equal to 5 times the difference to break first, jamming the lock.

magic-item:godsteel-warplate.description: On attunement and after each long rest, you gain 50 temporary hit points, lost if you remove it. You gain +1 AC, and resistance to nonmagical damage while you have temporary hit points.

magic-item:godsteel-worldcarver.description: You gain a +2 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. Hits deal an extra 1d8 radiant damage, and Small creatures suffer no heavy penalty with the greatsword form. As a bonus action store it in or summon it from an extradimensional space; it goes there on its own if more than 30 feet from you. On a 20, the target makes a DC 17 Charisma save or takes an extra 3d8 radiant damage and, if a creature, is incapacitated and banished until the start of your next turn (half damage and no banishment on a success); a cleric or paladin wielder and chosen creatures within 30 feet regain hit points equal to half that radiant damage.

magic-item:golem-sapper.description: As an action place it on a construct within reach: DC 18 Constitution save or 2d10 necrotic damage and stunned until your next turn, repeating the save each turn with the DC dropping by 2 each time (minimum 10). On a success it falls off, unusable for 1 hour. The DC recovers by 2 per 24 hours unused, up to 18.

magic-item:gorget-of-the-holy-soldier.attunementNote: Requires attunement by a creature of good alignment
magic-item:gorget-of-the-holy-soldier.description: While wearing it, you have resistance to radiant damage and a benefit for each class you have 10 or more levels in (an item-requirement-ignoring feature picks one on attunement). Barbarian: +2 Strength (maximum 26), and rage melee hits deal an extra 1d6 radiant. Bard: all languages, and Bardic Inspiration also heals twice your Charisma modifier. Cleric: commune, dispel evil and good, and raise dead always prepared; once per 7 days cast raise dead as an action without components, returning the target at half hit points. Druid: control weather and insect plague always prepared, and bonus-action wings granting a 60-foot fly speed. Fighter: immunity to charmed and frightened, resistance to nonmagical bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing. Monk: +10 feet speed, advantage against grapples, +2 AC unarmored. Paladin: Lay on Hands pool +10; spend 10 to end blindness, deafness, or paralysis, or 15 to remove a curse. Ranger: advantage on Perception, 15-foot truesight, and fine sight up to 1 mile. Rogue: bonus-action self invisibility without concentration once per short rest, and 30-foot telepathy. Sorcerer: light, dancing lights, and guiding bolt known (cast for 2 sorcery points, blinding on a failed Constitution save), and 1 sorcery point turns spell damage radiant. Warlock: you know when you hear a lie and can force a truthful answer (Charisma save) Charisma modifier times per long rest. Wizard: AC 13 + Dexterity or Intelligence modifier, and advantage on saves against magic.

magic-item:grasping-staff.attunementNote: Requires attunement by a warlock or wizard
magic-item:grasping-staff.description: While holding it you have resistance to necrotic damage. It has 10 charges, regaining 1d6 + 4 at dawn; as an action cast with your spell save DC and attack bonus: arcane hand (5), bestow curse (3), chill touch (0, or 1 for 5th level), inflict wounds (1 per level, up to 5th), mage hand (0), or vampiric touch (3). On the last charge roll a d20; on a 1 it turns to ash and 2d6 hostile crawling claws appear within 10 feet.

magic-item:great-owl-s-shroud.description: It has 10 charges, all regained at dawn. When you take the Attack action, replace attacks with feather barrages for 1 charge each: +5 ranged spell attack, range 30/120 feet, 2d4 + 3 force damage. Once per dawn, as a reaction when you fall, cast feather fall on yourself.

magic-item:green-knight-s-vow.description: Wearing these bracers grows horns on a non-tiefling (falling away 24 hours after attunement ends). They have 7 charges, all regained at dawn. As a bonus action expend 2 to give a creature within 30 feet a spectral shield granting half cover until the end of your next turn, plus another creature per extra charge. When you make an opportunity attack, expend charges so that one ally per charge within 60 feet who can see or hear you makes a reaction weapon attack. Expend 1 to cast hellish rebuke (DC 15) at 3rd level, plus one level per extra charge. Flaw: you're fanatically loyal to a sovereign; after 24 hours attuned you can't attune to the Red Queen's Burden or Violet King's Promise, and become charmed by and obedient to the first wielder of either you meet (or guard an unclaimed one with your life), curable by greater restoration only after attunement ends.

magic-item:griffon-coinpouch.description: A storybook-style purse holding up to 1,000 coins at a constant 1 pound; coins come out freshly shiny. At the GM's discretion it holds a cryptic slip of advice.

magic-item:griffon-component-pack.description: Once per dawn, as an action place coins worth 5 gp plus a material component's exact cost inside and name it; the coins become that component. At the GM's discretion it takes only the 5 gp and leaves a note pointing to someone or somewhere that can help.

magic-item:griffon-key-loop.description: Hold a key to it for 1 minute to store it extradimensionally (up to 10; remove one with a minute's tugging). As an action recall or dismiss chosen keys. Touching it to a lock whose key it holds locks or unlocks it.

magic-item:guardian-s-reliquary.attunementNote: Requires attunement by a creature missing an arm
magic-item:guardian-s-reliquary.description: A saint's prosthetic arm that can't be removed against your will (detach or reattach as an action). While attached you gain +3 to saving throws, which you can lend to a touched creature as a bonus action for 1 minute. It has 10 charges, all regained at dawn: as an action cast greater restoration (5), lesser restoration (2), protection from evil and good (1), remove curse (3), or warding bond (2). Final Sacrifice: as an action cast mass heal or true resurrection, destroying the relic's bones; it remains a working prosthesis without attunement.

magic-item:gusting-blowgun.description: Ranged hits deal an extra 1d4 bludgeoning damage and push a Medium or smaller creature 5 feet on a failed DC 13 Strength save, and long range imposes no disadvantage. It has 3 charges, all regained at dawn; as an action expend 1 for a 30-by-5-foot gust pushing Medium or smaller creatures 10 feet on a failed DC 13 Strength save.

magic-item:h-rethi-soul-scepter.description: While attuned you ignore sandy difficult terrain and tolerate 200 degrees Fahrenheit. It has 20 charges, regaining 2d6 + 8 at dawn (at 0, roll a d20; on a 1 it bursts into sand). Sandblast (1): +10 ranged attack within 60 feet, 4d6 bludgeoning damage. Sandstorm (5): a 15-foot-radius, 30-foot-high storm follows you while you concentrate, up to 1 hour, heavily obscuring others, deflecting ordinary projectiles, and dealing 4d10 bludgeoning damage (DC 17 Constitution half) to creatures entering or starting inside; on sandy ground you can teleport 60 feet between sandy spaces as a bonus action. Sand Summon (3): a 30-foot radius within 60 feet becomes shifting sand for 1 minute, costing 3 feet per foot moved. Soul of the H'rethi (3): summon a friendly sand elemental (earth elemental limited to sand, advantage on grapples) on sand within 30 feet while you concentrate, up to 1 hour.

magic-item:hadiya-s-handy-quill.description: It returns to your hand after a ranged attack. Once per dawn, speak a command word as you throw it; on a hit the target is blinded by ink until the end of its next turn (an action clears it). As a quill it makes its own ink in a color you choose as a bonus action. As a bonus action it becomes a feather tattoo on your body, or returns to your hand or feet.

magic-item:half-plate-of-the-blind-marty.attunementNote: Requires attunement by a cleric; half plate
magic-item:half-plate-of-the-blind-marty.description: You gain a +2 bonus to AC while wearing it. It has 8 charges, regaining 1d4 + 4 at midday; as an action cast with your spellcasting statistics: cure wounds or inflict wounds (1), blindness/deafness or lesser restoration (2), bestow curse or remove curse (3), banishment or death ward (4), contagion or mass cure wounds (5), harm or heal (6). Curse: ended only by wish or similar magic; you're blind but have blindsight 60 feet while wearing it, and take 3 psychic damage (ignoring resistance and immunity) whenever you hit a creature or affect another creature with a spell.

magic-item:harbinger-s-flail.description: It has the reach property, deals an extra 1d4 thunder damage on a hit, and tolls audibly to 100 feet when it strikes.

magic-item:harvest.description: Hits against plant creatures deal an extra 1d6 slashing damage, and nonmagical plants harvested with it stay fresh 7 extra days.

magic-item:hat-of-osnomnosis.description: A sentient hat (chaotic good; Int 4, Wis 8, Cha 6; hearing and darkvision 30 feet; telepathic emotions and images) that works as your arcane focus while worn. As an action feed it a page; while wearing it you instantly know the nonmagical contents. Magic pages are spat back, and a page holding a spell deals 1d6 psychic damage per spell level to you. It loves being worn, eating paper, and being petted.

magic-item:hat-of-the-sanguine-coven.attunementNote: Requires attunement by a sorcerer, warlock, or wizard
magic-item:hat-of-the-sanguine-coven.description: While wearing it, you can cast chill touch at will. At 0 hit points, you need six successes or failures on death saves instead of three, but succeed only on a 15 or higher; when you roll a death save, the hat can cast chill touch (+5 to hit, no action) at a creature within 30 feet, and a hit adds +5 to the save.

magic-item:hatred-the-wrathful-edge.attunementNote: Requires attunement by a creature the axe deems worthy; greataxe
magic-item:hatred-the-wrathful-edge.description: You gain a +3 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. Hits deal an extra 2d6 fire or lightning damage (your choice), and dropping a living creature to 0 hit points grants temporary hit points equal to that extra damage. A barbarian's first rage after a rest deals 4d6 fire or lightning damage to up to 6 chosen creatures within 10 feet, and while raging, creatures within 5 feet that touch or hit you in melee take 1d6. While attuned you speak, read, and write Abyssal and Infernal, are immune to fire damage, and can walk on molten rock. It has 1 minor and 1 major beneficial and 1 minor and 1 major detrimental random property. Sentient and chaotic evil (Int 14, Wis 13, Cha 17; hearing and darkvision 120 feet; telepathy, Abyssal, Common, Infernal), it relishes anger and bloody resolutions. Casting dispel evil and good on it daily for 5 years on an Upper Plane destroys its spirit, leaving only its bonus.

magic-item:headband-of-the-sweatless.description: While wearing it, perspiration doesn't wet you though it still cools you. Once per dawn, add 1d4 to a Constitution save against extreme heat.

magic-item:headdress-of-the-serpent-king.description: While wearing it, poison damage you take is reduced by your Constitution modifier, ordinary snakes and those of CR 1/4 or lower are indifferent unless provoked, and you can cast animal messenger on snakes as an action. Curse: until remove curse, you hiss your s sounds.

magic-item:headhunter-s-bullseye-lantern.description: It sheds red light (bright 60-foot cone, dim 60 more). Once per dawn, as a bonus action flash it: hostile creatures in its bright light make a DC 13 Dexterity save or are marked for 1 minute, shedding dim light 10 feet, gaining no benefit from invisibility, and negating disadvantage on attacks against them by attackers who can see them.

magic-item:heart-of-damned-intervention.attunementNote: Requires attunement by a cleric or paladin
magic-item:heart-of-damned-intervention.description: An archdevil's burning heart. While attuned you have resistance to fire damage and can cast hellish rebuke at 2nd level at will. Curse: it replaces your heart, dealing 15d6 necrotic damage and turning you evil; you and creatures within 100 feet can't magically contact gods, your radiant damage becomes necrotic, you speak Infernal, and you have disadvantage on attacks against devils and saves against their abilities; dying while cursed binds your soul below (wish or divine intervention only). Only a deity or a good creature's wish ends it. While cursed, once per dawn speak a devil's true name to summon a CR 6 or lower devil that obeys you for 1 hour; and Channel Divinity becomes Channel Damnation: as an action, a creature within 120 feet and those within 10 feet of it make a Charisma save, taking 1d12 + your cleric or paladin level fire damage and being chained (half speed, 1d12 fire each turn for up to 1 minute, repeating the save) or half damage on a success.

magic-item:heartless-cage-pendant.description: Found with 1d4 + 8 charges. As a reaction when a hostile creature you see within 30 feet drops to 0 hit points, expend 1 to kill it outright before any effect can save it; you gain 2d6 + 25 temporary hit points and it can't be revived by spells of 5th level or lower (creatures with legendary actions are immune). On the last charge it shatters, summoning 12 friendly skeletons within 60 feet that obey you for 24 hours, and crumbles.

magic-item:heaven-s-edge.description: You gain a +2 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. Hits deal an extra 2d4 radiant damage (4d4 against fiends and undead). On a 20 against a fiend, it makes a DC 15 Charisma save or is banished as banishment without concentration (ending if you're incapacitated or die within a minute), or is blinded until your next turn on a success.

magic-item:heaven-s-gavel.attunementNote: Requires attunement by a creature of good alignment; maul
magic-item:heaven-s-gavel.description: You gain a +3 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. Hits against evil creatures deal an extra 1d6 radiant damage. It has 10 charges, regaining 1d6 + 4 at dawn; when you hit a creature no more than one size larger, expend up to 3: it makes a DC 17 Strength save and is launched 10 feet per charge (half on a success), taking 1d6 bludgeoning damage per 10 feet remaining if it hits something solid (a creature struck takes the same).

magic-item:heavenly-chalice.description: Once per 24 hours, a cleric, paladin, or celestially connected creature can pray over a potion of healing in it for 1 minute to sanctify it for 24 hours, creating a pool of hit points equal to the potion's maximum roll; drinkers take any amount from the pool until it's empty.

magic-item:heavy-golem-armor.attunementNote: Requires attunement by a Small humanoid; plate
magic-item:heavy-golem-armor.description: A 100-pound suit of golem-built plate. While wearing it, your Strength is 19 unless higher and you count as Medium, though you still take damage dealt to it. Once per dawn, as a bonus action gain haste without concentration; at the end of each of your turns there's a cumulative 20 percent chance it overheats, dealing 1d10 fire damage and ending the effect.

magic-item:hedgewitch-s-gardening-cane.description: As an action tap it to turn its lower end into a broom, hoe, rake, shovel, or back to a cane.

magic-item:hedonic-motivator.description: It has 3 charges, regaining 1d3 at dusk. As a bonus action lash a friendly creature within 10 feet and expend 1 to grant either 2d4 + 4 temporary hit points for 1 minute or 1d4 + 2 to one check, attack, or save before the start of your next turn.

magic-item:helm-of-the-broken-dragon.attunementNote: Requires attunement by a non-lawful dragonborn
magic-item:helm-of-the-broken-dragon.description: While wearing it, you have resistance to psychic damage and creatures have disadvantage on Insight checks against you. Your breath weapon deals psychic damage against a Wisdom save, and those who fail are also affected as by bane for 1 minute (repeating the save each turn). Curse: until remove curse, you won't remove it and gain the flaw of an inner voice always demanding the opposite course.

magic-item:helm-of-the-chromatic-dragon.attunementNote: Requires attunement by a dragonborn of evil alignment
magic-item:helm-of-the-chromatic-dragon.description: While wearing it, your breath weapon deals an extra 1d6 damage, and you choose its damage type (acid, cold, fire, lightning, or poison), shape (15-foot cone or 5-by-30-foot line), and save (Dexterity or Constitution). After using it, roll a d6; on a 5 or 6 you regain a use.

magic-item:helm-of-the-justicars.description: While wearing it, you gain +1 AC, advantage on saves against spells and magical effects, and spell attacks against you have disadvantage. It has 12 charges, regaining 2d6 at dawn; as a reaction when affected by a spell, learn its level and expend charges (minimum 1); if they equal or exceed its level (cantrips count as 1st), you're unaffected.

magic-item:helm-of-the-platinum-dragon.attunementNote: Requires attunement by a dragonborn of good alignment
magic-item:helm-of-the-platinum-dragon.description: While wearing it, you gain +1 to AC and saving throws. Once per dawn your breath weapon can be a holy plume dealing radiant damage, with evil hostile creatures making the save at disadvantage and friendly creatures in the area instead regaining hit points equal to the damage dice.

magic-item:helm-of-the-ruby-dragon.attunementNote: Requires attunement by a dragonborn of neutral alignment
magic-item:helm-of-the-ruby-dragon.description: While wearing it, you have advantage on Investigation checks and Intelligence checks to glean information from observation or lore, and can speak telepathically to one creature within 30 feet that shares a language. Once per dawn your breath weapon can deal force damage, and creatures that fail take an extra 2d6 psychic damage and are stunned until the end of your next turn.

magic-item:hideaway-vase.description: A 15-pound vase. When you remove its lid as an action, you make a DC 13 Charisma save (willing Medium or smaller may fail; Large or larger succeed) or are drawn into a demiplane inside, blinded and immobile but hearing outside; anyone already inside is released instead. Leave as an action unless someone holds the lid with a DC 25 Strength check as a reaction. You can stay up to 8 hours, or are ejected if it's placed in an extradimensional space (shattering it if the lid is held). It has AC 12, 30 hit points, and bludgeoning vulnerability. After someone exits, it can't be opened again for 24 hours. As an action change its apparent style.

magic-item:hoarder-s-haul.description: A dragon-horn cart weighing 5 pounds empty that resizes as an action (1 to 5 feet long; contents don't resize). As an action lock nonliving contents in place; a creature trying to remove them makes a Wisdom save or is frightened of the cart for 1 minute (immune 24 hours on a success). Uncommon: wheeled, 250 pounds, DC 13. Rare: 500 pounds, DC 15, 3d6 psychic damage on a failure. Very rare: flies at 10 feet, hovering up to 20 feet and following spoken directions within 30 feet, 750 pounds, DC 16, 6d6 psychic damage.

magic-item:homeroot.description: Plant it for 1 minute; after 1 hour buried it grows a hidden wooden dwelling beneath a stump whose door opens only at your bonus-action command and resists knock. A 15-foot root ladder leads to a 30-foot round hall lit by controllable fungi and a hallway with four 10-foot rooms furnished to your needs. Pulling a red root as a bonus action opens a hidden second exit 60 feet away until your next turn (DC 15 Perception to notice). Plant growth redesigns a room (or the whole home over 8 hours). A conscious druid or ranger inside senses the size and gait of Small or larger creatures within 60 feet of the entrance. The stump has 100 hit points, immunity to nonmagical weapons other than siege weapons, and resistance to other damage, repaired only by plant growth; if destroyed, the home collapses harmlessly, ejecting occupants.

magic-item:homeward-boots.description: As an action, leave a permanent teleportation circle in dirt beneath you (making a new one erases the old). As an action, cast a 5-foot teleportation circle linked only to that circle and step through it; this fails if the home circle was cleaned away. Teleporting recharges after 1d3 days.

magic-item:horatio-s-impossible-ship-in-.description: Unseal it with its command word and submerge it in large water to release a 50-by-15-foot sailing ship (half normal capacity) crewed by 10 unseen servants obeying you and your allies. Keep a bottle that's spent at least 10 years in the ocean aboard, and running the ship aground shrinks it back into that bottle, dropping everything aboard.

magic-item:hour-and-minute.description: A bound dagger and shortsword; attuning to one covers both, and as an action you learn the other's distance and direction on the same plane. If two creatures attune to the pair, contested Arcana checks decide who keeps attunement (secure for 24 hours). Holding both, you gain +1 to attack and damage rolls with them and +1 AC; a 20 with Hour subjects the creature to slow until the end of your next turn, and a 20 with Minute grants you haste until the start of your next turn without the usual lethargy. Laid on the ground, they point north and show the time.

magic-item:hourglass-of-slumber.description: A 1-minute timer filled with dreamy smoke. It has 3 charges, regaining 1d3 at dusk; turn it over and expend 1 to cast sleep at 3rd level, plus one level per extra charge. The sleep lasts until the timer runs out, is stopped, or the glass is flipped; a sleeper that takes damage makes a Constitution save (DC 20 minus half the damage, minimum 10) to wake, waking automatically after 3 failures.

magic-item:hushed-ring.description: While wearing it, only creatures you choose can speak to you telepathically. Once per dusk, as an action create a 10-foot aura of silence while you concentrate, up to 1 minute: other creatures in it trying to speak or use verbal components make a DC 13 Wisdom save or can't until the start of their next turn, wasting the action used.

magic-item:hydra-charm.description: While wearing it, each benefit is usable once per long rest: make a second attack with an opportunity attack; make an opportunity attack after using your reaction; as a reaction gain advantage on a save against being blinded, charmed, deafened, frightened, stunned, or knocked unconscious; as a reaction when you take more than 25 damage from one source regain 10 hit points (or drop to 1 instead of 0 if not killed outright); and as a reaction negate decapitation.

magic-item:hydra-flail.description: Each critical hit against a hostile creature grows another head for 1 hour; you gain +2 to damage rolls per extra head (maximum +6).

magic-item:impact-plate.description: This dwarven plate resizes to fit. While wearing it, you have resistance to bludgeoning damage and take no damage from falls of 100 feet or less.

magic-item:indigo-stray-s-conviction.description: Smoky gloves that rematerialize missing arms, hands, or fingers while attuned. You gain darkvision 60 feet that sees through magical darkness (or +60 feet to existing darkvision, magical darkness only in the first 60). They have 7 charges, all regained at dawn. Allow Me (1): as a reaction when an attacker within 15 feet damages an ally, move 15 feet and make a weapon attack, gaining advantage against it until the end of your next turn on a hit. By His Will (3): as a bonus action a 15-foot aura of magical darkness for 1 minute deals 2d8 necrotic damage to hostiles entering or starting there, grappling on double 8s (DC 17 Athletics or Acrobatics to escape). The Price of Freedom (2): as a reaction take the damage, or the blinded, deafened, paralyzed, petrified, or poisoned condition, of a creature within 30 feet instead. Flaw: you must prove yourself; after 24 hours attuned you can't attune to the Red Queen's Burden or Violet King's Promise, become the charmed servant of the first Violet King's Promise wielder you meet, and guard either if found unowned, curable by greater restoration only after attunement ends.

magic-item:infernal-chain.description: A 10-foot chain coiled on your arm that lashes out in fire and smoke; it has reach and heavy and deals an extra 1d8 fire damage on a hit. You can grapple with its reach; a creature it grapples takes 2d8 fire damage at the start of each turn, keeps its speed but can't move more than 10 feet from you, and can be pulled 5 feet as a bonus action (no chain attacks while grappling). Curse: you can't remove it, must succeed on a DC 16 Wisdom save at the start of each turn a known celestial is within 30 feet or attack the nearest celestial, and gain a flaw of delighting in exploiting enemies' fears.

magic-item:inker-s-armband.description: As a bonus action, cover the arm wearing it with still or 6-second looping black tattoos, which last until removed, changed, or ended as a bonus action.

magic-item:insatiable-tome.description: A 12-pound book of 1,000 blank pages that eats smaller nonmagical documents set beside it over 1 minute. As an action name one it ate to reprint its contents in the original language or cipher until erased or replaced. Magic pages are spat out, but notes and spells written directly in it can be recalled if dated, labeled, or titled, along with any added commentary.

magic-item:inspector-s-silverware.description: A knife, spoon, and fork, each with 1 charge; touching poisoned food or drink spends the charge and tarnishes the piece. Lesser restoration on the holder restores one piece.

magic-item:instrument-of-roses-and-thorn.description: When you give Bardic Inspiration with it, another creature within 60 feet that hears you makes a Charisma save against your spell save DC or gains an Enervation die (your Bardic Inspiration die) for 1 minute. As a reaction when it makes a check or attack, roll its Enervation dice and subtract them (before the outcome is known); dropping the total to 0 or less also deals 6d6 necrotic damage. Unattuned players make a DC 16 Constitution save or take 2d6 necrotic damage.

magic-item:ironleaf-impaler.description: You gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. It has 5 charges, all regained at dawn; on a ranged attack expend 1 to explode it into thorns: the target (failing automatically if hit) and creatures within 10 feet make a DC 15 Dexterity save, taking 1d8 piercing damage or half on a success. Its seed then regrows it in your hand.

magic-item:jo-catian-denier.attunementNote: Requires attunement by a creature of neutral alignment; longsword, scimitar, or shortsword
magic-item:jo-catian-denier.description: It has 3 charges, regaining 1d3 at dawn. On a hit expend 1 to force a DC 13 save of your choice; on a failure: Strength, -2 to attack rolls; Dexterity, half speed; Wisdom, no reactions; Charisma, disadvantage on attacks against others than you (each until the end of its next turn); Constitution, a Large or smaller target is pushed 15 feet; Intelligence, disadvantage on its next spell attack within 1 minute. While also attuned to the Jo'Catian Rebuker, either item's charges fuel both.

magic-item:jo-catian-rebuker.attunementNote: Requires attunement by a creature of neutral alignment; shield
magic-item:jo-catian-rebuker.description: It has 3 charges, regaining 1d3 at dawn. As a reaction when a creature you see within 30 feet damages you, expend 1 to reduce the damage by 1d6 and choose an ability; it has disadvantage on its next save of that ability before the end of its next turn (once per creature per minute). While also attuned to the Jo'Catian Denier, either item's charges fuel both.

magic-item:kestra-s-bent-spoon.description: Three runes: Ulm enhances the flavor of spoonable food; Tox tarnishes it on contact with poison until dawn; Seera, once per dawn while it's on your person, lets one psychic damage die you roll deal maximum.

magic-item:ki-blade.attunementNote: Requires attunement by a monk; shortsword
magic-item:ki-blade.description: You gain a +2 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. While attuned your ki maximum increases by 2. When you use Deflect Missiles holding it, you can strike the missile to reduce the damage by an extra 1d10, destroying a nonmagical missile reduced to 0 (magical ones drop at your feet), then spend 1 ki point to use Deflect Missiles again that turn.

magic-item:kinetic-bowstring.description: Strung on a nonmagical bow or crossbow, it makes its attacks magical, and the first ranged attack each turn has double range and deals one extra damage die on a hit.

magic-item:kraken-band.description: It can't be removed against your will. When you take the Attack action, make a bonus-action unarmed strike with your arm as a 15-foot tentacle, dealing an extra 1d6 acid damage on a hit. You can grapple creatures within 15 feet as part of the Attack action; on a success it takes 1d6 acid damage and is pulled up to 10 feet toward you.

magic-item:lady-phantasma-s-material-anc.description: As an action within 30 feet of water on the Material Plane, call the lost ghost ship: an anchor appears and after 1 minute a 70-by-20-foot longship emerges, crewed by harmless, friendly spectral sailors who handle only the ship, with you as captain while you carry the charm. The crew returns to the Ethereal Plane at dawn and back at dusk, the anchor holding the ship immovable by day; it sails at 10 miles per hour without wind. It vanishes if the charm is off the ship for 24 hours or you speak its command phrase, dropping added cargo. If the ship is destroyed, the charm rusts away.

magic-item:lamian-facestealer.description: You gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. It has 3 charges, regaining 1d3 at dusk. When you hit a humanoid, expend 1 to take its appearance as disguise self (DC 15, up to 3 feet taller or shorter); it makes a DC 15 Wisdom save or has disadvantage on Wisdom saves and all ability checks while it can see you wearing its face.

magic-item:lash-of-the-spelldrinker.attunementNote: Requires attunement by a spellcaster; whip
magic-item:lash-of-the-spelldrinker.description: You gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. While attuned you're proficient with it, can use it as a spellcasting focus, and can use your spellcasting modifier for its attack and damage rolls. As a reaction when a hostile creature within reach casts a spell, attack it; on a hit it makes a save with its spellcasting ability against your spell save DC or you learn its highest remaining slot level and it takes that much extra force damage. Once per dusk, recover an expended spell slot up to that damage (maximum 3rd level).

magic-item:leatherbeard.description: A mask worn or removed as an action that grows an illusory beard up to 2 feet long in your chosen style (DC 10 Investigation reveals it). Each 7 consecutive days worn adds a cumulative 25 percent chance the beard becomes real and the mask is destroyed.

magic-item:life-tether-ankh.description: While wearing it, you can turn a failed death save into a success, shattering it. If used against a roll that would be two failures, you gain one success and one failure instead; reaching 3 of each forces a final death save to stabilize or die.

magic-item:mageplate-ring.description: It has 3 charges, all regained at dawn. As a bonus action expend 1 or more for spectral armor for 1 minute: your base AC becomes 16 (no Dexterity), plus 1 per extra charge, and you shed bright light 20 feet and dim 20 more.

magic-item:magnificent-pocket-vanity.description: A brass compact with 3 uses. As an action apply it to yourself or a willing creature within reach to take a random one of six preset disguises as disguise self (DC 13), able to change apparent height by up to 5 feet. It becomes nonmagical after the last use.

magic-item:mandible-bident.description: Once per turn when you hit a Medium or smaller creature with a melee attack, it makes a DC 13 Strength or Dexterity save or is grappled in its pincers (action and DC 13 Strength check to free it or another). While grappling you can't attack others with it, but can replace an attack with 1d8 automatic bludgeoning damage to the held creature. Release it freely; it lets go if you drop it or are incapacitated.

magic-item:mantle-of-security.description: A beloved child's blanket turned cloak. Worn, you can't be frightened or magically put to sleep. Used as a blanket while sleeping or resting, you can't be unwillingly targeted by dream, gain +3 passive Perception, and can't be surprised for being unconscious. Either way you tolerate temperatures down to -50 degrees Fahrenheit.

magic-item:marlin-lunger.description: You gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. It ignores underwater combat penalties, and once per turn when you attack with it underwater, you can glide up to 15 feet immediately before or after the attack.

magic-item:masks-of-the-sacred-beasts.description: Ceramic and gold animal masks; you can switch attunement between masks in 1 minute. Crocodile (common): 30-foot swimming speed and hold breath 10 minutes. Lion (uncommon): advantage on smell-based Perception, and claws make your unarmed strikes magic 1d6 slashing. Hawk (rare): advantage on sight-based Perception, no disadvantage at long range, feather fall on yourself at will. Mule (very rare): +2 Strength (maximum 20), count one size larger for carrying, advantage against being knocked prone, and after a melee weapon hit on a Large or smaller creature, a bonus action forces a DC 16 Strength or Dexterity save or prone. Jackal (legendary): advantage on Perception and immunity to necrotic damage; once per dusk, as an action a 60-foot beam forces a DC 17 Constitution save, 7d8 + 30 necrotic damage or half, and a humanoid slain rises as a mummy you control (one at a time) until dismissed, destroyed, or you stop being attuned to any mask.

magic-item:matron-s-mug.description: Once per dawn, as an action it fills with a creamy chocolate drink; 1 minute after drinking, you can recover one expended spell slot by spending Hit Dice equal to its level (maximum 5th).

magic-item:medusan-lavalier.description: A necklace of coiled metal snakes, worn or removed as an action. While wearing it, you can't be petrified against your will, and existing petrification is suppressed until you remove it.

magic-item:medusan-signet.description: When you drop to 0 hit points but aren't killed, you turn to stone instead of falling prone, petrified until you die, receive greater restoration, or regain hit points. Meanwhile you make no death saves (though damage still causes failures) and critical hits against you are normal hits. On waking you gain 2d6 + 3 temporary hit points for 1 minute. After 3 uses it crumbles.

magic-item:medzo-s-crossbow.description: Its ranged hits deal 3d4 piercing damage instead of normal damage; critical hits don't double its dice, and a 1 on the attack jams it until the end of your next turn. On a hit with three matching damage dice, the target takes an extra 1d6 piercing damage and: 1s, reroll one die; 2s, the next attack against it before your next turn has advantage; 3s, it has disadvantage on attacks until the end of your next turn; 4s, 30 gp appears at your feet if it's hostile.

magic-item:meta-mantle.description: While wearing it, you can change your known Metamagic options after each long rest, and gain three new options. Delayed Spell (3 points): a readied spell targeting a point needs no concentration, can be released as a reaction within 1 minute, and originates from where you readied it. Emergency Spell (6 points): as a reaction when hit or damaged, cast a spell with a casting time of 1 action or bonus action. Expanded Spell (2 points): lines grow 15 feet, cones, cubes, and sphere radii 5 feet, and cylinders 5 feet in diameter or 10 in height.

magic-item:meta-medallion.description: While wearing it, you gain one additional Metamagic option of your choice, changeable after a long rest.

magic-item:mimicloak.description: As a bonus action change its apparent style. While wearing it, you have advantage on checks to escape grapples, and whenever you try to escape a grapple or restraints, whatever holds you takes 1d10 piercing damage from a toothy maw in the fabric.

magic-item:mindmaster-s-monocle.description: Floating before your eye, it shows indigo mist around any creature you see concentrating on a spell. It has 10 charges, regaining 1d6 + 4 at dawn: as an action cast arcane eye (4), detect thoughts (2), or telepathic bond (5) with your spell save DC; or as a bonus action expend 3 to contest your Intelligence check against the spellcasting ability check of a creature within 60 feet, ending its concentration if you win.

magic-item:mistwalker-armor.description: Once per dawn, as an action cast fog cloud at 2nd level. Fog doesn't obscure your vision, and while in opaque fog you can spend movement to teleport to a space you see within it.

magic-item:monarch-mantle.description: As a bonus action, gain a 30-foot flying speed until the end of your turn. It has 3 charges, regaining 1d3 at dawn; as a reaction when a creature you see hits you, expend 1 to halve the damage and teleport up to 15 feet in a burst of butterflies, imposing disadvantage on attacks against you there until the end of the turn.

magic-item:monster-tamer-s-shield.description: While holding it, beasts and monstrosities that damage you with melee attacks take 1d4 psychic damage, and you have advantage on Animal Handling checks. If you're also attuned to the Monster Tamer's Sword, its captured creature gains +1 AC and can't be charmed.

magic-item:monster-tamer-s-sword.description: It has 6 charges, regaining 1d4 + 2 at dawn. As a reaction when you drop a Large or smaller beast or monstrosity of CR 3 or lower to 0 hit points with it, expend 1 to capture it (DC 15 Charisma save; shapechangers succeed) at 1 hit point, one creature at a time. As an action release it within 10 feet as a friendly ally obeying your commands for 1 minute (or until recalled with a touch as an action); it turns on you if it can't return, you release control as a bonus action, or you or an ally harm it. As a bonus action expend charges to heal it 10 hit points each while stored or within 30 feet, its only healing.

magic-item:moonstone-bracers.description: While wearing them, you're immune to moonbeam damage and resistant to nonmagical bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from silvered weapons. Once per dusk, in dim light or darkness, as an action polymorph yourself into a wolf, keeping your Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma.

magic-item:morath-scepter-of-the-soul-vo.attunementNote: Requires attunement by a sorcerer, warlock, or wizard
magic-item:morath-scepter-of-the-soul-vo.description: While attuned you have resistance to necrotic damage and know chill touch; a warlock gains +3 to warlock spell attacks and save DCs while holding it. Its green flame (bright light 20 feet, dim 20 more) is lit or snuffed as a bonus action; lit, as an action make a 30-foot ranged spell attack with a phantasmal skull for 3d8 necrotic damage, healing you half. It has 1 minor beneficial, 1 minor detrimental, and 1 major detrimental random property. It has 8 charges, regaining 1d3 + 1 at dawn and 1 when you drop a humanoid to 0: bestow curse (1), circle of death (4), confusion (2), insect plague (3), ray of enfeeblement (1), or speak with dead (1). Once per dawn, a bestow curse can impose disadvantage and all four curse options; once per dawn, cast finger of death. Sentient and chaotic evil (Int 17, Wis 13, Cha 14; hearing and darkvision 120 feet; telepathy, Common), it holds Morath, the first human to die, who urges base desires. Curse: a non-human attuned who dies makes a Charisma save against their own DC; on a failure (or if over 100 feet from the rod) their soul joins the Thousand Voices (wish only), on a success it enters the rod as magic jar. Defeating Morath (archmage statistics) inside the rod destroys it and returns you with 1 hit point.

magic-item:mosshide-troll-belt.description: While wearing it, your Constitution increases by 2 (maximum 20), and in combat you regain 1d4 + 1 hit points at the start of your turn while below half your hit points; this stops for 1 hour after acid or fire damage, or until dawn if you drop to 0.

magic-item:mourningsteel-demi-gauntlets.description: While wearing them, you have resistance to necrotic damage. They have 12 charges, regaining 1d6 + 6 at dawn; as an action cast (+8 spell attack) chill touch (0, or 1 for 5th level), inflict wounds (1 per level, up to 5th), or vampiric touch (3), ignoring necrotic resistance. A charged chill touch hit can deliver inflict wounds or vampiric touch at range by spending their charges (an active vampiric touch delivers free), though chill touch damage doesn't count toward vampiric healing.

magic-item:mourningsteel-ghost-candle.description: Its candle never burns down. Holding it lit while attuned, will-o'-wisps are indifferent to you, and once per dusk you can cast blink; each time you vanish, a will-o'-wisp obeying your mental commands takes your place and acts after you, and if it drops to 0 you return early to a space within 10 feet.

magic-item:mourningsteel-half-plate.description: You gain +1 AC and resistance to radiant damage. Once per dusk, as a reaction to necrotic damage, take none and gain temporary hit points equal to half. Each once per dusk, cast bestow curse, divine word, or nondetection (DC 17). Once per 7 days, touch a battle-worn object to cast legend lore on it. Once per dusk, as a bonus action raise an unholy aura for 1 minute: celestials have disadvantage on attacks against you and take 1d10 necrotic damage (ignoring resistance and immunity) when first moving within 5 feet or starting there, and once you can turn a failed save against a celestial's effect into a success.

magic-item:mourningsteel-war-banner.description: A 7-pound standard that collapses or extends as a bonus action; while carried you have advantage on saves against being frightened. It has 3 charges, regaining 1d3 at dawn. As an action plant it within reach (difficult terrain; removed by you as an action or by another's DC 25 Athletics check), expending charges to summon one friendly animated armor per charge within 20 feet for 1 hour, until destroyed, or until the standard is removed.

magic-item:murk-blowgun.description: Ranged hits deal an extra 1d4 poison damage, and on a 20 the target makes a DC 13 Constitution save or is poisoned and incapacitated until the end of its next turn. It also works as a magic club.

magic-item:myceliaweave-armor.description: While wearing it, your Constitution increases by 2 (maximum 20), and magical healing also grants temporary hit points equal to half the healing (maximum 15), during which you resist necrotic damage. Curse: you can't remove it until you die or receive remove curse, and when attunement ends your Constitution drops by 2 for 2d6 + 6 days or until you reattune.

magic-item:night-owl-s-half-moon-spectac.description: While wearing them, cast comprehend languages as an action (ending if removed). At the start of a long rest, set them beside books or parchment to create a spectral copy of you after 10 minutes that reads, writes, or copies spells there through the rest (ending if the glasses move or you go over 30 feet away); you learn what it read or wrote when the rest ends.

magic-item:nightmare-flask.description: After each long rest you sleep with it, there's a 25 percent chance it collects a nightmare (one per 24 hours, maximum 10). As an action throw it within 30 feet to shatter it: creatures within 20 feet make a DC 13 Wisdom save (disadvantage below half hit points) or sleep for up to 1 minute (woken by non-psychic damage or a shake), taking 1d10 psychic damage at the start of each turn for turns equal to the stored nightmares, never below 1 hit point. Or, when you're targeted by dream, the caster makes a DC 17 Wisdom save or takes 1d10 psychic damage per nightmare and the spell fails, destroying the flask.

magic-item:nightstalker-s-armor-of-the-n.description: As a reaction when a creature within 5 feet damages you, deal it 1d6 cold damage. Once per dusk, as a bonus action become a frigid fog as gaseous form for 1 minute, during which you can take the Attack action with unarmed strikes dealing 1d6 cold damage and still use the retributive cold.

magic-item:nightstalker-s-mask.description: It has 3 charges, regaining 1d3 at dusk. When you take the Hide action, expend 1 to become invisible with your gear until the end of your next turn, ending if you attack or cast a spell; a hit while invisible this way deals an extra 1d10 psychic damage.

magic-item:nimbus-first-staff-of-the-thu.description: You gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. Instead of a melee attack, make a proficient 30-foot ranged spell attack adding your Wisdom modifier, dealing 1d6 bludgeoning damage. Up to 3 variant properties active, swappable on a long rest: works as a broom of flying; 5th level, cast shillelagh with it as a bonus action; 5th-level druid or ranger, 8 charges (regaining 1d6 + 2 at dawn) for create or destroy water 1, fog cloud 1, misty step 2, sleet storm 3, thunderwave at 2nd level 2; 9th level, bonus +2 and ranged die d8 (+3 and d10 at 17th); 9th level, first hit each turn deals an extra 1d6 cold, lightning, or thunder; 13th-level druid or ranger, 8 more charges for lightning bolt 3, shatter 2, spirit guardians 3, wind wall 3; 13th level, resistance to cold, lightning, or thunder (changeable on a long rest); 17th level, Dash as a bonus action; 17th-level druid or ranger, 8 more charges for chain lightning 6, cloudkill 5, cone of cold 5, control weather 8, fly 3 (6 at 6th level); 20th-level druid or ranger, all properties, and a ranger can summon a friendly roc with an 8-hour ritual (Int 6, understands one of your languages; 30 days before another if it dies). Charge pools stack. Destroyed only by 10 years in a vacuum.

magic-item:no-stones.description: A split geode. Once per dawn per half, as an action fix a half to stone, natural metal, or earth to project a 3-foot monochrome map of such surfaces within 120 feet, with traps and gemstones glowing red. It stays until recalled as a bonus action, the surface moves, it bears over 100 pounds, or a DC 15 Strength check moves it.

magic-item:novanite-armor.attunementNote: Medium or heavy armor, but not hide
magic-item:novanite-armor.description: You gain a +1 bonus to AC while wearing it. Once per 12 hours, as an action vanish into the Astral Plane and reappear at a space you see within 30 feet at the start of your next turn (3d6 force damage and the nearest space if occupied). Creatures within 10 feet when you leave and when you arrive make a DC 15 Strength save, taking 3d6 force damage and being pulled toward where you left or pushed from where you appear, or half and no movement on a success.

magic-item:oaken-candle.description: Lit as an action, its green flame sheds bright light 5 feet and dim 5 more. After 1d8 + 4 hours it's consumed and an oak up to 30 feet tall grows there over 10 minutes, if there's room on solid ground.

magic-item:oathkeeper-s-resolve.attunementNote: Requires attunement by a paladin; shield
magic-item:oathkeeper-s-resolve.description: A 2-pound mithral buckler granting +2 AC beyond its normal bonus. As a bonus action its lens sheds bright light 15 feet and dim 15 more until extinguished or you drop to 0. Once per 8 hours, when you doff it or as an action, throw it to an ally's free hand or a space within 30 feet; for 1 minute it sheds bright light 30 feet and dim 30 more, and friendly creatures in its bright light gain your paladin auras.

magic-item:octavius-s-saber.attunementNote: Requires attunement by a rogue; rapier
magic-item:octavius-s-saber.description: You gain a +3 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. When you deal Sneak Attack damage with it, treat any 1 on a Sneak Attack die as an 8.

magic-item:ogramau-s-graveyard.attunementNote: Requires attunement by a cleric or wizard
magic-item:ogramau-s-graveyard.description: While carried, undead have disadvantage on attacks against you. As an action, store a Small or Medium humanoid corpse within 5 feet in its demiplane, where it doesn't age (storing another swaps it out); or animate the stored corpse as animate dead within 15 feet, lasting 24 hours or until destroyed (one at a time).

magic-item:ol-stumpy.description: Hits deal an extra 1d4 poison damage, maximized against fey.

magic-item:orb-of-remembrance.description: As an action prime it for 1 minute, then squeeze to capture a miniature illusory diorama of the area within 30 feet, which silently replays the next 6 seconds while held. A primed orb touched to a full one copies its scene; shaking it while speaking the command word clears it.

magic-item:orelia-s-tome-of-beast-famili.description: While attuned you always have find familiar prepared. Cast with a higher slot (costing 10 gp more components per level above 1st), your familiar can be a beast up to CR 1/8 (2nd), 1/4 (3rd to 4th), 1/2 (5th to 6th), 1 (7th to 8th), or 2 (9th). Ending attunement dismisses your familiar.

magic-item:orner-s-venomous-crossbow.description: You gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. It has 4 charges, regaining 1d3 + 1 at dawn; expend 1 on an attack and a hit deals an extra 1d6 poison damage plus a DC 13 Constitution save or poisoned until the end of the target's next turn. On the last charge roll a d20; on a 1 it sprays poison in a 20-foot radius around you (1d12 poison damage and a DC 15 Constitution save or poisoned for 1 minute) and becomes nonmagical.

magic-item:orostead-iced-tea.description: A lemon-cherry tea with 6 + 1d4 sips (an action each) whose alcohol affects you twice as strongly as normal. Common: each sip rolls a harmless 1-minute quirk (illusory drenching, extreme warmth or cold, a 1-second time freeze, speak with animals, a 5-foot teleport, gray clothes, static shocks, or inverted coloring with a small height change). Very rare: each sip grants a benefit not repeatable before a long rest: +2 to Strength, Dexterity, Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma checks and saves for 1 hour (plus related weapon attacks or spell attacks and DCs), 2d10 + 20 temporary hit points, a free choice, or recovering spell slots totaling up to 8 levels (none 6th or higher), or if none are spent, a 6th-level fireball (DC 16) within 8 hours.

magic-item:overseer-s-spade.description: As an action touch loose earth within 5 feet to excavate up to eight contiguous 5-foot cubes of loose nonmagical earth over 1 minute, destroying it but leaving metals and gems; up to eight cubes per day.

magic-item:owlbear-leather-armor.description: Once per dawn, when you fail a Constitution save against a hostile effect, you can succeed instead.

magic-item:pack-of-revisibility-bombs.description: Found with 1d3 + 3 bombs. As an action throw one within 60 feet: creatures within 30 feet make a DC 20 Dexterity save or become visible and can't turn invisible for 1 minute, and unattended objects there do the same automatically.

magic-item:pegasus-quill.description: Writing with it, such as copying spells or scribing scrolls, takes half the time.

magic-item:pennypuncher-slingshot.description: It requires two hands. You gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. Firing coins adds damage by value: copper +1, silver +1d4, electrum +1d6, gold +1d8, platinum +1d12. Coins are recovered as ammunition.

magic-item:peregrine-spear.description: You gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. Once per dawn, on a ranged attack it flies straight to the target and returns to your hand, dealing an extra 1d4 piercing damage per 5 feet traveled on a hit (maximum 12d4).

magic-item:performer-s-puppet.description: Worn on your hand, its canvas face and clothes change as a bonus action, and while held aloft your voice comes from it.

magic-item:periscope-rod.description: As an action or part of a Perception check, look through one bent end to see out the other as a spyglass; as a bonus action adjust its angles and length (up to 5 feet).

magic-item:phantom-walkers.description: While wearing them, checks to track you by footprints have +5 DC. Once per dawn, as a bonus action leave no prints for 1 minute while false tracks wander up to 300 feet for 8 hours (DC 13 Arcana reveals them).

magic-item:phasing-bow.description: Ranged hits deal an extra 1d4 force damage. It has 5 charges, all regained at dawn. Expend 1 on a ranged attack to ignore cover (not lead or over 1 foot thick), dealing an extra 3d4 force damage on a hit. Or as a bonus action expend 3 to fire at a point within normal range and teleport to the nearest space where it strikes.

magic-item:phoenix-breastplate.description: You gain +1 AC and resistance to fire damage. Once per 1d6 + 1 days, when reduced to 0 hit points but not killed, drop to 1 instead in a fiery burst: hostile creatures within 30 feet make a DC 16 Dexterity save, taking 3d10 fire damage or half, and you and allies there regain that many hit points.

magic-item:phoenix-rocket-sword.description: You gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. It has 10 charges, regaining 1d6 + 4 at dawn. As an action expend up to 5 for a roaring jet (audible 100 feet): make a Strength save (DC 10 + charges, which you may fail) or be propelled 20 feet per charge without provoking (upward if pointed down; otherwise flames ring you in 15 feet). The 15-foot cone of flame deals 3d6 fire damage plus 1d6 per extra charge (DC 16 Dexterity half) to creatures it reaches. Hitting an object deals you 1d6 bludgeoning per charge and knocks you prone; hitting a creature deals that to both of you, each making a Strength save (DC 10 + charges) or falling prone.

magic-item:pick-and-pocket.description: You gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. It doubles as part of thieves' tools, adding +1 to checks to pick locks. As an action, twist it like a key to stash an object in your other hand (up to 1 foot and 10 pounds) in a demiplane, one at a time; it returns to your hand or feet when you twist back (no action) or let go of the dagger.

magic-item:pisces-shield.description: Submerged for 1 minute, its koi swim for up to 24 hours; the next time you roll a 1 on a d20 attack, check, or save while holding it, treat it as a 20, after which the koi rest for 24 hours.

magic-item:poison-armor-of-amphibios.description: While wearing it, you have advantage on saves against poison and resistance to poison damage. It has 3 charges, all regained at dawn; as a reaction when a creature within 5 feet hits you in melee, expend 1 to spray it: DC 15 Constitution save, 2d6 poison damage and poisoned until the end of its next turn, or half and not poisoned.

magic-item:pollinator-carapace.attunementNote: Requires attunement by a druid or ranger; leather, studded leather, or hide
magic-item:pollinator-carapace.description: It has 3 charges, regaining 1d3 at dawn; expend 1 (no action) to sprout insect wings for 1 hour, gaining a 30-foot flying speed and hover. While attuned to three Beekeeper's Commitment items, it regains all charges at dawn and gains: while winged, insect and plant creatures targeting you with attacks or harmful spells must first succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom save or choose another target or lose it.

magic-item:pollinator-pants.attunementNote: Requires attunement by a druid or ranger
magic-item:pollinator-pants.description: Flowers bloom as you pass within 5 feet. They have 3 charges, regaining 1d3 at dawn; as an action expend 1 to cast speak with plants on flowering plants, communicating through dance. While attuned to three Beekeeper's Commitment items, it regains all charges at dawn and gains: when you take the Attack action, a bonus-action unarmed sting against a creature within 5 feet deals an extra 1d4 piercing damage, and on a 20 an extra 10 poison damage plus a DC 15 Constitution save or poisoned until the end of your next turn.

magic-item:pollinator-visor.attunementNote: Requires attunement by a druid or ranger
magic-item:pollinator-visor.description: Raised or lowered as an action; lowered, you have advantage on Perception checks relying on sight and smell. It has 3 charges, regaining 1d3 at dawn; as an action expend 1 to cast animal messenger on a Tiny insect (25 miles a day flying, 12 otherwise). While attuned to three Beekeeper's Commitment items, it regains all charges at dawn and gains: the insect can instead shadow the recipient and, on a trigger phrase, record up to 25 words or 6 seconds of sound and relay it to your mind across any distance on the same plane.

magic-item:poltergeist-candle-holder.description: As a bonus action it floats above your shoulder (dropping if anything but a candle is placed in it), and its lit candle's smoke hangs motionless for 6 seconds.

magic-item:power-collar.description: Place it on a willing Medium or smaller creature as an action, bonding with a friendly beast companion or familiar, whose hit point maximum increases by your level. Once per 2 days, as a bonus action while it's within 30 feet, it gains enlarge without concentration, or it can trigger this itself as a reaction if you drop to 0 hit points within 30 feet. It fails on polymorphed creatures, travels with a dismissed familiar, and a creature benefits from only one magic collar.

magic-item:prism-glasses.description: While wearing them, your darkvision shows color for the first 15 feet, and a colorblind wearer sees color normally.

magic-item:prototype-thunderberd.description: Hits deal an extra 1d6 lightning damage. It has 10 charges, regaining 1d6 + 4 at dawn. While charged, load a crossbow bolt into its haft as an action; when you take the Attack action, expend charges to fire a 1-foot-wide line 10 feet long plus 10 feet per charge: DC 15 Dexterity save, 1d6 piercing plus 1d6 lightning per charge, or half on a success. On the last charge roll a d20; on a 1 it explodes, dealing 10d6 piercing damage (DC 15 Dexterity half) within 10 feet.

magic-item:prying-mace.description: You gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. On a 20 against a living creature with Intelligence 6 or higher that speaks a language, you learn the words of the last lie it told, but not the truth.

magic-item:quick-change-ring.description: Bind one suit of armor to its extradimensional space over 1 hour (binding another ejects the first). As an action touch the bound armor, even while wearing it, to store it; speak again to don it instantly or drop it at your feet, with a harmless flourish. Armor that prevents removal can't be stored. When found, 50 percent chance it holds a random suit.

magic-item:quiver-of-elemental-chaos.description: As a bonus action press a button to create elemental ammunition, magical only for you and losing magic at the end of the turn once removed; up to 5 of each per day. Air: no long-range disadvantage, extra 1d6 thunder, dispels atmospheric magic of 3rd level or lower it passes through. Earth: extra 2d6 bludgeoning and a DC 15 Strength save or pushed 10 feet. Fire: extra 1d6 fire and, hit or miss, a burst (DC 15 Dexterity or 1d6 fire) within 5 feet. Water: no underwater penalties, extra 2d6 piercing (3d6 against fire creatures), extinguishes nonmagical flames within 10 feet. Pressing two compatible buttons creates one paraelemental shot of each per day: Ice, extra 3d6 cold and a DC 15 Constitution save or paralyzed for 1 minute (half speed on success; cold-resistant auto-succeed; ends on fire damage); Magma, extra 3d6 fire and a 10-foot burst forcing a DC 15 Constitution save or 1 exhaustion; Ooze, a 20-foot grease (DC 15) dealing 1d6 acid to those starting prone in it; Smoke, a pitch-black 2nd-level fog cloud.

magic-item:radiant-war-pick.attunementNote: Requires attunement by a cleric or paladin; war pick
magic-item:radiant-war-pick.description: You gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. Hits deal an extra 1d8 radiant damage, maximized against shapechangers and undead. Once per dawn, as an action spend a Channel Divinity to cast moonbeam at 6th level or sunbeam (save DC 16). As an action it sheds bright light 20 feet and dim 20 more, or goes dark.

magic-item:realmswarden-greataxe.description: As a bonus action a prismatic blade of light forms or vanishes (bright light 15 feet, dim 15 more, adjustable 10 to 30 as a bonus action). You gain a +3 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. It deals force damage instead of slashing, and an extra 1d12 radiant damage against aberrations and undead. Once per 12 hours, trace a glyph on it over 1 minute to recreate symbol (DC 17) that moves with the axe and triggers only on a creature you hit, affecting only that creature (aberrations and undead save with disadvantage).

magic-item:red-queen-s-burden.description: Requires Strength 17 to wield. You gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. Hits deal an extra 1d6 fire damage. It has 7 charges, regaining 1d6 + 1 at dawn, shown as horns on an illusory crown. Cower (2, on a hit): hostile creatures within 15 feet make a DC 17 Wisdom save or are frightened until the end of your next turn (the target at disadvantage). Execute (1, after an attack in the Attack action): a willing creature that sees and hears you makes a reaction weapon attack, dealing an extra 2d6 fire on a hit. Survive (bonus action): a creature gains 5 temporary hit points per charge plus your Strength modifier. At the start of your turn expend 2 to stand fast: speed 0, +2 AC, up to three reactions (one per turn), reaction attacks against creatures within 10 feet that attack, and hits force a DC 15 Wisdom save or speed 0. Flaw: you trust only one person; after 24 hours attuned you're vulnerable to psychic damage and have disadvantage on Investigation, curable by greater restoration only after attunement ends.

magic-item:redeemer-s-regards.attunementNote: Requires attunement by a paladin; longbow
magic-item:redeemer-s-regards.description: Ranged attacks with it count as melee weapon attacks for Divine Smite and smite spells. Once per dawn, using Divine Smite with a 1st-level slot through it doesn't expend the slot.

magic-item:redsmith-crucible-set.description: Magic smith's tools. Once per 24 hours, a dwarf or creature proficient with smith's tools can hold a nonmagical metal weapon in the crucible for 10 minutes and succeed on a DC 10 Strength check to make it magical for 24 hours, optionally reforging it into another weapon with the same properties.

magic-item:redsmith-hammer.description: Its runes glow red-hot when beaten on an anvil, letting a smith shape weapons and armor with only the hammer and anvil.

magic-item:rejuvenating-draft.description: Drinking it restores spent Hit Dice: 1d3 + 1 (uncommon), 1d4 + 3 (rare), 1d6 + 4 (very rare), or all (legendary); the legendary draft also reduces your age by 1d4 years (minimum 1).

magic-item:reliquary-of-holy-memories.attunementNote: Requires attunement by a cleric or paladin
magic-item:reliquary-of-holy-memories.description: Holds a saint's bones and works as a magic mace. While attuned you can prepare one extra spell per bone (up to 5): 1 to 2 bones uncommon, 3 rare, 4 very rare, 5 legendary.

magic-item:riff-s-dimensional-ripper.description: It has 4 charges, regaining 1d4 at dawn. As an action within 5 feet of a creature at least one size larger, expend 1 to slip through a planar tear to the opposite side of it and make one attack; a hit deals an extra 1d6 force damage and denies it reactions until the end of your turn. If this would move you more than 20 feet, you return to your space, take 4d6 force damage, and waste the action.

magic-item:rift-sheath.description: A staff sheathing twin shortswords; twist it two-handed as a bonus action to draw or sheathe them. Staff: +1 to attack and damage, finesse, and once per dawn a bonus-action spatial rift while you concentrate, up to 1 minute, making movement within 15 feet of you cost double for other creatures. Swords: thrown (15/30), returning to your hand after each attack; once per hour, after a ranged hit, as a reaction teleport within 5 feet of the target and gain advantage on your next attack against it before the end of your next turn.

magic-item:ring-of-changing-shapes.description: Once per dawn each: when your spell is counterspelled, as a reaction spend 3 sorcery points to cast another spell of the same or lower level and casting time without a slot (no consumed components); and as a bonus action spend 5 sorcery points to cast a 5th-level or lower 1-action spell even after casting one this turn, then you can't move or act until after your next turn.

magic-item:ring-of-healer-s-heroism.description: When you use an action to heal another creature, you gain temporary hit points equal to your spellcasting modifier and immunity to being frightened until the end of your next turn.

magic-item:ring-of-lunar-might.description: Once per dusk, as an action project a 20-foot-radius, 40-foot-high gravity field that moves with you while you concentrate, up to 10 minutes: allies move at half cost and hostile creatures at double. As a bonus action each turn, a creature in it makes a DC 16 Strength save or takes 2d10 bludgeoning damage and falls prone; as a bonus action push or pull water in it up to 20 feet. Once ever, cast reverse gravity (DC 16).

magic-item:ring-of-misdirection.description: Found with 1d3 + 3 charges. As a reaction when hit by an opportunity attack, expend 1 to cast mislead without concentration until the end of your next turn; the double takes the hit and you both move up to your remaining speed without provoking. Nonmagical when empty.

magic-item:ring-of-rituals.description: Its command word lights or snuffs a heatless illusory candle flame above it. Once per dawn, using it as an extra component of a ritual casting reduces the casting time by 5 minutes.

magic-item:ring-of-solar-s-sight.description: It has 4 charges, regaining 1d3 + 1 at dawn. As a bonus action expend 1 to cast hunter's mark for 1 minute; you gain +2 to weapon attacks against the marked target, and hits deal radiant damage instead of their normal type.

magic-item:ring-of-stolen-alacrity.description: Once per dawn, if you aren't surprised, as a reaction when initiative is rolled (before anyone acts) choose a creature you see within 30 feet that rolled; it makes a DC 13 Charisma save (or may fail willingly) or swaps initiative totals with you. If the order is hidden, first pick up to three creatures to learn whether each acts before or after you.

magic-item:ring-of-the-arcane-berserker.description: Cast chill touch (+5 to hit) as an action. It has 3 charges, regaining 1d3 at dawn; expend 1 to cast a spell while raging without your rage ending for lack of attacks. You can also concentrate while raging, with disadvantage on concentration saves.

magic-item:ring-of-the-assassin-lord.description: While wearing it, you can deal Sneak Attack damage twice per turn against different targets, the second at half. It marks each creature of CR 1 or higher you drop with a Sneak Attack; at 50 marks your Dexterity and its maximum increase by 2, until another attuner earns the bonus.

magic-item:ring-of-the-mute-mage.description: Once per dawn, cast a 3rd-level or lower spell that requires only verbal components using somatic components instead (no benefit for spells the target must hear).

magic-item:ring-of-the-split-mind.description: While concentrating on a single spell, you have advantage on concentration saves. Once per dawn, while concentrating on a spell of 3rd level or lower, concentrate on a second such spell too, saving separately for each (in casting order) and being vulnerable to psychic damage while holding both.

magic-item:ring-of-volleys.description: When you draw a bow or crossbow, you can summon a nocked magic arrow or bolt that vanishes if not fired at once and after it hits or misses.

magic-item:rings-of-the-true-companions.description: Sets of two to four linked rings (join a new one by holding them together 1 minute; a ring over 1 mile away for 24 hours leaves the set). Even unattuned, once per dawn as a reaction you can make another wearer who drops to 0 hit points drop to 1 instead. A lone attuned wearer's ring has 3 charges (regaining 1d3 at dawn) to cast cure wounds (+3 modifier) as an action, at 30 feet on another wearer; each extra attuned wearer adds 2 to a shared pool and its recharge (maximum 9, regaining 1d3 + 6). With 2 attuned wearers, cure wounds on another wearer can be a bonus action once per turn; with 3, range 60 feet and upcast to 4th with extra charges; with 4 or more, you also gain 1d4 + 1 temporary hit points per charge.

magic-item:riptide-crossbow.description: It has 3 charges, regaining 1d3 at dawn. As an action expend 1 to fire at a point within normal range: creatures within 20 feet make a DC 15 Strength save, pulled 15 feet toward it (5 on a success), and the area is difficult terrain until your next turn, when it erupts in a wave that douses nonmagical flames; creatures there make a DC 15 Strength save, taking 3d10 bludgeoning damage and falling prone, or half and standing.

magic-item:roaring-whip.description: When you take the Attack action, you can attack a target up to 5 feet beyond your reach with it; on a hit its die becomes a d6 and it deals thunder damage. Each such crack roars audibly to 100 feet.

magic-item:rod-of-endless-light.description: As an action it sheds bright light 20 feet and dim 20 more for 1 hour or until ended as an action; change the color as a bonus action.

magic-item:rod-of-refstophobia.description: As an action it repels freestanding nonliving liquids within 10 feet, for up to 1 hour total in increments of at least 1 minute, regaining 15 minutes per 12 hours inactive.

magic-item:rod-of-reverberation.description: It has 3 charges, all regained at dawn. As a reaction when hit in melee, expend 1 to add 1d6 to your AC against that attack; if it then misses, the attacker makes a DC 15 Constitution save, taking 1d10 lightning plus 1d10 thunder damage and disadvantage on its next attack before the end of its next turn, or half damage on a success.

magic-item:rod-of-storms.description: As a reaction when a creature you see within 30 feet takes lightning damage, halve it and redirect: another target within 30 feet makes a DC 15 Dexterity save or takes the lightning damage the first creature took. It has 3 charges, all regained at dawn: as an action expend 1 to cast lightning bolt (DC 15), or call lightning (DC 15) if it's on your spell list, regaining a charge whenever its bolts strike you.

magic-item:rod-of-the-magicycle.description: As an action twist its handles to transform it (with a 100-foot roar) into a Medium wooden two-wheeled vehicle under you or within 5 feet, and back. It has AC 14 (17 while moving), 40 hit points, speed 60 feet (100 after 600 feet straight), weighs 200 pounds, carries one Medium or two smaller riders up to 300 pounds, needs an action to right if prone, and reverts underwater. It heals 1d8 per 8 hours idle; at 0 it reverts for 5 days. As a reaction on a Dexterity save while riding, gain advantage and on a success drive 20 feet, taking no damage if you leave the area; on a failure you both fall prone.

magic-item:rod-of-thought-projection.description: As an action form a telepathic link with a willing humanoid within 120 feet while you concentrate; as an action, see and hear through its senses (with its special senses) until your next turn while losing your own. Once per dawn you can target an unwilling creature (DC 13 Wisdom save, repeating each turn).

magic-item:rod-of-water-absorption.description: A 3-pound rod holding up to 40 gallons. As an action underwater, absorb 10 gallons over 1 minute (100 per day). As an action, cast create water at up to 4th level from its stores (rain uses 10 gallons per level), or blast at least 10 gallons in a 30-by-1-foot line: DC 15 Dexterity save, 2d6 bludgeoning damage per 10 gallons and pushed 10 feet, or half and not pushed.

magic-item:rope-caster.description: Load rope as a bonus action and fire it at a willing creature or unattended object in range; on a hit it deals no damage and ties itself on (a harness around a willing creature); against unwilling creatures it drops untied. A bound object is freed with an action and a DC 10 Strength or Dexterity check.

magic-item:rose-quartz-koi.description: Released underwater, the 2-pound crystal fish swims within a 5-foot cube, and turns salt water in a container no larger than 5 feet fresh in 10 minutes. Recapture it as an action.

magic-item:royal-blade-of-amphibios.description: While holding it, you can walk on liquids, hold your breath 30 minutes, swim at 30 feet, and creatures with the Amphibious trait understand you. You gain a +2 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. It has 3 charges, all regained at dawn; when you take the Attack action, expend 1 to turn it into a frog-tongue lash for the turn: +10 feet of reach, slashing damage, and a hit forces a DC 16 Strength save or pulls the target 10 feet toward you.

magic-item:royal-incinerator.attunementNote: Requires attunement by a druid, sorcerer, warlock, or wizard
magic-item:royal-incinerator.description: A magic quarterstaff granting +2 to attack and damage rolls and an extra 1d8 fire damage on a hit; while held you have resistance to fire damage. It has 15 charges, regaining 2d6 + 3 at dawn (on the last, roll a d20; on a 1 it erupts in a 20-foot-radius, 80-foot pillar, DC 17 Dexterity, 8d6 fire or half). As a reaction when hit, expend charges to reduce the damage by 5 per charge, and an attacker within 5 feet takes that much fire damage. As an action cast fire shield (4, warm only), fireball (3+), or scorching ray (2+), upcasting with extra charges.

magic-item:rust-arrow.description: Found in quivers of 1d3 + 2. A hit against a creature wearing nonmagical metal armor or holding a nonmagical metal shield or weapon gives one such item a permanent cumulative -1 to AC or damage, destroying it at AC 10 (or +0) or -5. Against unattended ferrous metal, it destroys a 1-foot cube. It crumbles on a hit.

magic-item:sagittarian-vestments.attunementNote: Requires attunement by a cleric or paladin; any armor
magic-item:sagittarian-vestments.description: While wearing it, you have advantage on Medicine checks and can stabilize a dying creature by touch as a bonus action. Attuned, the tabard shows your deity's symbol, stabilizing has a 5 percent chance (a 20 on a d20) to restore 1 hit point, and once per dawn you can cast spiritual weapon (+5 attack, +2 modifier) as a bow in your space firing 30-foot ranged spell attacks. Curse: until remove curse, your legs become equine hooves, you take -5 on Stealth checks, and your standing jump distance is halved.

magic-item:salamander-flame-gauntlets.description: While wearing them, unarmed strikes with your hands deal an extra 1d4 fire damage. As a bonus action cast flame blade at 4th level without concentration, using your spellcasting ability, Strength, or Dexterity; as an action hurl it as a 30-foot ranged spell attack for 4d6 fire damage, then it reforms.

magic-item:sash-of-sorcerous-synergy.description: It has 5 charges, regaining 1d4 + 1 at dawn. As a reaction when an ally you see within 60 feet casts a spell, expend charges equal to a known Metamagic option's sorcery point cost to apply it (choosing any new target). Using Metamagic lets you restyle the sash.

magic-item:satchel-of-beast-chow.description: Holds 2d4 + 2 servings. A beast or monstrosity of CR 2 or lower and Intelligence 3 or lower that eats from your hand makes a DC 15 Wisdom save or is charmed for 1 hour (ending if you or allies harm it), regarding your group as friends and granting advantage on Animal Handling and Charisma checks with it; afterward it stays nonhostile unless threatened.

magic-item:scarlet-scourge.description: You gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. Each hit on a Small or larger living creature that isn't a construct, ooze, plant, or undead adds a charge (maximum 10, lost on a rest); every 5 charges add 5 feet of reach. As a bonus action convert all charges into 2 hit points each.

magic-item:scepter-of-faith.description: As a bonus action cast shield of faith on another creature; as a reaction when an attacker within 60 feet damages that creature, push the attacker 5 feet away. Each once per dawn, as an action cast guardian of faith or find the path (to a temple or holy site only).

magic-item:scorned-heart-breastplate.description: You gain +1 AC per two allies within 10 feet (maximum +2). Once per dawn, cast hellish rebuke (DC 15) at 3rd level as a reaction. Curse: until remove curse (removing the armor doesn't help), you have disadvantage on saves against being charmed and on Charisma checks with creatures you find attractive.

magic-item:scorpio-armor.description: While wearing it, it imposes no Stealth disadvantage in dim light or darkness, but your speed drops by 5 feet in sunlight. Attuned, you have advantage on saves against poison, and once per dusk as a bonus action you sense creatures on the ground within 30 feet as if by tremorsense for an instant.

magic-item:scorpion-lasher.description: Once per turn on a hit, deal an extra 1d6 poison damage, and a Medium or smaller target makes a DC 13 Strength save or is pulled 5 feet toward you.

magic-item:scroll-of-mapping.description: Reading it as an action turns it into a lasting map of the 1-mile radius around you, showing structures and terrain, your location, and zooming or panning at a touch. Very rare: in color with place names, and once per 12 hours, as an action ask where a named or described familiar person or place is; matching targets in the area are marked (and tracked if moving) for 10 minutes, unless transformed or hidden from divination.
